    case 'say': { if (state.mode === 'seat') await camSettled(); const ms = sayMs(s.text); // 美術評分修正 e：視訊裡的主管不在店裡：泡泡改成沒有尾巴的「畫外音」樣式（原本尾巴指著凱文）
      say(s.text, Math.max(ms / DEV_SPEED, Math.min(ms, 700)), personOf(s.who), s.name || null, s.who === 'boss');
      return realWait(ms + 450); }
    case 'wait': return realWait(s.sec * 1000);
    case 'look': lookToward(personOf(s.who), 2.3); return realWait(500); // 和對話時轉向說話的人一樣，可以轉到身後
    case 'pose': setPose(s.who, s.pose); return realWait(350);
    case 'enter': {
      if (S.REGULAR_IDS.includes(s.who)) { S.arrive(save, s.who, today()); live.arrived.add(s.who); }
      const spot = spotFor(s.who, s.at);
      live.planned[s.who] = spot; // 一起走進來的人（阿哲站在阿公旁邊）要知道對方要去哪裡
      const go = enterPerson(s.who, spot, s.pose, s.then || s.pose, s.fast);
      if (!s.async) await go;
      return;
    }
    case 'walk': return movePerson(s.who, spotFor(s.who, s.at), s.pose, s.then);
    case 'arrived': {
      const t0 = performance.now();
      while (live.at[s.who] !== live.planned[s.who] && performance.now() - t0 < 30000) await realWait(100);
      return undefined;
    }
    case 'leave': return leavePerson(s.who);
    case 'deshuTo': return deshuGo(nearSpot(s.who));
    case 'deshuHome': {
      if (!s.async) return deshuGo(HOME);
      const go = deshuGo(HOME).finally(() => { if (live.deshuWalk === go) live.deshuWalk = null; });
      live.deshuWalk = go;
      return undefined;
    }
    case 'serve': return serveTo(s.who, s.kind);
    case 'cat': return catTo(s.who, s.lap);
    case 'music': return musicDown();
    case 'laugh': return Promise.all(s.who.map(laugh));
    case 'glance': return glance(personOf(s.who));
    case 'weather': return startTyphoon();
    case 'prop': counterBag.visible = true; return realWait(500);
    case 'choice': {
      const i = await choose(s.options, s.prompt || ''); live.answers[s.key] = i; save.story.answers[s.key] = i; persist();
      if (s.speak) await playerSays(s.options[i]); // 來訪段落：老闆那句以「你」的泡泡說出來（括號的動作不出泡泡）
      return;
    }
    // 來訪段落（visits.js）多的幾種步驟：只在某個狀態下演、記一件事、龍眼在窗台上的小動作
    case 'when': return VS.condOk(save, s.if, { catSill: catOnSill() }) ? playSteps(s.steps, tok) : undefined;
    case 'mark':
      if (s.flag) save.flags[s.flag] = true;
      if (s.early) MO.markEarly(save, s.early);
      persist();
      return undefined;
    case 'catMove': return catFree() ? catMove(s.kind) : undefined;
    case 'branch': return playSteps(s.cases[live.answers[s.key] ?? save.story.answers[s.key] ?? 0] || [], tok); // 隔天才用到的選項（凱文念啟事）從存檔讀
    case 'notice': return postNotice();
    case 'keys': return handKeys(s.who);
    case 'name': { // 最後一晚：德叔第一次叫老闆的名字
      const t = F.nameLine(save.player.name), ms = sayMs(t) + 800;
      lookToward(null); // 視線回到桌上的琺瑯杯
      say(t, ms / DEV_SPEED, deshu);
      return realWait(ms + 450);
    }
    case 'ifFire': return save.player.resignation === 'fire' ? playSteps(s.steps, tok) : undefined;
    case 'read': return new Promise((r) => openLetter(S.DOCS[s.doc], r));
    case 'brewTaste': return brewTaste();
    case 'menu': return zheBeansAsk();
    default: return undefined;
  }
}

// 阿哲第六幕（任務 #19，Q73 的暫定做法，D186）：阿哲的豆收進菜單本，德叔問老闆要不要寫上黑板；老闆可以說之後再說。
// 任務照舊在這一幕演完時完成（不卡 37°C）；黑板寫滿了就問要擦掉哪一行，也可以先不寫
async function zheBeansAsk() {
  const d = today();
  MN.unlock(save, 'zhe-beans', d, now(), { board: false });
  MN.markTold(save, 'zhe-beans');
  persist();
  if (MN.onBoard(save, 'zhe-beans')) { drawBackBar(); return realWait(800); } // 中途重新整理、重演一次：已經寫上去了
  const i = await choose(MN.ZHE6.options, MN.ZHE6.ask, '德叔');
  let ok = false;
  if (i === 0) {
    ok = MN.write(save, 'zhe-beans', d);
    if (!ok) {
      const lines = [...save.menu.board];
      const j = await choose([...lines.map((id) => MN.eraseOf(MN.ITEMS[id].name)), MN.BOOK.cancel], MN.BOOK.swap, '德叔');
      if (j < lines.length) ok = MN.replace(save, lines[j], 'zhe-beans', d);
    }
  }
  if (ok) {
    MN.markNoticed(save, 'zhe-beans', 'zhe');
    persist();
    drawBackBar();
    audio.play('click');
    return realWait(900);
  }
  persist();
  const ms = sayMs(MN.ZHE6.later);
  say(MN.ZHE6.later, ms / DEV_SPEED, deshu);
  return realWait(ms + 450);
}

// 演一個里程碑；演完才記進存檔（中途重新整理就從頭再演一次）
// full：老闆坐著、來訪段落開著時，改演那個里程碑當天的擴寫（visits.js 的 kind: 'with'；原場景的每一句照順序都在裡面），
// 演完記進存檔之後，結尾有第一杯的就自然問一次（runInvite()）。站著、離線時照舊是原場景。
// 正式流程只在今天還有份量時才呼叫（storyTick() 的 liveScene()／entranceDue()）；開發者的 __cafe.playScene() 不看份量，滿了時是原場景
async function runScene(m, { full = false } = {}) {
  const tok = ++live.token;
  const ex = full ? VS.expansionFor(save, m.id, today()) : null;
  state.scene = m;
  bubble.classList.remove('show');
  updateUI();
  try {
    await playSteps(ex ? ex.steps : m.scene, tok);
    if (!behindBar(deshu.position) || deshu.position.distanceTo(HOME) > 0.05) await deshuGo(HOME);
  } catch (e) {
    if (e !== ABORT) console.warn('熟客場景中斷', e);
    if (tok !== live.token) return; // 跳天數等等讓場景作廢：不記進存檔
  }
  const d = today();
  const got = S.complete(save, m, d, now());
  if (got.length) drawBackBar();
  if (m.gift) glowFund(); // 熟客送的東西收進倉庫：佈置鈕輕輕亮一下
  if (m.id === 'zhe4') for (const w of ['zhe', 'grandpa']) live.leaveAt.set(w, performance.now() + 60000 / DEV_SPEED);
  if (m.id === 'zhe3') live.leaveAt.delete('zhe'); // 颱風夜，阿哲待在店裡
  // 來訪段落：老闆看到的里程碑（含同日擴寫）算那位熟客今天的一段；擴寫版演過就不再演接回；窗口過了的段落跳過
  VS.noteMilestone(save, m.who, d);
  if (ex) VS.markPlayed(save, ex, d);
  VS.expire(save);
  persist();
  if (ex && VS.inviteOf(ex) && tok === live.token) await runInvite(m.who, VS.inviteOf(ex), tok).catch((e) => { if (e !== ABORT) console.warn('第一杯的邀請中斷', e); });
  state.scene = null;
  updateUI();
  refreshDevTools();
  checkTasks({ delay: 600 });
  readyAt = performance.now() + 6000 / DEV_SPEED;
}

// 熟客的來訪段落（visits.js）：里程碑之間的閒聊、離線里程碑之後的接回。和熟客場景同一套步驟與鏡頭（state.scene，conversing() 為真）；
// 不完成任務、不加溫度、不寫日誌；演完才記進存檔（中途換一天就作廢，那一段之後照窗口規則再演或跳過）
async function runVisit(seg) {
  const tok = ++live.token;
  state.scene = { id: seg.id, visit: true, who: seg.who };
  bubble.classList.remove('show');
  updateUI();
  try {
    await playSteps(seg.steps, tok);
    if (!behindBar(deshu.position) || deshu.position.distanceTo(HOME) > 0.05) await deshuGo(HOME);
  } catch (e) {
    if (e !== ABORT) console.warn('來訪段落中斷', e);
    if (tok !== live.token) return;
  }
  const d = today();
  VS.markPlayed(save, seg, d);
  visitLog.push({ id: seg.id, day: d });
  persist();
  const inv = VS.inviteOf(seg);
  if (inv && tok === live.token) await runInvite(seg.who, inv, tok).catch((e) => { if (e !== ABORT) console.warn('第一杯的邀請中斷', e); });
  state.scene = null;
  updateUI();
  refreshDevTools();
  readyAt = performance.now() + 6000 / DEV_SPEED;
}
const visitLog = []; // 測試用：演過的來訪段落
// 段落結尾的第一杯（最愛第一段）：老闆在選項裡自然請一杯（提案決策 B）。選「我請」就直接端黑板上的那一杯（服從一天一杯）；
// 黑板上沒有那一杯（阿哲是沒有龍眼乾）時，德叔問要端哪一杯，照平常的選杯流程。今天這位熟客的邀請就算問過了（點他不再問）
async function runInvite(w, inv, tok) {
  const d = today();
  if (!VS.inviteReady(save, w, d) || !PEOPLE[w]?.visible) return;
  VS.markOffered(save, w, d);
  persist();
  const i = await choose(inv.options);
  if (tok !== live.token) throw ABORT;
  VS.markInvited(save, w); // 問到了（選項出來前中斷的，之後由接回補問：予安是 yuan-r3）
  persist();
  await playerSays(inv.options[i]);
  if (i !== 0) { await playSteps(inv.no, tok); return; }
  const drink = VS.inviteDrink(save, inv, boardShift);
  await playSteps(drink ? inv.yes : inv.missing, tok);
  state.scene = null; // 端過去的那段由 serveFavorite() 接手（state.favorite）
  if (drink) { await serveFavorite(w, drink, { quiet: true }); return; }
  const drinks = MN.boardDrinks(save, boardShift);
  if (!drinks.length) return;
  const j = await choose([...drinks.map((id) => MN.ITEMS[id].name), FV.FAV_TEXT.cancel], FV.FAV_TEXT.ask(favName(w)), barName());
  if (j < drinks.length && tok === live.token && PEOPLE[w].visible) await serveFavorite(w, drinks[j]); // 選完杯，德叔照平常說「好，我沖一杯過去。」
}
// 老闆在場時，這位熟客現在可以開始演的里程碑：S.liveNext() 再看今天的份量（visits.js 的 milestoneRoom()：
// 在場的里程碑含同日擴寫算一段，每位熟客一天一段、全店一天兩段）。份量滿了就是 null：今天不演、不記完成、不給獎勵，
// 條件與順序不動，等下一個有份量的遊玩日（老闆不在的日子照舊由營業日誌結算）。&visits=0（隔離原場景的測試）不看份量
function liveScene(w, d) {
  const m = S.liveNext(save, w, d);
  return m && (!VISITS_ON || VS.milestoneRoom(save, w, d)) ? m : null;
}
// 走進來就是演出的里程碑（颱風夜、阿哲帶阿公來）今天可以演：條件達成、在場的全店一天一個、今天的份量還有
const entranceDue = (w, m, d) => !!m?.entrance && S.isDue(save, m, d) && (!m.present || save.story.lastPresentDay !== d)
  && (!VISITS_ON || VS.milestoneRoom(save, w, d));
// 今天別的熟客還要演的里程碑有幾個（全店一天兩段：先留給它們）；今天已經用掉一段的熟客，里程碑今天也不會演，不留
function reservedMilestones(w, d) {
  let n = 0;
  const used = VS.slotsToday(save, d);
  for (const o of S.REGULAR_IDS) {
    if (o === w || used.includes(o) || (!live.arrived.has(o) && !live.expect.has(o))) continue;
    const m = S.nextMilestone(save, o);
    if (m && save.regulars[o].lastMilestoneDay !== d && S.isDue(save, m, d) && (!m.present || save.story.lastPresentDay !== d)) n++;
  }
  return n;
}
const VISIT_QUIET_MS = 8000; // 店裡安靜這麼久（遊戲時間）之後，才開始來訪段落（熟客剛坐下、剛說完話時不馬上開始）
// 現在可以演的來訪段落：人在店裡、坐在自己的位子上，這位熟客今天沒有里程碑要演
function visitCandidate(d) {
  if (!VISITS_ON || keeper() || F.inFarewell(save) || state.guest || state.closing) return null;
  for (const w of S.REGULAR_IDS) {
    if (!live.arrived.has(w) || !PEOPLE[w].visible || live.at[w] !== HOME_SPOT[w] || state.favorite === w) continue;
    const m = S.nextMilestone(save, w);
    const due = !!m && save.regulars[w].lastMilestoneDay !== d && S.isDue(save, m, d);
    const seg = VS.dueVisit(save, w, d, { milestoneDue: due, reserved: reservedMilestones(w, d) });
    if (seg) return seg;
  }
  return null;
}

// 新的一天（進店、跳天數、過了午夜）：決定今天誰會來
function stopStory() {
  live.token++;
  keeperHome(true); // 凱文坐在老闆旁邊喝的那杯（D200）：換一天、重設時直接回到吧台
  state.scene = null;
  if (state.choice) { state.choice = false; $('choices').innerHTML = ''; }
  for (const w of PEOPLE_IDS) {
    PEOPLE[w].visible = false;
    removeGuestCup(w);
  }
  live.expect.clear(); live.arrived.clear(); live.leaveAt.clear();
  live.at = {}; live.planned = {}; live.answers = {}; live.seatHinted = false; live.visitSeatHinted = false; live.closeHinted = false; live.deshuWalk = null; live.fwHinted = 0; live.held = new Set(); live.trialOfferHint = '';
  live.day = 0;
  catHoldUntil = 0;
}
function startDay() {
  if (!REGULARS_ON || !save.flags.seenOpening) return;
  const d = today();
  if (live.day === d) return;
  stopStory();
  live.day = d;
  S.settleThrough(save, d - 1);
  refreshNotice();
  if (F.departureDue(save, d)) { departureMorning(); updateUI(); return; } // 離開東山的早上
  if (H.closedOn(save, d)) {
    // 今天已經打烊了（打烊後重新整理）；最後一晚的話，凱文還在，龍眼睡在他腿上
    if (REGULARS_ON && (F.fw(save).on[7] === d || F.segmentDue(save, d)?.lastNight)) { placeAt('kevin', SPOT.kevin, 'free'); live.arrived.add('kevin'); }
    updateUI();
    return;
  }
  const t = performance.now();
  for (const p of S.planToday(save, d)) {
    if (p.who === 'kevin' && keeper()) continue; // 離開東山之後，凱文在吧台後面顧店
    if (p.already) {
      // 同一天重新整理：予安、凱文還在位子上；阿哲平常早就走了（颱風夜還在，或還有話要說時才在）
      if (p.who !== 'zhe' || save.story.typhoonDay === d || liveScene('zhe', d)) {
        placeAt(p.who, HOME_SPOT[p.who]);
        live.arrived.add(p.who);
      }
      continue;
    }
    live.expect.set(p.who, t + arrivalDelay(p.who, d));
  }
  planFarewellDay(d, t);
  updateUI();
}
// 什麼時候走進來（毫秒）：予安一開門就在；阿哲隔一會兒；凱文下午五點（開發者模式不等五點）
function arrivalDelay(w, d) {
  if (w === 'yuan') return 0;
  if (w === 'zhe') return (20000 + Math.floor(((d * 7919) % 25) * 1000)) / DEV_SPEED;
  if (DEV) return 8000 / DEV_SPEED;
  if (F.inFarewell(save) && F.done(save, 3)) return 10000; // 錄取之後，凱文早一點來（德叔：「明天早一點來。」）
  const ms = S.kevinWaitMs(new Date(now()));
  return ms ? ms : 3000;
}
async function arriveNormally(w) {
  const d = today();
  S.arrive(save, w, d);
  persist();
  if (w === 'yuan') { placeAt('yuan', SPOT.yuan); live.arrived.add('yuan'); return; }
  const m = S.nextMilestone(save, w);
  const seatPose = m?.arrivePose && S.isDue(save, m, d) ? m.arrivePose : defaultPose(w);
  live.walking = (live.walking || 0) + 1;
  await enterPerson(w, HOME_SPOT[w], w === 'kevin' ? 'walk' : 'stand', seatPose);
  live.walking--;
  if (live.day !== d) return;
  live.arrived.add(w);
  if (w === 'zhe') live.leaveAt.set('zhe', performance.now() + 100000 / DEV_SPEED);
}
const sceneReady = () => quiet() && !dueLetter(save, letterCtx());

function storyTick() {
  if (!REGULARS_ON || !live.day || live.day !== today()) return;
  const d = live.day, t = performance.now();
  for (const [w, at] of live.expect) {
    if (state.guest || state.closing) break; // 客人模式、打烊時沒有人走進來
    if (t < at) continue;
    const m = S.nextMilestone(save, w);
    // 自己走進來就是演出的里程碑（颱風夜、阿哲帶阿公來）：等店裡安靜下來。
    // 今天的份量滿了就照平常走進來，那個里程碑等下一個有份量的遊玩日（不記完成）
    if (entranceDue(w, m, d)) {
      if (sceneReady() && !state.scene) { live.expect.delete(w); runScene(m); return; }
      continue;
    }
    live.expect.delete(w);
    arriveNormally(w);
  }
  for (const [w, at] of live.leaveAt) {
    if (state.guest) break; // 客人模式中，聊天的人不會走
    if (t > at && !state.scene && state.favorite !== w && (!S.REGULAR_IDS.includes(w) || !liveScene(w, d)) && !farewellNeeds(w, d)) { live.leaveAt.delete(w); leavePerson(w); }
  }
  if (state.scene || !sceneReady()) return;
  // 今天的份量滿了的熟客不在候選裡（liveScene()）：不演第三段，也不提「先坐」「等打烊」
  const cands = [...live.arrived].map((w) => liveScene(w, d)).filter(Boolean)
    .sort((a, b) => (a.present - b.present) || S.MILESTONES.indexOf(a) - S.MILESTONES.indexOf(b));
  for (const m of cands) {
    // 予安念稿：要老闆按了「打烊」、喝完最後一杯；還沒打烊時德叔提一次
    if (!!m.needClosing !== (state.closing === 'after')) {
      if (m.needClosing && !state.closing && !live.closeHinted) { live.closeHinted = true; say(m.needClosingHint, 4800); }
      continue;
    }
    if (m.needSeat && state.mode !== 'seat') {
      if (!live.seatHinted) { live.seatHinted = true; say(m.needSeatHint, 4800); }
      continue;
    }
    // 里程碑當天的擴寫（visits.js）：老闆坐著才演擴寫版。在場的里程碑（yuan3）等老闆坐下，德叔提一次「先坐。」；
    // 可以離線的里程碑不等，照舊演原場景（之後演接回或跳過），條件與順序都不動。
    // 能走到這裡就表示今天還有份量（liveScene()），擴寫不會因為份量滿了消失
    const ex = VISITS_ON ? VS.expansionFor(save, m.id, d) : null;
    if (ex && m.present && state.mode !== 'seat') {
      if (!live.visitSeatHinted) { live.visitSeatHinted = true; say(VS.SEAT_HINT, 3000); }
      continue;
    }
    runScene(m, { full: !!ex && state.mode === 'seat' });
    return;
  }
  // 來訪段落：里程碑都沒有要演時，坐著才演；站著時德叔提一次「先坐。」（一天一次）
  const seg = live.day === d && moments.quietFrom && (performance.now() - moments.quietFrom) * DEV_SPEED > VISIT_QUIET_MS ? visitCandidate(d) : null;
  if (seg) {
    if (state.mode === 'seat') { runVisit(seg); return; }
    if (!live.visitSeatHinted && !state.placing) { live.visitSeatHinted = true; say(VS.SEAT_HINT, 3000); }
  }
  farewellTick(d);
}
setInterval(storyTick, 500);

/* ---------- 等客人（承峰 11/3 試玩回饋 3，D179） ---------- */
// 「要玩家等，但要等啥沒讓玩家知道，會以為當機了」：熟客快走到門口的前幾秒，門外有腳步聲、門上的鈴輕輕晃，
// 提示列寫「好像有人往這邊走來了……」；坐著、一陣子沒人說話時，提示列換成等待的句子（文字與規則在 story.js 的 waitHint()）。
// 熟客場景裡「營業中」（D219）一字不改，只讓提示列慢慢呼吸（index.html 的 .hint.breathe），看得出畫面沒有停住
// 下一位熟客還有幾毫秒走進門（遊戲時間，開發者倍率換算回來）；今天沒有人要來、客人模式、打烊時是 null
function nextArrivalMs() {
  if (!REGULARS_ON || !live.day || live.day !== today() || state.guest || state.closing) return null;
  const t = performance.now();
  let best = null;
  for (const [w, at] of live.expect) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(at)) continue;
    const m = S.nextMilestone(save, w);
    if (entranceDue(w, m, live.day) && !sceneReady()) continue; // 走進來就是演出的：要等店裡安靜下來，時間說不準
    best = Math.min(best ?? Infinity, Math.max(0, at - t) * DEV_SPEED);
  }
  return best;
}
function waitTick() {
  const next = nextArrivalMs();
  if (next !== null && next <= S.APPROACH_MS && !waiting.approach) {
    waiting.approach = { until: performance.now() + (next + 4000) / DEV_SPEED };
    audio.play('steps');
    ringDoorBell();
  }
  if (waiting.approach && performance.now() > waiting.approach.until) waiting.approach = null;
  const here = PEOPLE_IDS.some((w) => PEOPLE[w].visible);
  const idleMs = (performance.now() - Math.max(state.satAt || 0, sayEnds, waiting.quietFrom)) * DEV_SPEED;
  const line = S.waitHint({ approaching: !!waiting.approach, nextMs: next, idleMs, here });
  if (line !== waiting.line) { waiting.line = line; updateUI(); }
}
setInterval(waitTick, 500);

/* ---------- 店裡的小事（承峰 11/3 第二輪回饋：方案 3、1、5；文字與規則在 moments.js） ---------- */
// 店裡沒事的時候（沒有演出、沒有人說話、沒在沖咖啡、沒有人走進來），依序看：
// 1. 擺飾第一次擺出來的反應（D183）：安靜 4 秒就演，一件一次（存檔 moments.decor）；
// 2. 前三天的小段落（D181）：安靜 30 秒（遊戲時間）之後演，一段一次（存檔 moments.early）；
// 3. 店內小事件（D182）：安靜 1～3 分鐘一件。
// 演的時候 moments.busy，quiet() 為 false：熟客場景、交信、德叔的話都等它演完（每件最多十幾秒）
// 開發者模式：店內小事件預設不自己發生（冒煙測試快轉時不會被隨機的小事打斷），&idle=N 改成安靜 N 秒（真實時間）就來一件；
// &moments=0 連擺飾的反應、前三天的小段落也關掉。__cafe.idleEvent()／early()／decorReact() 可以直接演
const MOMENTS_ON = !DEV || params.get('moments') !== '0';
const IDLE_FIXED = DEV && Number(params.get('idle')) > 0 ? Number(params.get('idle')) * 1000 : 0;
const IDLE_ON = MOMENTS_ON && (!DEV || IDLE_FIXED > 0);
const idleGap = () => IDLE_FIXED || (MO.IDLE_GAP.min + Math.random() * (MO.IDLE_GAP.max - MO.IDLE_GAP.min)) / DEV_SPEED;
moments.gap = idleGap();
const deshuFree = () => !keeper() && !brewing && !deshuReturning && !wipeOn && deshu.userData.art === deshuCanvas.idle && deshu.position.distanceTo(HOME) < 0.05;
const catFree = () => catAtHome && !catBusy && !catHeld() && !catOnSeat && cat.visible;
function momentsFree() {
  return quiet() && !state.closing && !state.arriving && !live.walking && !waiting.approach && !state.closeup && !sceneHidden() && !bubble.classList.contains('show');
}
const placedSet = () => new Set(save.owned.filter((o) => o.placed).map((o) => o.item));
// 在店裡、沒在演場景的熟客
const hereNow = () => (state.scene ? [] : S.REGULAR_IDS.filter((w) => PEOPLE[w].visible && live.arrived.has(w)));
function earlyCtx() {
  return { day: today(), here: S.REGULAR_IDS.filter((w) => PEOPLE[w].visible), seated: hereNow().filter((w) => live.at[w] === HOME_SPOT[w]),
    expecting: [...live.expect.keys()], met: { yuan: S.hasMilestone(save, 'yuan', 1), zhe: S.hasMilestone(save, 'zhe', 1) } };
}
async function runMoment(kind, id, fn) {
  moments.busy = true;
  moments.log.push({ kind, id, at: Math.round(performance.now()) });
  try { await fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('店裡的小事', id, e); }
  moments.busy = false;
  moments.quietFrom = performance.now();
  moments.gap = idleGap();
  updateUI();
}
setInterval(() => {
  if (moments.busy || !MOMENTS_ON) return;
  const t = performance.now();
  // 黑板便條：德叔各提一次（第一次坐吧台座、第一次打烊後）。打烊後 momentsFree() 是 false，所以放在它前面，條件自己看（noteHintDue()）
  const nh = noteHintDue();
  if (nh) { runMoment('note', nh, () => noteHint(nh)); return; }
  if (!momentsFree()) { moments.quietFrom = t; return; }
  const quietMs = (t - moments.quietFrom) * DEV_SPEED;
  if (quietMs > 4000) {
    const item = MO.pendingDecor(save)[0];
    if (item) { runMoment('decor', item, () => decorReact(item)); return; }
  }
  // 黑板菜單（D187）：收進菜單本的東西德叔提一句；熟客看到自己的東西寫上黑板（或被擦掉）說一句。都是一次
  if (quietMs > 4000 && !keeper()) {
    const t = MN.pendingTell(save)[0];
    if (t) { runMoment('menu', t.id, () => menuTell(t)); return; }
    const r = MN.boardReaction(save, hereNow(), (w, n) => S.hasMilestone(save, w, n));
    if (r) { runMoment('board', `${r.item}:${r.who}:${r.kind}`, () => boardReact(r)); return; }
    // 熟客最愛的咖啡：這一段開放、那位熟客在店裡時，德叔在吧台說一次那一段的線索
    const c = REGULARS_ON && live.day === today() ? FV.pendingClue(save, hereNow()) : null;
    if (c) { runMoment('clue', `${c.who}-${c.n}`, () => favClue(c)); return; }
    // 試咖啡教學：配方開放了、老闆還站著 → 德叔請他坐下（一次）
    const pendGuide = TS.pendingOffer(save);
    if (pendGuide && !save.tasting?.guided && state.mode === 'overview' && deshuFree() && !state.placing) {
      runMoment('trial-guide', pendGuide, () => tasteGuide()); return;
    }
    // 試咖啡（D206、D207）：劇情配方開放了，老闆坐著、德叔在吧台閒著時提一次；還沒定案的測試紀錄，隔天提一次（一張最多一次）
    const off = deshuFree() && trialOfferable() ? TS.pendingOffer(save) : null;
    if (off) { runMoment('trial', off, () => offerTrial(off)); return; }
    const rec = TS.pendingHint(save, today());
    if (rec) { runMoment('record', String(rec.id), () => recordHint(rec)); return; }
  }
  if (REGULARS_ON && live.day === today() && quietMs > MO.EARLY_QUIET_MS && !keeper()) {
    const e = MO.earlyDue(earlyCtx(), save.moments.early);
    if (e) { runMoment('early', e.id, () => earlyBeat(e)); return; }
  }
  if (IDLE_ON && t - moments.quietFrom > moments.gap) {
    const e = MO.pickIdle({ placed: placedSet(), night: state.night, weather: state.weather, keeper: keeper(), deshuFree: deshuFree(), catFree: catFree(), recent: moments.recent }, Math.random());
    if (!e) { moments.quietFrom = t; return; }
    moments.recent = [e.id, ...moments.recent].slice(0, 2);
    runMoment('idle', e.id, () => idleEvent(e, MO.idleLine(e, Math.random())));
  }
}, 1000);

// 德叔換一個姿勢一會兒（擦杯子、彎腰寫黑板）；sway：紙片左右輕輕晃（擦的動作）。中途有別的動作換過圖就不換回來
async function deshuBusy(pose, sec, sway = 0) {
  const c = deshuCanvas[pose];
  setPaper(deshu, c);
  const m = deshu.userData.mesh;
  await animate(sec, (k) => { m.rotation.z = sway * Math.sin(k * Math.PI * 6) * Math.sin(Math.PI * k); });
  m.rotation.z = 0;
  if (deshu.userData.art === c && !brewing) setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.idle);
}
// 德叔走到某處做一件事再走回吧台：走開的這段當作「德叔走回吧台……」（deshuReturning），這時按沖咖啡會等他回來
async function deshuErrand(pos, fn) {
  let done;
  deshuReturning = new Promise((r) => { done = r; });
  try {
    await deshuGo(V2(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(pos.x + (pos.x < 0.45 ? 0.5 : -0.5), -2.6, 2.6), THREE.MathUtils.clamp(pos.z + 0.25, -3.6, 3.5)));
    await fn();
    await deshuGo(HOME);
    deshu.userData.mesh.position.y = 0;
  } finally { deshuReturning = null; done(); }
}
// 澆花：壺口落下幾滴水（小小的淡藍點，往下掉、淡掉）
function waterDrops(pos) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
    const s = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: puffTex, color: '#9fd0e6', transparent: true, opacity: 0.8, depthWrite: false }));
    s.position.set(pos.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.18, 0.75 + Math.random() * 0.15, pos.z + 0.1);
    s.scale.setScalar(0.035);
    s.visible = false;
    scene.add(s);
    const vy = 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.3, delay = i * 0.18;
    let t = 0;
    waiters.push((dt) => {
      t += dt * speedNow();
      if (t < delay) return false;
      s.visible = true;
      s.position.y -= vy * dt * speedNow();
      s.material.opacity = Math.max(0, 0.8 - (t - delay) * 1.4);
      if (t - delay > 0.6) { scene.remove(s); s.material.dispose(); return true; }
      return false;
    });
  }
}
// 窗台上的龍眼：伸懶腰（坐起來、拉長）、翻身（換邊）、尾巴晃（紙片輕輕擺）、坐起來看窗外。都不離開窗台（Q64）
async function catMove(kind) {
  catBusy = true;
  const m = cat.userData.mesh;
  try {
    if (kind === 'stretch') {
      setPaper(cat, catCanvas.sit);
      await animate(1.6, (k) => { cat.userData.squash = 1 + Math.sin(Math.PI * k) * 0.12; });
      cat.userData.squash = 1;
      await wait(0.6);
    } else if (kind === 'roll') {
      await animate(0.5, (k) => { m.position.y = SILL.y + Math.sin(Math.PI * k) * 0.05; cat.userData.squash = 1 - Math.sin(Math.PI * k) * 0.15; });
      catTurn = -catTurn;
      cat.userData.squash = 1;
    } else if (kind === 'tail') {
      await animate(2.4, (k) => { m.rotation.z = Math.sin(k * Math.PI * 4) * 0.035; });
    } else if (kind === 'look') {
      setPaper(cat, catCanvas.sit);
      await wait(6);
    }
  } finally {
    m.rotation.z = 0;
    if (catAtHome) { m.position.y = SILL.y; setPaper(cat, catCanvas.sleep); }
    cat.userData.squash = 1;
    catBusy = false;
  }
}
// 窗外經過的影子（機車）：後面那扇窗前一團很淡的影子由左滑到右
async function windowShadow(sec = 3.2) {
  const w = windows[0];
  const s = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: puffTex, color: '#2a2018', transparent: true, opacity: 0, depthWrite: false }));
  s.scale.set(0.55, 0.4, 1);
  scene.add(s);
  await animate(sec, (k) => {
    s.position.set(w.position.x - 0.75 + 1.5 * k, w.position.y - 0.3, w.position.z + 0.04);
    s.material.opacity = Math.sin(Math.PI * k) * (state.night ? 0.08 : 0.16);
  });
  scene.remove(s); s.material.dispose();
}
const decorOf = (ids) => [...decorPapers.values()].find((d) => ids.includes(d.userData.item.id));

// 店內小事件（D182）：line＝這次偶爾說的那一句（沒有就是不說話）
async function idleEvent(e, line = '') {
  const deshuSays = (ms = 3200) => { if (line) say(line, ms); };
  switch (e.id) {
    case 'deshu-wipe':
      await deshuBusy('wipe', 4.5, 0.025);
      deshuSays();
      break;
    case 'deshu-water': {
      const p = decorOf(['plant', 'succulent']);
      if (!p) break;
      await deshuErrand(p.position, async () => {
        setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.pour);
        waterDrops(p.position);
        await wait(2.2);
        setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.idle);
        deshuSays(2600);
        await wait(1.2);
      });
      break;
    }
    case 'deshu-board':
      setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.pour);
      await wait(1.6);
      // 黑板上喝的東西換一杯到最上面（只寫老闆寫上去的東西，D188）；只有一杯時只是重寫一次、不說「今天換這支」
      if (MN.boardDrinks(save).length > 1) boardShift++;
      else line = '';
      drawBackBar();
      audio.play('click');
      await wait(0.8);
      if (deshu.userData.art === deshuCanvas.pour && !brewing) setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.idle);
      deshuSays();
      break;
    case 'cat-stretch': await catMove('stretch'); deshuSays(); break;
    case 'cat-roll': await catMove('roll'); break;
    case 'cat-tail': await catMove('tail'); break;
    case 'cat-look': await catMove('look'); break;
    case 'window-bike':
      audio.play('motorbike');
      await windowShadow();
      deshuSays();
      break;
    case 'window-birds':
      audio.play('birds');
      await wait(2.5);
      break;
    default: break;
  }
  if (line) await realWait(2600);
}

// 前三天的小段落（D181）
async function earlyBeat(e) {
  MO.markEarly(save, e.id);
  persist();
  const tok = live.token;
  if (e.id === 'd1-peek') {
    // 門外有腳步聲、門上的鈴輕輕晃（D179 的提示照常），一位小姐推門進來，站在門口看了窗邊那張桌子一會兒，沒坐就走了
    waiting.approach = { until: performance.now() + 9000 / DEV_SPEED };
    audio.play('steps');
    ringDoorBell();
    updateUI();
    await realWait(4000);
    if (tok !== live.token) return;
    live.walking = (live.walking || 0) + 1;
    try {
      await enterPerson('yuan', { pos: V2(0.25, 2.55), cup: null }, 'stand', 'stand');
      updateUI(); // 人進來了：「好像有人往這邊走來了……」換回平常的提示
      if (tok !== live.token) return;
      await wait(1.2);
      await glance(yuan, 2.2);
      await wait(1.5);
      await leavePerson('yuan');
    } finally { live.walking--; }
    if (tok !== live.token) return;
    await realWait(1500);
  } else if (e.id === 'd2-refill') {
    await serveTo('yuan', 'hot');
    deshuReturning = deshuGo(HOME).then(() => { deshuReturning = null; });
    await deshuReturning;
  } else if (e.id === 'd3-passerby') {
    audio.play('steps');
    await realWait(2600);
    ringDoorBell(0.12);
    await realWait(2200);
  }
  if (tok !== live.token) return;
  say(e.line[1], 4200, WHO[e.line[0]] || deshu);
  await realWait(4600);
}

// 收進菜單本的東西：德叔說一句（D187）
async function menuTell(t) {
  MN.markTold(save, t.id);
  persist();
  say(t.line, 4200, deshu);
  await realWait(4600);
}
// 熟客最愛的咖啡：德叔說那一段的線索（每段一次）
async function favClue(c) {
  FV.markClue(save, c.who, c.n);
  persist();
  if (!PEOPLE[c.who]?.visible) return;
  say(c.line, 4400, deshu);
  await realWait(4800);
}
// 熟客看到黑板：自己的東西第一次寫上去、或平常點的東西被擦掉（D187）
async function boardReact(r) {
  MN.markReaction(save, r);
  persist();
  if (!PEOPLE[r.who]?.visible) return;
  say(r.line, 4000, PEOPLE[r.who]);
  await realWait(4400);
}

// 試咖啡（承峰 11/5：「先做試咖啡」，D206；文字與規則在 tasting.js）：老闆坐著、德叔在吧台，沒有劇情、選項、演出時
function trialOfferable() {
  // 承峰：只在吧台座可以試（參數微調）
  return !keeper() && state.mode === 'seat' && state.seat?.id === 'bar' && !brewing && !deshuReturning && !state.choice && !state.scene && !state.favorite
    && !state.guest && !state.closing && !state.cinematic && !state.tutorial && !state.arriving && !state.placing && !state.letter && !overlayOpen()
    && deshu.visible && deshu.position.distanceTo(HOME) < 0.05;
}
// 微調面板狀態（參數微調 → 沖 → 登錄；定案另在記事本）
let tuneState = { item: 'dongshan', recipe: null, params: { ...TS.DEFAULT_PARAMS } };
function openTune(open, opt = {}) {
  const el = $('tune');
  if (!open) { el.hidden = true; live.trialOfferHint = ''; syncModal(); updateUI(); return; }
  openAbout(false); openNotebook(false);
  const items = TS.tuneItems(save);
  let item = opt.item || save.stats.lastBean || 'dongshan';
  let recipe = opt.recipe || null;
  if (opt.recipe && TS.RECIPES[opt.recipe]) { recipe = opt.recipe; item = TS.RECIPES[recipe].item; }
  if (!items.some((x) => x.id === item)) item = items[0]?.id || 'dongshan';
  const params = TS.normalizeParams(opt.params || TS.defaultParamsFor(item, recipe), item);
  tuneState = { item, recipe, params };
  $('tune-title').textContent = TS.TASTE.title;
  $('tune-sub').textContent = TS.TASTE.sub;
  renderTune();
  el.hidden = false;
  syncModal();
  const firstHint = !save.tasting.offerHint;
  if (firstHint) { TS.markOfferHint(save); persist(); }
  live.trialOfferHint = firstHint ? TS.TASTE.offerHint : '';
  updateUI();
  $('tune-brew').focus();
}
function renderTune() {
  const box = $('tune-list');
  box.innerHTML = '';
  const items = TS.tuneItems(save);
  const pick = document.createElement('div');
  pick.className = 'tune-items';
  const lab = document.createElement('p');
  lab.className = 'nb-help';
  lab.textContent = TS.TASTE.pickItem;
  box.appendChild(lab);
  for (const it of items) {
    const b = document.createElement('button');
    const name = MN.ITEMS[it.id]?.name || it.id;
    b.textContent = it.draft ? `${name}${TS.TASTE.draft}` : name;
    b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(it.id === tuneState.item));
    b.onclick = () => {
      tuneState.item = it.id;
      tuneState.recipe = it.recipe || (TS.RECIPES[it.id] ? it.id : null);
      tuneState.params = TS.normalizeParams(tuneState.params, it.id);
      // 換成冰／熱時技法檔位跟著換
      if (TS.isIceItem(it.id) && !TS.TECH_ICE.includes(tuneState.params.technique)) tuneState.params.technique = 'ice-pour';
      if (!TS.isIceItem(it.id) && TS.TECH_ICE.includes(tuneState.params.technique)) tuneState.params.technique = 'pulse';
      if (TS.isIceItem(it.id)) tuneState.params.temp = 0;
      else if (!tuneState.params.temp) tuneState.params.temp = TS.DEFAULT_PARAMS.temp;
      renderTune();
    };
    pick.appendChild(b);
  }
  box.appendChild(pick);
  const keys = ['ratio', 'temp', 'grind', 'technique'];
  for (const key of keys) {
    if (key === 'temp' && TS.isIceItem(tuneState.item)) {
      const row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'tune-row';
      row.innerHTML = `<b>${esc(TS.TASTE.param.temp)}</b><span class="val">${esc(TS.TASTE.tempIce)}</span>`;
      box.appendChild(row);
      continue;
    }
    const opts = key === 'ratio' ? TS.RATIOS
      : key === 'temp' ? TS.TEMPS
      : key === 'grind' ? TS.GRINDS
      : TS.techniquesFor(tuneState.item);
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'tune-row';
    const cur = tuneState.params[key];
    const i = Math.max(0, opts.indexOf(cur));
    const val = document.createElement('span');
    val.className = 'val';
    val.textContent = TS.labelParam(key, opts[i], tuneState.item);
    const minus = document.createElement('button');
    minus.textContent = '−';
    minus.setAttribute('aria-label', '少一點');
    minus.disabled = i <= 0;
    minus.onclick = () => { if (i > 0) { tuneState.params[key] = opts[i - 1]; renderTune(); } };
    const plus = document.createElement('button');
    plus.textContent = '＋';
    plus.setAttribute('aria-label', '多一點');
    plus.disabled = i >= opts.length - 1;
    plus.onclick = () => { if (i < opts.length - 1) { tuneState.params[key] = opts[i + 1]; renderTune(); } };
    const b = document.createElement('b');
    b.textContent = TS.TASTE.param[key];
    row.append(b, minus, val, plus);
    box.appendChild(row);
  }
}
function confirmTuneBrew() {
  if (!trialOfferable() && state.seat?.id === 'bar' && !brewing) { /* 面板開著時 overlayOpen 為真，試一次放寬 */ }
  const seat = state.seat;
  if (!seat || seat.id !== 'bar' || brewing || keeper()) return;
  const { item, recipe, params } = tuneState;
  const p = TS.normalizeParams(params, item);
  openTune(false);
  brew(seat, item, { trial: recipe || true, tune: { item, recipe, params: p } });
}
$('tune-brew').onclick = () => confirmTuneBrew();
$('tune-cancel').onclick = () => {
  openTune(false);
  if (!keeper()) say(TS.TASTE.later, 3400, deshu);
};
$('tune').addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (e.target === $('tune')) openTune(false); });

function brewTrial(id, opt = {}) {
  // 開發／冒煙：不開面板，直接用配方預設參數沖；autoLog 自動登錄（略過沖完選項）
  if ((!trialOfferable() && !opt.force) || !TS.recipeOpen(save, id)) return false;
  if (!state.seat || state.seat.id !== 'bar') return false;
  const r = TS.RECIPES[id];
  const params = TS.normalizeParams(opt.params || TS.defaultParamsFor(r.item, id), r.item);
  brew(state.seat, r.item, { trial: id, tune: { item: r.item, recipe: id, params }, autoLog: !!opt.autoLog });
  return true;
}
async function tasteGuide() {
  TS.markGuided(save);
  persist();
  say(TS.TASTE.guide, 4800, deshu);
  await realWait(5200);
}
async function offerTrial(id) {
  TS.markOffered(save, id, today());
  persist();
  say(TS.RECIPES[id].offer, 5200, deshu);
  const i = await choose([TS.TASTE.yes, TS.TASTE.no]);
  if (i === 0) {
    if (!trialOfferable()) return;
    openTune(true, { recipe: id });
    return;
  }
  say(TS.TASTE.later, 3400, deshu);
  await realWait(3600);
}
// 吧台座點德叔：一起試一杯 → 開微調面板
const trialAgainable = () => trialOfferable() && !moments.busy && TS.tastingOpen(save);
// 還沒坐吧台座就點德叔想試（黑板便條，承峰 11/7）：營業中、試咖啡開放了（TS.tastingOpen）、老闆站著或坐在別的位子時，德叔提醒先坐吧台
const needBarSeat = () => !keeper() && !state.closing && !(state.mode === 'seat' && state.seat?.id === 'bar') && TS.tastingOpen(save) && !brewing && !moments.busy
  && !state.choice && !state.scene && !state.favorite && !state.guest && !state.tutorial && !state.placing;
async function offerTrialAgain() {
  const j = await choose([TS.TASTE.together, TS.TASTE.just]);
  if (j === 0) openTune(true, {});
}
async function recordHint(rec) {
  TS.markHinted(save, today());
  persist();
  const name = MN.ITEMS[TS.recordItem(rec)]?.name || '';
  say(TS.TASTE.hint(name), 4800, deshu);
  await realWait(5200);
}

// 擺飾第一次擺出來的反應（D183）：熟客在店裡就由熟客說，不然德叔或龍眼
async function decorReact(item) {
  MO.markDecor(save, item);
  persist();
  const r = MO.decorReaction(item, hereNow(), keeper());
  if (!r) return;
  const p = decorOf([item]);
  if (r.who === 'cat') {
    if (catFree()) await catMove('look');
    else await wait(1);
    if (!keeper()) { say(r.line, 3800); await realWait(4200); }
    return;
  }
  if (r.who === 'deshu') {
    if (r.act === 'visit' && p && deshuFree()) {
      await deshuErrand(p.position, async () => {
        await glance(deshu, 0.8);
        say(r.line, 3800);
        await realWait(4000);
      });
      return;
    }
    say(r.line, 3800);
    if (r.act === 'smile' && deshuCanvas.smile?.art && deshuFree()) await deshuBusy('smile', 2.6);
    await realWait(4200);
    return;
  }
  // 熟客：說一句，有的人輕輕跳一下
  say(r.line, 4000, PEOPLE[r.who]);
  if (r.act === 'laugh') await laugh(r.who);
  await realWait(4400);
}

/* ---------- 幫熟客找到最愛的咖啡、相簿（承峰 11/4 Q75～Q78，src/favorites.js） ---------- */
// 熟客在店裡、這一段開放、今天還沒收過老闆請的那杯：點他搭話後，下方多一個「請德叔端一杯給他」。
// 從黑板上喝的東西選（德叔只照黑板沖，D185；黑板上有點心就附一小碟）；德叔在吧台沖、端過去；熟客說一句。
// 端對：德叔看一眼，畫面淡成那一段的照片（回憶畫面，Q76），幾秒後自己淡回店裡，也可以點一下回去；收進記事本的相簿。
// 端錯：熟客照喝、說一句溫和的話；同一段錯兩次以後，德叔再說一句更靠近的話。沒有提示框、沒有「獲得」字樣。
// 演的時候 state.favorite 是那位熟客（quiet() 為 false：熟客劇情、信、店裡的小事都等它演完）
const favLog = []; // 測試用：演過的結果
const favName = (w) => (w === 'kevin' ? nameOf(kevin) : S.REGULARS[w].short);
const barName = () => (keeper() ? F.KEEPER.name : '德叔');
// 現在可以請德叔端一杯給他嗎：劇情演出、選項、客人模式、打烊、開場、佈置、面板開著時都不行；凱文顧店以後凱文不是客人
// 每位熟客一天只主動問一次（來訪段落的第一杯邀請也算一次，visits.js 的 offered）
function favOfferable(w) {
  return VS.offerable(save, w, today()) && favServable(w);
}
// 端得過去嗎（不看今天問過沒：問了、選了「請」之後用這個再確認一次）
function favServable(w) {
  return REGULARS_ON && S.REGULAR_IDS.includes(w) && FV.canServe(save, w, today()) && live.day === today() && live.arrived.has(w) && PEOPLE[w].visible
    && live.at[w] === HOME_SPOT[w] && !state.favorite && !state.scene && !state.choice && !state.guest && !state.closing && !state.cinematic && !state.tutorial
    && !state.arriving && !state.placing && !state.letter && !brewing && !moments.busy && !overlayOpen() && !(keeper() && w === 'kevin');
}
// 點熟客搭話之後：選項上面那一行是他剛說的那句；「只是聊聊」就照舊只搭話
async function offerFavorite(w) {
  const name = favName(w);
  VS.markOffered(save, w, today()); // 選「只是聊聊」當天就不再問（提案決策 D）
  persist();
  const i = await choose([FV.FAV_TEXT.offer(barName(), name), FV.FAV_TEXT.just]);
  if (i !== 0 || !favServable(w)) return false;
  const drinks = MN.boardDrinks(save, boardShift);
  const j = await choose([...drinks.map((id) => MN.ITEMS[id].name), FV.FAV_TEXT.cancel], FV.FAV_TEXT.ask(name), barName());
  if (j >= drinks.length || !favServable(w)) return false;
  return serveFavorite(w, drinks[j]);
}
// 吧台請凱文喝一杯（承峰 11/4：「坐吧台時可以請凱文喝一杯」，D199）：離開東山之後凱文在吧台後面顧店（吧台後面的紙片 deshu 換成凱文的圖）。
// 只有老闆坐在吧台座時，點凱文搭話後下方多一個「請凱文喝一杯」；其他座位、俯瞰、站著時點凱文照舊只搭話。
// 段落與答案照 favorites.js 的凱文三段；凱文照黑板替自己沖一杯、放在他面前的吧台上，老闆請客（誰沖、怎麼端：待承峰確認）
function keeperFavOfferable() {
  return REGULARS_ON && keeper() && state.mode === 'seat' && state.seat?.id === 'bar' && FV.canServe(save, 'kevin', today()) && live.day === today() && deshu.visible
    && !state.favorite && !state.scene && !state.choice && !state.guest && !state.closing && !state.cinematic && !state.tutorial && !state.arriving && !state.placing
    && !state.letter && !brewing && !deshuReturning && !moments.busy && !overlayOpen() && deshu.position.distanceTo(HOME) < 0.05;
}
function keeperLine() {
  const clue = FV.keeperClueLines(save);
  const pool = clue.length && Math.random() < 0.5 ? clue : F.KEEPER.talk;
  return pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
}
async function offerKeeperDrink() {
  const i = await choose([FV.KEEPER_FAV.offer, FV.FAV_TEXT.just]);
  if (i !== 0 || !keeperFavOfferable()) return false;
  const drinks = MN.boardDrinks(save, boardShift);
  const j = await choose([...drinks.map((id) => MN.ITEMS[id].name), FV.FAV_TEXT.cancel], FV.KEEPER_FAV.ask, F.KEEPER.name);
  if (j >= drinks.length || !keeperFavOfferable()) return false;
  return serveFavorite('kevin', drinks[j]);
}
// 凱文出來坐旁邊喝（承峰 11/4：「出來坐旁邊喝」，D200，取代 D199「放在自己面前的吧台上」）：
// 凱文在吧台沖好，端著杯子循路走出吧台（D214：不再寫死航點，不穿椅子、高腳椅與硬的東西），坐到老闆旁邊那張高腳椅（stoolMid），
// 杯子放在他面前的吧台上；說完端對／端錯的話、照片淡回之後，再坐著喝一會兒（KEEPER_SIT_MS），喝完端著空杯走回吧台裡他的位子。
// 吧台後面的紙片（deshu）就是凱文：走路用顧店的圖（kevinBar），坐下換成他當客人時坐高腳椅的圖（char_kevin_barstool_nochair，
// 沒有畫椅子，坐在店裡那張 stoolMid 上；D215 起椅子不收，D216 換掉自己畫了椅子的舊圖免得疊兩張）；沒有「繫圍裙端杯走路」「繫圍裙坐高腳椅喝」的圖，先用現有的頂著（D192：一張圖加程式動態，不生成圖）。
// 他離開吧台的整段當作 deshuReturning（德叔走回吧台的那個狀態）：請凱文沖一杯會先叫他回吧台再沖、熟客劇情／店裡的小事／客人模式的邀請／
// 打烊後擦杯子都等他回去；老闆站起來（換座位、打烊、佈置都要先站起來）、換一天、劇情開始，他就收杯回吧台
const KEEPER_SIDE = { pos: V2(1.3, -2.1), cup: new THREE.Vector3(1.72, TOP, -2.1), stool: stoolMid }; // 老闆旁邊那張高腳椅（OPPOSITE.bar 同一張）
const KEEPER_HOLD = new THREE.Vector3(0.2, 1.12, 0.15); // 端著走的時候杯子在他身上的哪裡（高過吧台檯面，走出吧台時看得到）
const KEEPER_SIT_MS = 20000; // 照片淡回之後再坐著喝多久（真實時間，跟開發者倍率）
const keeperCup = () => keeperOut?.cup || null;
// 鏡頭跟著凱文轉（只在吧台座）：lookToward() 只看一個定點，走路時要每一格重算
function followKeeper(max = 1.8) {
  if (state.mode !== 'seat' || !state.seat) return;
  const s = state.seat, b = s.look.clone().sub(s.eye), base = Math.atan2(b.x, b.z);
  const my = ++lookTok;
  focusP = null;
  realWaiters.push((dt) => {
    if (my !== lookTok || state.mode !== 'seat' || !keeperOut || keeperOut.phase !== 'walkOut') return true;
    if (tween) return false;
    const t = deshu.position.clone().sub(s.eye);
    const yaw = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(wrapAngle(Math.atan2(t.x, t.z) - base), -max, max);
    const k = Math.min(1, dt * 3);
    cam.yaw += (yaw - cam.yaw) * k;
    cam.pitch += (0 - cam.pitch) * k;
    return false;
  });
}
// 凱文端著杯子走出來、坐下、把杯子放在面前（演的時候 state.favorite 還是 'kevin'）。中途被叫回去（keeperBack）就停下來
async function keeperWalkOut(kind, dish) {
  keeperHome(true);
  const cup = makeCup(kind, dish);
  if (cup.userData.liquid && kind !== 'iced') cup.userData.liquid.visible = true;
  let done;
  const ko = keeperOut = { phase: 'walkOut', cup, until: 0, done: null };
  ko.done = new Promise((r) => { done = r; });
  ko.resolve = done;
  deshuReturning = ko.done; // 他回到吧台之前，請凱文沖一杯、熟客劇情、店裡的小事都等（brew()、quiet()）
  setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.pour);
  await wait(0.5);
  setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.idle);
  deshu.attach(cup);
  cup.position.copy(KEEPER_HOLD);
  cup.rotation.set(0, 0, 0);
  if (state.mode === 'seat' && state.seat?.id === 'bar') followKeeper();
  // 路由 navPath() 找（D214：不再寫死吧台出口、走道的航點）：一個轉折點走一段，走出吧台的那一段起鏡頭先轉去高腳椅那邊等他
  let looked = false;
  for (const pt of navPath(deshu.position, KEEPER_SIDE.pos)) {
    if (!looked && !behindBar(deshu.position) && state.mode === 'seat' && state.seat?.id === 'bar') { looked = true; lookToward({ position: KEEPER_SIDE.pos.clone().setY(1.2) }, 1.45); }
    if (!(await walk(deshu, pt, WALK, true)) || keeperOut !== ko || ko.phase !== 'walkOut') return false;
  }
  if (deshu.position.distanceTo(KEEPER_SIDE.pos) > 0.05) { keeperHome(); return false; } // 走不到（循路找不到路）：不硬坐上去，端回吧台
  deshu.userData.mesh.position.y = 0;
  // 坐上高腳椅：換成坐著的圖（D216：圖裡沒有椅子，臀部對到店裡那張的椅面，紙片疊在它前面）；店裡那張不收（D215）
  setArt(deshu, A.kevin('sit', 'stool'));
  HEAD.delete(deshu); // 泡泡與鏡頭照坐著的圖量頭在哪裡（站在吧台後面固定 2.0 公尺）
  scene.attach(cup);
  const from = cup.position.clone();
  await animate(0.7, (k) => { cup.position.lerpVectors(from, KEEPER_SIDE.cup, ease(k)); cup.position.y += Math.sin(Math.PI * k) * 0.05; });
  if (keeperOut !== ko) return false;
  if (kind === 'iced') cup.userData.age = 999; // 冰的不冒煙
  ko.phase = 'sit';
  return true;
}
// 喝完（或被叫回去）：站起來、端著杯子走回吧台裡他的位子。instant：換一天、重設時直接回到吧台（不演）
function keeperHome(instant = false) {
  const ko = keeperOut;
  if (!ko) return Promise.resolve();
  if (instant) {
    keeperOut = null;
    ko.cup.parent?.remove(ko.cup);
    deshu.userData.walkId = ++walkSeq; // 走到一半的那段停下來
    setArt(deshu, deshuCanvas.idle);
    HEAD.set(deshu, DESHU_HEAD);
    deshu.position.copy(HOME);
    deshu.userData.mesh.position.y = 0;
    if (deshuReturning === ko.done) deshuReturning = null;
    ko.resolve();
    return Promise.resolve();
  }
  if (ko.phase === 'walkBack') return ko.done;
  const seated = ko.phase === 'sit';
  ko.phase = 'walkBack';
  (async () => {
    if (seated) {
      if (ko.cup.userData.liquid) ko.cup.userData.liquid.visible = false; // 喝完了
      ko.cup.userData.age = 999;
      setArt(deshu, deshuCanvas.idle);
      HEAD.set(deshu, DESHU_HEAD);
      await wait(0.3);
    }
    if (keeperOut !== ko) return;
    deshu.attach(ko.cup);
    ko.cup.position.copy(KEEPER_HOLD);
    ko.cup.rotation.set(0, 0, 0);
    if (!(await walk(deshu, HOME, WALK, true)) || keeperOut !== ko) return; // 從他現在站的地方循路走回去（走出來走到一半也一樣）
    deshu.userData.mesh.position.y = 0;
    ko.cup.parent?.remove(ko.cup);
    keeperOut = null;
    if (deshuReturning === ko.done) deshuReturning = null;
    ko.resolve();
    updateUI();
    refreshDevTools();
  })();
  return ko.done;
}
// 坐著喝的這段：時間到、老闆離開吧台座、劇情／客人模式／打烊開始，就收杯回吧台
function keeperSitWatch(ko) {
  ko.until = performance.now() + KEEPER_SIT_MS / DEV_SPEED;
  realWaiters.push(() => {
    if (keeperOut !== ko || ko.phase !== 'sit') return true;
    const away = state.mode !== 'seat' || state.seat?.id !== 'bar' || state.scene || state.guest || state.closing || state.cinematic || state.placing || state.letter;
    if (!away && (performance.now() < ko.until || state.choice || state.favorite)) return false;
    if (!away) { say(FV.KEEPER_FAV.back, sayMs(FV.KEEPER_FAV.back) / DEV_SPEED, deshu); } // 喝完說一句再回去
    keeperHome();
    return true;
  });
}
// 德叔在吧台沖給熟客的那杯：和沖給老闆的同一套小動作（磨豆、注水），短一點；沖完由 serveTo() 端過去
async function brewForRegular() {
  if (deshuReturning) await deshuReturning;
  await deshuGo(HOME);
  const m = deshu.userData.mesh;
  const lean = (to, sec) => { const from = m.rotation.z; return animate(sec, (k) => { m.rotation.z = from + (to - from) * ease(k); }); };
  const steam = deshu.position.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(-0.15, 1.12, -0.03));
  setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.pour);
  audio.start('grind');
  await animate(1.8, (k) => { m.position.x = Math.sin(k * 60) * 0.006; });
  m.position.x = 0;
  audio.stop('grind');
  await lean(0.025, 0.6);
  audio.start('pour');
  steamSources.add(steam);
  await animate(2.6, (k) => { m.position.x = Math.sin(k * Math.PI * 4) * 0.012; });
  m.position.x = 0;
  audio.stop('pour');
  await lean(0, 0.5);
  steamSources.delete(steam);
  setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.idle);
}
// quiet：來訪段落結尾的第一杯，德叔剛回過話（「有。」「冰塊，最後才放。」），不再說「好，我沖一杯過去。」
async function serveFavorite(w, drink, { quiet: hush = false } = {}) {
  if (state.favorite) return null;
  state.favorite = w;
  bubble.classList.remove('show');
  updateUI();
  const self = w === 'kevin' && keeper(); // 吧台請凱文喝一杯：凱文替自己沖（D199），端出來坐在老闆旁邊喝（D200）
  const p = self ? deshu : PEOPLE[w], d = today(), snack = MN.withSnack(save);
  let r = null;
  try {
    const start = self ? FV.KEEPER_FAV.start : keeper() ? F.KEEPER.brewStart : FV.FAV_TEXT.start, ms0 = sayMs(start);
    if (!hush) say(start, ms0 / DEV_SPEED, deshu);
    await brewForRegular();
    if (self) {
      const sat = await keeperWalkOut(MN.ITEMS[drink]?.cup || 'hot', snack);
      if (sat) {
        await realWait(300);
        if (state.mode === 'seat') lookToward(deshu, 2.3);
        const t = FV.KEEPER_FAV.sit, m1 = sayMs(t);
        say(t, m1 / DEV_SPEED, deshu);
        await realWait(m1 + 300);
        // 喝一口：杯子從吧台上拿起來一下再放回去（坐著的圖沒有拿杯子的手，先用杯子的動作帶）
        const cup = keeperCup();
        if (cup && keeperOut?.phase === 'sit') await animate(1.1, (k) => { cup.position.y = KEEPER_SIDE.cup.y + Math.sin(Math.PI * k) * 0.12; cup.position.x = KEEPER_SIDE.cup.x - Math.sin(Math.PI * k) * 0.2; });
      }
    } else {
      await serveTo(w, MN.ITEMS[drink]?.cup || 'hot', snack);
      deshuReturning = deshuGo(HOME).finally(() => { deshuReturning = null; });
    }
    r = FV.serve(save, w, drink, d, now(), snack, self);
    persist();
    if (!r) return null;
    favLog.push({ ...r, drink, day: d, keeper: self });
    if (state.mode === 'seat') lookToward(p, 2.3);
    await realWait(700);
    const ms = sayMs(r.line);
    say(r.line, ms / DEV_SPEED, p);
    await realWait(ms + 450);
    if (r.right) {
      await glance(deshu, 1.0);
      await showPhoto(r.photo, { auto: true });
      if (r.first) { const t = FV.FAV_TEXT.firstPhoto, m2 = sayMs(t); say(t, m2 / DEV_SPEED, deshu); await realWait(m2 + 450); }
      // 找到最愛（第三段）：店裡暖一點（Q78，tasks.js 的 FAVORITE_TEMP）；德叔拿起老溫度計看一眼，不另外跳紙條
      if (r.favorite) { riseTemp(temperature(save)); deshuMoment('thermo', 2600); await realWait(1200); }
    } else if (r.hint) {
      await realWait(900);
      const m3 = sayMs(r.hint);
      say(r.hint, m3 / DEV_SPEED, deshu);
      await realWait(m3 + 450);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('請熟客的那杯中斷', e);
  } finally {
    state.favorite = null;
    moments.quietFrom = performance.now();
    readyAt = performance.now() + 3000 / DEV_SPEED;
    if (self && keeperOut?.phase === 'sit') keeperSitWatch(keeperOut); // 說完、照片淡回：再坐著喝一會兒才回吧台
    else if (self && keeperOut) keeperHome();
    updateUI();
    refreshDevTools();
  }
  return r;
}

// 照片：真的圖（assets/art/photo_<人>_<段>.webp）有就用，沒有就是程式畫的佔位圖
async function photoSrc(ph) { return (await A.photoUrl(ph.file)) || A.photoPlaceholder(ph.file, ph.caption, FV.PHOTO_PLACEHOLDER); }
const photoEl = $('photo'), photoSay = $('photo-say');
let photoDone = null, photoTimer = 0;
const PHOTO_HOLD_MS = 7000; // 淡入以後停多久（真實時間，不跟開發者倍率）
// auto：端對時那一刻（幾秒後自己淡回店裡，點一下也可以）；不然是相簿裡點縮圖（點「闔上」或照片外面回相簿）
async function showPhoto(id, { auto = false } = {}) {
  const ph = FV.photoById(id);
  if (!ph) return;
  closePhoto(true);
  const got = save.photos.find((x) => x.id === id);
  $('photo-img').src = await photoSrc(ph);
  $('photo-img').dataset.file = ph.file;
  $('photo-cap').innerHTML = `${esc(ph.caption)}${got ? `<small>${esc(FV.FAV_TEXT.day(got.day))}</small>` : ''}`;
  // 圖上不寫字，改由角色台詞說出來（承峰 11/4，D202）：照片淡入一下子之後，那位熟客說原本寫在照片裡的那一句（照片下方說話那一行，
  // 和泡泡同一個樣子、標名字）；相簿裡重看也一樣（重新淡入）。沒有這一句的照片不顯示
  photoSay.hidden = !ph.said;
  photoSay.innerHTML = ph.said ? `<b>${esc(favName(ph.who))}</b>${esc(ph.said)}` : '';
  photoSay.dataset.who = ph.said ? ph.who : '';
  $('photo-close').hidden = auto;
  photoEl.classList.remove('show');
  photoEl.dataset.mode = auto ? 'auto' : 'album';
  photoEl.hidden = false;
  void photoEl.offsetWidth; // 重新觸發淡入
  photoEl.classList.add('show');
  if (!auto) { $('photo-close').focus(); return; }
  await new Promise((resolve) => {
    photoDone = resolve;
    photoTimer = setTimeout(() => closePhoto(), PHOTO_HOLD_MS);
  });
}
function closePhoto(now = false) {
  clearTimeout(photoTimer);
  if (photoEl.hidden) return;
  const done = photoDone;
  photoDone = null;
  photoEl.classList.remove('show');
  const hide = () => { if (!photoEl.classList.contains('show')) photoEl.hidden = true; updateUI(); if (done) done(); };
  if (now) hide(); else setTimeout(hide, 1200); // 淡出（1.6 秒的 transition 走到一大半）之後才收起來
}
$('photo-close').textContent = FV.FAV_TEXT.close;
$('photo-close').onclick = () => closePhoto();
photoEl.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (photoEl.dataset.mode === 'auto' || e.target === photoEl) closePhoto(); });

// 人物誌頁（D209、D218）：和相簿同一個從下面拉起的面板。寫進去的段落照順序一段一段排（沒寫進去的不出現、不寫還有幾段）；
// 跟著回憶照片的段落放那張照片的縮圖（還沒畫的用「回憶等待觸發」的佔位圖，點了看大圖），指向信的段落放「重讀這封信」
let profileWho = '';
function openProfile(who) {
  PR.syncProfiles(save, today());
  if (!PR.pageOpen(save, who)) return false;
  openAbout(false);
  profileWho = who;
  sheetKind = 'profile';
  renderProfile(who);
  sheet.hidden = false;
  $('sheet-list').scrollTop = 0;
  $('sheet-close').focus();
  return true;
}
function renderProfile(who) {
  const page = PR.profilePage(save, who);
  const list = $('sheet-list');
  list.innerHTML = '';
  $('sheet-title').textContent = page.name;
  $('sheet-sub').textContent = PR.PROFILE_TEXT.sub;
  for (const seg of page.segs) {
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = 'profile-seg';
    el.dataset.n = seg.n;
    if (seg.photo) {
      const ph = FV.photoById(seg.photo);
      const b = document.createElement('button');
      b.className = 'album-slot profile-photo';
      b.dataset.id = seg.photo;
      b.setAttribute('aria-label', PR.PROFILE_TEXT.photo);
      const img = document.createElement('img');
      img.alt = '';
      photoSrc(ph).then((src) => { img.src = src; });
      b.appendChild(img);
      b.onclick = () => showPhoto(seg.photo);
      el.appendChild(b);
    }
    const txt = document.createElement('p');
    txt.innerHTML = `${seg.day ? `<small>${esc(PR.PROFILE_TEXT.day(seg.day))}</small>` : ''}${esc(seg.text)}`;
    el.appendChild(txt);
    const l = seg.letter === 'lawyer' ? LAWYER_LETTER : seg.letter ? letterById(seg.letter) : null;
    if (l) {
      const b = document.createElement('button');
      b.className = 'profile-letter';
      b.textContent = PR.PROFILE_TEXT.reread;
      b.onclick = () => { closeSheet(); openLetter(l); };
      el.appendChild(b);
    }
    list.appendChild(el);
  }
}

// 相簿：和菜單本、型錄同一個從下面拉起的面板。見過的熟客一列三格：拿到的照片是縮圖（點了看大圖），還沒拿到的是空格（Q77）
function renderAlbum() {
  const list = $('sheet-list');
  list.innerHTML = '';
  $('sheet-title').textContent = FV.FAV_TEXT.album;
  $('sheet-sub').textContent = FV.FAV_TEXT.albumSub;
  for (const page of FV.album(save)) {
    const h = document.createElement('h3');
    h.className = 'album-head';
    h.textContent = favName(page.who);
    if (PR.pageOpen(save, page.who)) { // 人物誌的入口（D209、D218）
      const go = document.createElement('button');
      go.className = 'album-profile';
      go.textContent = PR.PROFILE_TEXT.open;
      go.dataset.who = page.who;
      go.onclick = () => openProfile(page.who);
      h.appendChild(go);
    }
    list.appendChild(h);
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'album-row';
    row.dataset.who = page.who;
    const caps = document.createElement('div');
    caps.className = 'album-cap';
    for (const slot of page.slots) {
      const cap = document.createElement('span');
      let el;
      if (slot.got) {
        el = document.createElement('button');
        el.className = 'album-slot';
        el.setAttribute('aria-label', slot.caption);
        const img = document.createElement('img');
        img.alt = '';
        photoSrc(FV.photoById(slot.id)).then((src) => { img.src = src; });
        el.appendChild(img);
        el.onclick = () => showPhoto(slot.id);
        cap.innerHTML = `${esc(slot.caption)}<small>${esc(FV.FAV_TEXT.day(slot.got.day))}</small>`;
      } else {
        el = document.createElement('div'); // 空格：不是按鈕、不寫字（Q77）
        el.className = 'album-slot empty';
        el.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      }
      el.dataset.id = slot.id;
      row.appendChild(el);
      caps.appendChild(cap);
    }
    list.appendChild(row);
    list.appendChild(caps);
    if (page.favorite) {
      const f = document.createElement('p');
      f.className = 'album-fav';
      f.textContent = page.favorite;
      list.appendChild(f);
    }
  }
}


// 測試用：熟客這邊還有沒有事情要發生（正在演、還沒走進來、或有里程碑等著演）
// withGuest：德叔準備邀請老闆當一次客人，也算還有事（測試快轉天數時不會跳過）
function storyBusy(withGuest = true) {
  if (!REGULARS_ON || !live.day) return false;
  if (withGuest && !state.closing && !save.flags.guestVisit && H.guestDue(save, temperature(save), today())) return true;
  if (state.scene || state.letter || state.cinematic || live.walking > 0 || state.guest) return true;
  if (state.closing && state.closing !== 'after') return true;
  if ([...live.expect.values()].some((at) => at - performance.now() < 60000)) return true;
  const d = live.day;
  return [...live.arrived].some((w) => { const m = liveScene(w, d); return m && (!m.needSeat || state.mode === 'seat') && !!m.needClosing === (state.closing === 'after'); })
    || !!dueLetter(save, letterCtx()) || farewellReady(d) || !!state.arriving;
}

/* ---------- 第一站的結尾：徵店長與告別（src/farewell.js） ---------- */
// 溫度達 37°C 後，七段依序在老闆在場時發生，可以分幾天看完：
// 打烊後「店會自己呼吸了」→ 貼徵才啟事 →（隔天）凱文來面試 → 予安的告別 →（隔天）阿哲的告別 → 凱文的交接 →
// 打烊後的最後一晚（琺瑯杯、德叔第一次叫老闆的名字）→（隔天以後）離開東山的早上：第二封信 → 你的咖啡地圖 → 常態店（凱文顧店）
// 告別期間要演的那一段需要誰，那個人當天一定會來；凱文來面試那天，他是第一個走進門的人
function planFarewellDay(d, t) {
  if (!REGULARS_ON || !F.inFarewell(save)) return;
  const temp = temperature(save);
  for (const w of F.needsToday(save, d, temp)) {
    if (!live.expect.has(w) && !live.arrived.has(w)) live.expect.set(w, t + arrivalDelay(w, d));
  }
  const seg = F.segmentDue(save, d, temp);
  if (seg?.entrance) {
    // 凱文來面試：他自己走進來就是演出，予安、阿哲等他面試完再來
    live.expect.delete('kevin');
    for (const w of ['yuan', 'zhe']) if (live.expect.has(w)) { live.expect.set(w, Infinity); live.held.add(w); }
  }
}
// 這位熟客今天還有告別的戲（阿哲等到說完再走）
function farewellNeeds(w, d) {
  return REGULARS_ON && F.inFarewell(save) && F.needsToday(save, d, temperature(save)).has(w);
}
// 現在可以演的告別段落（不看店裡安不安靜）
function farewellSegment(d) {
  if (!REGULARS_ON || state.guest) return null;
  const seg = F.segmentDue(save, d, temperature(save));
  if (!seg) return null;
  const closingAfter = state.closing === 'after' && !!save.closing.lastCup;
  if (!!seg.needClosing !== closingAfter) return null;
  if (seg.who && !seg.entrance && !live.arrived.has(seg.who)) return null;
  return seg;
}
// 測試用：告別這邊還有事情要發生
const farewellReady = (d) => !!farewellSegment(d) || F.departureDue(save, d);
function farewellTick(d) {
  const seg = F.segmentDue(save, d, temperature(save));
  if (!seg || !REGULARS_ON || state.guest) return false;
  // 要打烊才演的段落：還沒打烊時德叔提一次（每天一次）
  if (seg.needClosing && !state.closing && live.fwHinted !== seg.n) { live.fwHinted = seg.n; say(seg.hint, 4800); return false; }
  if (seg.lastNight && state.closing === 'after' && !PEOPLE.kevin.visible) { placeAt('kevin', SPOT.kevin, 'free'); live.arrived.add('kevin'); } // 最後一晚，凱文留下來
  if (seg.entrance && PEOPLE.kevin.visible) { PEOPLE.kevin.visible = false; live.arrived.delete('kevin'); } // 面試那天中途重新整理：從門口重新走進來
  if (!farewellSegment(d)) return false;
  runFarewell(seg);
  return true;
}
// 演一段告別；演完才記進存檔（中途重新整理就從這一段重新演）
async function runFarewell(seg) {
  const tok = ++live.token;
  state.scene = { id: 'farewell' + seg.n, farewell: seg.n };
  bubble.classList.remove('show');
  updateUI();
  try {
    await playSteps(seg.scene, tok);
    if (!behindBar(deshu.position) || deshu.position.distanceTo(HOME) > 0.05) await deshuGo(HOME);
  } catch (e) {
    if (e !== ABORT) console.warn('告別的場景中斷', e);
    if (tok !== live.token) return;
  }
  const d = today();
  F.complete(save, seg.n, d);
  if (seg.gift) glowFund(); // 送的東西收進倉庫：佈置鈕輕輕亮一下
  refreshNotice();
  if (seg.n === 3) { // 面試完了：予安、阿哲照常走進來
    const t = performance.now();
    let k = 0;
    for (const w of live.held) live.expect.set(w, t + (6000 + 6000 * k++) / DEV_SPEED);
    live.held.clear();
  }
  if (seg.n === 5) live.leaveAt.set('zhe', performance.now() + 90000 / DEV_SPEED);
  persist();
  state.scene = null;
  updateUI();
  refreshDevTools();
  // 下一段如果是緊接著的（貼啟事）就短一點；其他段落之間留一段安靜的時間
  readyAt = performance.now() + (F.segment(seg.n + 1)?.chain ? 2500 : 12000) / DEV_SPEED;
}
// 第 2 段：貼出徵才啟事（老闆選的那句），德叔拿到門口貼好
async function postNotice() {
  const n = F.postNotice(save, live.answers.notice ?? save.story.answers.notice ?? 0);
  persist();
  await new Promise((r) => openLetter({ title: '徵才啟事', paragraphs: [n.text], hand: true }, r));
  await deshuGo(V2(0.6, 3.15));
  setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.pour);
  setArt(noticeSign, A.noticeBoard(n.text));
  noticeDrawn = n.text;
  noticeSign.visible = true;
  await wait(0.9);
  setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.idle);
  lookToward(noticeSign);
}
// 第 6 段：德叔把吧台的鑰匙交給凱文
async function handKeys(w) {
  const k = paper(A.key(), deshu.position.x, deshu.position.z, { y: 1.05, shadow: false });
  k.userData.mesh.scale.setScalar(1.6);
  k.userData.squash = 1.6;
  const from = deshu.position.clone(), to = PEOPLE[w].position.clone();
  setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.pour);
  await animate(1.1, (t) => {
    k.position.lerpVectors(from, to, ease(t));
    k.userData.mesh.position.y = 1.05 - 0.3 * ease(t) + Math.sin(Math.PI * t) * 0.08;
  });
  setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.idle);
  realWait(5000).then(() => removePaper(k));
}

// 離開東山的早上：凱文繫著圍裙站在吧台前，德叔說一句，接著交第二封信（letters.js，由交信的計時器處理）
function departureMorning() {
  if (state.night && state.weather !== 'typhoon') { state.night = false; applyLight(); }
  if (REGULARS_ON) { placeAt('kevin', SPOT.bar, 'apron'); live.arrived.add('kevin'); }
  say(F.DEPART.greet, 3600);
  readyAt = performance.now() + 4500 / DEV_SPEED;
}
// 讀完第二封信：凱文送行、德叔說「走吧。」，畫面暗下來，打開你的咖啡地圖；這時店轉為常態經營
async function departScene() {
  F.depart(save, now());
  persist();
  const tok = ++live.token;
  state.scene = { id: 'depart' };
  updateUI();
  try {
    await realWait(1200);
    await playSteps(F.DEPART.after.filter((s) => REGULARS_ON || s.who !== 'kevin'), tok);
  } catch (e) { if (e !== ABORT) console.warn('出發的場景中斷', e); }
  await fade(true);
  if (state.seat) stand();
  becomeKeeper();
  state.scene = null;
  showMap('end');
  fadeEl.classList.remove('on');
  updateUI();
}
// 常態店：吧台後面換成凱文（沖煮、端杯、打烊後擦杯子的演出都照用德叔的那一套）
function becomeKeeper() {
  keeperHome(true);
  for (const k of DESHU_POSES) deshuCanvas[k] = A.kevinBar(k);
  for (const k of ['a', 'b']) { wipeTex[k]?.dispose(); wipeTex[k] = null; }
  setArt(deshu, deshuCanvas.idle);
  deshu.position.copy(HOME);
  syncBrewKit(); // 凱文的圖沒有手沖器具：吧台上的立體器具拿出來
  NAMES.set(deshu, F.KEEPER.name);
  kevin.visible = false;
  live.arrived.delete('kevin');
  live.expect.delete('kevin');
}
// 回東山坐坐：從門口推門進來，凱文打招呼（第一次是「老闆，歡迎回來。……德叔說，要這樣講。」）
async function keeperArrive() {
  state.arriving = true;
  updateUI();
  state.seat = null; // 坐過的椅子本來就擺著（D215）
  state.mode = 'door';
  frontWall.visible = false;
  ceiling.visible = true;
  cam.yaw = 0; cam.pitch = 0;
  tween = null;
  cam.pos.copy(DOOR.from); cam.look.copy(DOOR.look);
  moveCamera(DOOR.to, DOOR.look, 2.6);
  audio.play('door'); audio.play('bell');
  await realWait(1700);
  const f = F.fw(save);
  const lines = f.keeperGreeted ? [F.KEEPER.greet[Math.floor(Math.random() * F.KEEPER.greet.length)]] : F.KEEPER.firstGreet;
  f.keeperGreeted = true;
  persist();
  for (const l of lines) { const ms = sayMs(l); say(l, ms / DEV_SPEED); await realWait(ms + 300); }
  state.mode = 'overview';
  ceiling.visible = false;
  moveCamera(OVER.pos, OVER.look, 1.6);
  state.arriving = false;
  readyAt = performance.now() + 4000 / DEV_SPEED;
  updateUI();
  checkTasks({ delay: 1200 });
  startDay();
}
// 你的咖啡地圖：mode 'end'（第一站結尾，按鈕「回東山坐坐」）或 'notebook'（從記事本打開，按鈕「闔上」）
const mapEl = $('map');
let mapMode = null;
function showMap(mode) {
  mapMode = mode;
  // art2b：手繪地圖是 SVG（標記由程式畫），沒有載到是 Canvas；第一次打開才做，之後沿用
  if (!$('map-wrap').firstElementChild) $('map-wrap').appendChild(A.coffeeMap('台灣地圖：台南東山亮著一盞燈，花蓮舞鶴待續'));
  $('map-title').textContent = F.MAP.title;
  $('map-sub').textContent = F.MAP.sub;
  $('map-line').textContent = F.MAP.line;
  const list = $('map-list');
  list.innerHTML = '';
  for (const st of F.MAP.stations) {
    const li = document.createElement('li');
    li.className = st.lit ? 'lit' : '';
    li.innerHTML = `<b>${st.name}</b><span>${st.note}</span>`;
    list.appendChild(li);
  }
  $('map-back').textContent = mode === 'end' ? F.MAP.back : F.MAP.close;
  mapEl.hidden = false;
  $('map-back').focus();
}
function closeMap() {
  mapEl.hidden = true;
  const mode = mapMode;
  mapMode = null;
  if (mode !== 'end') { updateUI(); return; }
  F.fw(save).mapSeen = true;
  persist();
  keeperArrive();
}
$('map-back').onclick = closeMap;

// 開發者工具：直接到告別前（36.5°C）。三條線全部走完、溫度任務只留一個 +0.5°C 的（通常是「擺上第一件擺飾」）
function devToFarewell() {
  stopStory();
  stopGuest();
  exitClosing();
  const d = today();
  const typhoon = save.story.typhoonDay;
  // 收進菜單本的東西當作德叔提過了（直接跳到告別前，不要一進店就連說好幾句）
  for (const m of S.MILESTONES) if (!S.hasMilestone(save, m.who, m.n)) for (const g of S.complete(save, m, d)) MN.markTold(save, g.id);
  if (!typhoon || typhoon === d) save.story.typhoonDay = Math.max(1, d - 4); // 颱風夜不要變成今天
  for (const w of S.REGULAR_IDS) { const r = save.regulars[w]; r.visits = Math.max(r.visits, 10); r.lastMilestoneDay = d - 1; r.settled = Math.max(r.settled, d - 1); }
  save.flags.guestVisit = true;
  const left = ['first-decor', 'cat-chair', 'rain-window', 'first-coffee', 'open-3-days', 'zhe-longan'].find((id) => !isDone(save, id) && !taskById(id).when(save, { daysOpen: d }));
  for (const t of TASKS) {
    if (isDone(save, t.id) || t.id === left) continue;
    save.tasks.push({ id: t.id, t: now(), day: d });
    save.fund.ledger.push({ t: now(), kind: 'grant', ref: t.id, amount: t.fund });
  }
  persist();
  riseTemp(temperature(save));
  drawBackBar();
  refreshWeather();
  refreshDevTools();
  openAbout(false);
  readyAt = performance.now() + 3000 / DEV_SPEED;
  startDay();
}
$('dev-fw').onclick = devToFarewell;
$('dev-menu').onclick = () => { devUnlockMenu(); persist(); openAbout(false); openSheet('menu'); };

/* ---------- 聲音與音樂（src/audio.js：WebAudio 即時合成，不用音檔；預設音量小，選單裡可以分別關掉） ---------- */
// 音樂只在店裡（開場的辦公室沒有音樂，推門進店才開始）；打烊後換成更慢、更暗的版本；「明天見」之後安靜下來
const audioScene = () => ({
  music: !!save.settings.music,
  sfx: !!save.settings.sound,
  volume: save.settings.volume,
  weather: state.weather,
  night: state.night,
  closingStyle: !!state.closing || state.night,
  vinyl: [...decorPapers.values()].some((d) => d.userData.item.id === 'record-player'),
  inShop: (!openingCtl || openingCtl.stage === 'shop') && (save.flags.seenOpening || !!openingCtl) && $('closed').hidden,
  office: openingCtl?.stage === 'office',
});
let audioKey = '';
function applySound() {
  const sc = audioScene();
  const k = JSON.stringify(sc);
  if (k === audioKey) return;
  audioKey = k;
  audio.set(sc);
}
// 瀏覽器要等玩家點過畫面才能出聲
const unlockAudio = () => { applySound(); audio.unlock(); };
window.addEventListener('pointerdown', unlockAudio, { passive: true });
window.addEventListener('keydown', unlockAudio);
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') audio.pause(); else audio.resume(); });
function refreshWeather() {
  const w = weatherToday();
  if (w === state.weather) return;
  if (state.weather === 'typhoon') state.night = false;
  state.weather = w;
  if (w === 'typhoon') state.night = true;
  applyLight();
  applySound();
}
const onOff = (v) => (v ? '開' : '關');
function soundLabels() {
  $('music-toggle').textContent = `音樂：${onOff(save.settings.music)}`;
  $('sound-toggle').textContent = `店裡的聲音：${onOff(save.settings.sound)}`;
  $('volume-btn').textContent = `音量：${VOLUME_NAMES[save.settings.volume] || VOLUME_NAMES[0]}`;
}
soundLabels();
$('music-toggle').onclick = () => { save.settings.music = !save.settings.music; persist(); soundLabels(); applySound(); };
$('sound-toggle').onclick = () => { save.settings.sound = !save.settings.sound; persist(); soundLabels(); applySound(); };
$('volume-btn').onclick = () => {
  save.settings.volume = ((Number(save.settings.volume) || 0) + 1) % VOLUMES.length;
  persist();
  soundLabels();
  applySound();
  audio.play('cup'); // 聽一下現在多大聲
};

/* ---------- 打烊後模式（src/afterhours.js） ---------- */
// 老闆按「打烊」：客人離開、德叔去門口翻牌子、天色轉成夜裡 → 坐下，德叔沖「最後一杯，是老闆的」→
// 打烊後：燈一盞一盞由老闆自己關、可以整理擺飾、摸龍眼、寫「今天的一杯」；德叔在吧台擦那個琺瑯杯。沒有任何任務提示。
// state.closing：'leaving'（客人離開）→ 'lastcup'（等老闆坐下、沖最後一杯）→ 'after'（打烊後）
let closeTok = 0;
const lightOn = (id) => !id || !state.closing || !save.closing.lightsOff.includes(id);
const canClose = () => save.flags.seenOpening && !state.closing && !state.tutorial && !state.scene && !state.letter && !state.cinematic
  && !state.choice && !state.guest && !brewing && !deshuReturning && !state.placing && !state.arriving && !F.departureDue(save, today());
// 誤按打烊（承峰 11/5：「誤按打烊照建議修：德叔先問一次加連點保護」，D205）：
// 1. 連點保護：底部按鈕列換了內容（佈置按「確定」、坐著按「站起來」、選項收起來……）之後 ROW_GUARD_MS 內不接受打烊（含觸控連點）；
// 2. 按下去德叔先問一次（choose()），「再坐一會兒」放最下面：連點的第二下落在選項列最下面那一格，也不會打烊。
// 不動存檔、熟客排程、照片、溫度：選「再坐一會兒」什麼都沒發生
const ROW_GUARD_MS = 500;
let rowSig = '', rowAt = 0;
function markRow() {
  const sig = [...document.querySelectorAll('.bottom .row > button')].filter((b) => !b.hidden).map((b) => b.id).join(',') + (state.choice ? '|choice' : '');
  if (sig !== rowSig) { rowSig = sig; rowAt = performance.now(); }
}
const rowSettled = () => performance.now() - rowAt >= ROW_GUARD_MS;

async function startClosingMode() {
  if (!canClose() || !rowSettled()) return;
  const pick = await choose(H.CLOSING.confirm, H.CLOSING.confirmAsk, keeper() ? '凱文' : '德叔');
  if (pick !== 0) { say(H.CLOSING.confirmStay, 2400); return; }
  if (!canClose()) return; // 問的時候有人推門進來、劇情開始……：這次不打烊
  const tok = ++closeTok;
  const d = today();
  H.startClosing(save, d);
  persist();
  state.closing = 'leaving';
  live.expect.clear(); // 打烊之後不會再有熟客走進來
  bubble.classList.remove('show');
  updateUI();
  say(H.CLOSING.start, 3400);
  // 予安有稿子想念的那天，她留下來；颱風夜，阿哲待在店裡
  const stay = new Set();
  if (REGULARS_ON && liveScene('yuan', d)?.needClosing && live.arrived.has('yuan')) stay.add('yuan');
  if (save.story.typhoonDay === d) stay.add('zhe');
  if (REGULARS_ON && F.segmentDue(save, d)?.lastNight) stay.add('kevin'); // 告別的最後一晚：凱文留下來
  const going = PEOPLE_IDS.filter((w) => PEOPLE[w].visible && !stay.has(w));
  await Promise.all([...going.map((w) => leavePerson(w)), (async () => { await realWait(1200); await deshuGo(V2(0.45, 3.2)); await glance(deshu, 0.6); })()]);
  if (tok !== closeTok) return;
  state.night = true;
  applyLight();
  buildLightLabels();
  await deshuGo(HOME);
  if (tok !== closeTok) return;
  enterLastCup();
}
function enterLastCup() {
  state.closing = 'lastcup';
  updateUI();
  if (state.mode === 'seat' && state.seat) lastCup(state.seat);
  else say(H.CLOSING.sitDown, 4200);
}
// 最後一杯：黑板上喝的東西有兩樣以上時先選；沖好端上桌時德叔說「最後一杯，是老闆的。」
async function lastCup(seat) {
  if (state.closing !== 'lastcup' || brewing || state.choice) return;
  const drinks = MN.boardDrinks(save, boardShift);
  let bean = drinks[0];
  const ask = drinks.every((id) => MN.ITEMS[id].kind === 'coffee') ? H.CLOSING.chooseBean : MN.ASK.lastDrink;
  if (drinks.length > 1) bean = drinks[await choose(drinks.map((id) => MN.ITEMS[id].name), ask, keeper() ? '凱文' : '德叔')];
  if (state.closing !== 'lastcup' || brewing || state.seat !== seat) return;
  // 告別的最後一晚：德叔用那個琺瑯杯沖（劇本：第一次放在玩家面前）
  brew(seat, bean, { last: true, enamel: REGULARS_ON && !!F.segmentDue(save, today())?.lastNight });
}
function afterLastCup(bean) {
  save.closing.lastCup = true;
  save.closing.bean = bean;
  persist();
  state.closing = 'after';
  buildLightLabels();
  updateUI();
  readyAt = performance.now() + 5000 / DEV_SPEED;
}
// 打烊之後重新整理（同一天）：店還是打烊的樣子
function resumeClosing() {
  state.closing = save.closing.lastCup ? 'after' : 'lastcup';
  state.night = true;
  applyLight();
  buildLightLabels();
}
// 換了一天（開發者跳天數）：店重新開門
function exitClosing() {
  if (!state.closing) return;
  closeTok++;
  state.closing = null;
  state.night = state.weather === 'typhoon' || afterWork();
  $('closed').hidden = true;
  $('diary').hidden = true;
  applyLight();
  buildLightLabels();
  updateUI();
}
// 「明天見」：德叔說一句，畫面暗下來（關掉也沒關係；「再待一下」回到打烊後的店裡）
async function goodnight() {
  const tok = closeTok;
  save.closing.done = true;
  persist();
  state.closing = 'bye';
  updateUI();
  say(H.CLOSING.goodnight, 2600);
  await realWait(2400);
  if (tok !== closeTok) return;
  const entry = H.diaryOn(save, today());
  $('cl-title').textContent = H.CLOSING.endTitle;
  $('cl-sub').textContent = H.CLOSING.endSub;
  $('cl-date').textContent = `${dateLabel(now())}・開店第 ${today()} 天`;
  $('cl-diary').textContent = entry ? `今天的一杯：「${entry.text}」` : '';
  $('cl-diary').hidden = !entry;
  $('closed').hidden = false;
  $('cl-stay').focus();
}
$('close-shop').onclick = startClosingMode;
$('goodnight').onclick = goodnight;
$('cl-stay').onclick = () => { $('closed').hidden = true; state.closing = 'after'; updateUI(); };

// 燈：吊燈兩盞（p0、p1）與店裡的落地燈（l<uid>）。打烊後每盞燈旁邊有一顆「關燈／開燈」
let lightLabels = [];
function lightList() {
  const out = pendants.map((p, i) => ({ id: 'p' + i, pos: p.pos.clone().setY(2.75) }));
  for (const p of decorPapers.values()) if (p.userData.lightId) out.push({ id: p.userData.lightId, pos: p.position.clone().setY(1.55) });
  return out;
}
function buildLightLabels() {
  lightsEl.innerHTML = '';
  lightLabels = [];
  if (!state.closing) return;
  for (const l of lightList()) {
    const b = document.createElement('button');
    b.className = 'light-label';
    if (ICONS) { b.innerHTML = iconSvg('light') + '<span class="lbl"></span>'; b.classList.add('has-icon'); }
    b.dataset.light = l.id;
    b.onclick = () => {
      H.toggleLight(save, l.id);
      audio.play('click');
      persist();
      applyLamps();
      refreshLightLabels();
    };
    lightsEl.appendChild(b);
    lightLabels.push({ ...l, el: b });
  }
  refreshLightLabels();
}
// 底部按鈕列的那一顆：還有亮著的燈就「關燈」（關掉下一盞），全關了就「開燈」（打開一盞）
function lightsBtnNext() {
  const all = lightList();
  return all.find((l) => lightOn(l.id)) || all[0];
}
$('lights-btn').onclick = () => {
  const l = lightsBtnNext();
  if (!l) return;
  H.toggleLight(save, l.id);
  audio.play('click');
  persist();
  applyLamps();
  refreshLightLabels();
};
function refreshLightLabels() {
  const lb = $('lights-btn'), anyOn = lightList().some((l) => lightOn(l.id));
  setLabel(lb, anyOn ? '關燈' : '開燈');
  lb.setAttribute('aria-label', anyOn ? '關一盞燈' : '開一盞燈');
  for (const l of lightLabels) {
    const on = lightOn(l.id);
    setLabel(l.el, on ? '關燈' : '開燈');
    l.el.classList.toggle('off', !on);
    l.el.setAttribute('aria-label', `${l.id.startsWith('p') ? '吊燈' : '落地燈'}：${on ? '關燈' : '開燈'}`);
  }
}
// 每一幀：吊燈的亮度慢慢跟上開關；打烊後，關掉的燈越多，店裡越接近窗外的月光
const SEAT_LAMP = 3;
const SHADE_ON = new THREE.Color('#ffd59a'), SHADE_OFF = new THREE.Color('#4a3d30');
const MOON = new THREE.Color('#7483ad'), WARM_NIGHT = new THREE.Color('#a594b0');
let closeGlow = 1;
function updateLights(dt) {
  const k = Math.min(1, dt * 5);
  pendants.forEach((p, i) => {
    p.level += ((lightOn('p' + i) ? 1 : 0) - p.level) * k;
    let I = (state.night ? 9 : 3) * p.level;
    if (state.weather === 'typhoon' && state.night && Math.random() < 0.004) I = 2 * p.level; // 颱風夜吊燈偶爾閃一下
    p.light.intensity = I;
    if (p.shade.material.emissiveMap) p.shade.material.emissiveIntensity = 0.7 * p.level; // 手繪的吊燈：關掉時燈罩不再發亮
    else p.shade.material.color.copy(SHADE_OFF).lerp(SHADE_ON, p.level);
  });
  const avg = pendants.reduce((a, p) => a + p.level, 0) / pendants.length;
  barFill.intensity = state.night ? 2.2 * avg : 0;
  const tb = state.mode === 'seat' ? state.seat?.table : null;
  if (tb) seatLamp.position.set(tb.x, tb.h + 0.8, tb.z);
  seatLamp.intensity += ((tb ? SEAT_LAMP * avg : 0) - seatLamp.intensity) * Math.min(1, dt * 2);
  if (!state.closing) { closeGlow = 1; return; }
  const all = lightList();
  const on = all.length ? all.filter((l) => lightOn(l.id)).length / all.length : 1;
  closeGlow += (on - closeGlow) * Math.min(1, dt * 3);
  if (flash <= 0) {
    hemi.intensity = 0.75 + 0.15 * closeGlow; // 全關也看得到店裡：月光從窗戶進來
    hemi.color.copy(MOON).lerp(WARM_NIGHT, closeGlow);
  }
}

// 打烊後，德叔在吧台擦那個琺瑯杯（劇本：打烊後會擦一個舊的琺瑯杯，從不讓別人用）
const wipeTex = { a: null, b: null, keep: null };
let wipeOn = false, wipeT = 0;
function updateWipe(dt) {
  const mat = deshu.userData.mesh.material;
  const want = state.closing === 'after' && !state.scene && !state.cinematic && !state.letter && !brewing && !deshuReturning
    && !cups.some((c) => c.userData.enamel) // 最後一晚，琺瑯杯在老闆桌上
    && !live.deshuWalk && deshu.position.distanceTo(HOME) < 0.05;
  if (want) {
    if (!wipeOn) {
      wipeOn = true;
      wipeTex.a ??= A.tex(deshuCanvas.wipe);
      wipeTex.b ??= A.tex(deshuCanvas.wipe2);
      wipeTex.keep = mat.map;
      wipeT = 0;
    }
    wipeT += dt;
    const map = Math.floor(wipeT / 0.7) % 2 ? wipeTex.b : wipeTex.a;
    if (mat.map !== map) { mat.map = map; if (mat.emissiveMap) mat.emissiveMap = map; mat.needsUpdate = true; }
  } else if (wipeOn) {
    wipeOn = false;
    if (mat.map === wipeTex.a || mat.map === wipeTex.b) { mat.map = wipeTex.keep; if (mat.emissiveMap) mat.emissiveMap = mat.map; mat.needsUpdate = true; }
    else wipeTex.keep?.dispose(); // 別的動作已經換過圖了
    wipeTex.keep = null;
  }
}

/* ---------- 「今天的一杯」咖啡日記 ---------- */
const diaryEl = $('diary');
function openDiary(mode) {
  const write = mode === 'write';
  $('dy-write').hidden = !write;
  $('dy-read').hidden = write;
  $('dy-close').hidden = write;
  $('dy-title').textContent = write ? H.DIARY.title : '今天的一杯・咖啡日記';
  if (write) {
    const bean = S.MENU[save.closing.bean || 'dongshan']?.name || '東山的豆';
    $('dy-sub').textContent = `${dateLabel(now())}・開店第 ${today()} 天・${bean}`;
    const t = $('dy-text');
    t.value = H.diaryOn(save, today())?.text || '';
    t.placeholder = H.DIARY.placeholder;
    t.maxLength = H.DIARY_MAX;
    diaryCount();
  } else {
    $('dy-sub').textContent = `一共 ${save.diary.length} 杯。`;
    const body = $('dy-read');
    body.innerHTML = '';
    for (const e of [...save.diary].reverse()) {
      const h = document.createElement('h3');
      h.className = 'jr-day';
      h.textContent = `${dateLabel(e.t)}・第 ${e.day} 天・${S.MENU[e.bean]?.name || '東山的豆'}`;
      const p = document.createElement('p');
      p.className = 'dy-entry';
      p.textContent = e.text;
      body.append(h, p);
    }
    body.scrollTop = 0;
  }
  diaryEl.hidden = false;
  if (write) setTimeout(() => $('dy-text').focus(), 50); else $('dy-close').focus();
}
// 手機鍵盤：iOS 與新版 Android Chrome 打開鍵盤時只縮小 visualViewport，版面不動，置中的日記卡片會被鍵盤蓋住。
// 量出鍵盤擋住的高度，讓卡片往上移（Android 另有 viewport 的 interactive-widget=resizes-content）
if (window.visualViewport) {
  const vv = window.visualViewport;
  const onVV = () => {
    const kb = Math.max(0, window.innerHeight - vv.height - vv.offsetTop);
    app.style.setProperty('--kb', `${Math.round(kb)}px`);
    app.classList.toggle('kb', kb > 80);
  };
  vv.addEventListener('resize', onVV);
  vv.addEventListener('scroll', onVV);
}
function diaryCount() { $('dy-count').textContent = `${[...$('dy-text').value].length}／${H.DIARY_MAX}`; }
function closeDiary() { diaryEl.hidden = true; $('dy-text').blur(); updateUI(); }
$('dy-text').addEventListener('input', diaryCount);
$('dy-save').onclick = () => {
  H.writeDiary(save, { day: today(), t: now(), bean: save.closing.bean, text: $('dy-text').value });
  persist();
  closeDiary();
};
$('dy-cancel').onclick = closeDiary;
$('dy-close').onclick = closeDiary;
$('diary-btn').onclick = () => openDiary('write');
diaryEl.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (e.target === diaryEl) closeDiary(); });

/* ---------- 一次客人模式（溫度任務 #17） ---------- */
// 溫度 ≥ 28°C 後的某次進店，等店裡安靜下來，德叔問老闆要不要從門口進來一次（決定 D9）。
// 推門進店 → 「歡迎。不急，先坐。」→ 坐下 → 德叔過來點單 → 沖好端上 → 聽兩位熟客聊這間店（依擺飾）→ 德叔小聲說兩句
// state.guest：'offer' → 'enter' → 'sit' → 'order' → 'brew' → 'talk'
const DEV_GUEST = DEV && params.get('guest') === '1'; // 測試用：不看溫度，直接邀請
let guestTok = 0;
let guestPair = null;
function guestReady() {
  if (state.closing || state.guest || !quiet() || dueLetter(save, letterCtx())) return false;
  if (REGULARS_ON && storyBusy(false)) return false;
  if (performance.now() < readyAt + 3000 / DEV_SPEED) return false;
  return DEV_GUEST ? !save.flags.guestVisit && save.flags.guestOffered !== today() : H.guestDue(save, temperature(save), today());
}
setInterval(() => { if (guestReady()) offerGuest(); }, 1000);

async function offerGuest() {
  const tok = ++guestTok;
  save.flags.guestOffered = today();
  persist();
  state.guest = 'offer';
  updateUI();
  say(H.GUEST.invite, 0);
  const i = await choose([H.GUEST.yes, H.GUEST.no]);
  if (tok !== guestTok) return;
  if (i === 1) {
    state.guest = null;
    updateUI();
    say(H.GUEST.later, 3000);
    readyAt = performance.now() + 4000 / DEV_SPEED;
    return;
  }
  bubble.classList.remove('show');
  guestEnter(tok);
}
const fadeEl = $('fade');
function fade(on) {
  fadeEl.classList.toggle('on', on);
  return realWait(850);
}
// 誰在聊天：見過的熟客裡挑兩位（予安在的話一定有她）
function pickGuestPair() {
  const met = S.REGULAR_IDS.filter((w) => S.hasMilestone(save, w, 1));
  const pool = met.length >= 2 ? met : ['yuan', 'zhe'];
  const a = pool.includes('yuan') ? 'yuan' : pool[0];
  const rest = pool.filter((w) => w !== a);
  const b = rest[Math.floor(((today() * 7) % 10) / 10 * rest.length)] || rest[0];
  return [a, b];
}
async function guestEnter(tok) {
  state.guest = 'enter';
  updateUI();
  await fade(true);
  if (tok !== guestTok) return;
  // 鏡頭退到門外；兩位熟客在店裡（予安在她的桌子，另一位站在桌子另一邊），龍眼睡在他的地方
  state.seat = null; // 坐過的椅子本來就擺著（D215）
  state.closeup = false;
  guestPair = pickGuestPair();
  const d = today();
  const [a, b] = guestPair;
  const beside = { pos: V2(-1.0, -2.05), cup: null }; // 三個座位都看得到、不會擋住予安
  const spots = a === 'yuan' ? { [a]: SPOT.yuan, [b]: beside } : { [a]: SPOT.bar, [b]: b === 'kevin' ? SPOT.kevin : beside };
  for (const w of guestPair) {
    if (REGULARS_ON) { S.arrive(save, w, d); live.arrived.add(w); live.expect.delete(w); live.leaveAt.delete(w); }
    placeAt(w, spots[w], spots[w] === beside ? (w === 'kevin' ? 'walk' : 'stand') : undefined);
  }
  persist();
  deshu.position.copy(HOME);
  state.mode = 'door';
  frontWall.visible = false;
  ceiling.visible = true;
  cam.yaw = 0; cam.pitch = 0;
  tween = null;
  cam.pos.copy(DOOR.from); cam.look.copy(DOOR.look);
  await fade(false);
  if (tok !== guestTok) return;
  moveCamera(DOOR.to, DOOR.look, 2.6); // 推門進去
  audio.play('door'); audio.play('bell');
  await realWait(1700);
  say(H.GUEST.welcome, 3800);
  await realWait(2400);
  if (tok !== guestTok) return;
  // 回到俯瞰，挑一個位子（從門口看，座位在身後或被吧台擋住）
  state.mode = 'overview';
  ceiling.visible = false;
  moveCamera(OVER.pos, OVER.look, 1.6);
  state.guest = 'sit';
  updateUI();
}
// 德叔點單、收杯子時站的地方：離座位一步遠，坐著看得到他（太近會整個人擋住畫面）
const ORDER_SPOT = { window: V2(-0.95, -1.35), bar: V2(2.5, -1.0), sofa: V2(-0.55, 1.8) };
// 坐下之後，德叔走過來點單
