// 凱文顧店時，坐吧台座點他偶爾說的線索（他那一段開放時；沒有開放是空陣列）
export const keeperClueLines = (save) => (isOpen(save, 'kevin') ? KEEPER_FAV.clue[current(save, 'kevin').n - 1] : []);
export function keeperHintOf(save) {
  const s = current(save, 'kevin');
  if (!s) return '';
  const h = KEEPER_FAV.hint[s.n - 1];
  return typeof h === 'function' ? h(nameOf(lastBeanOf(save))) : h;
}

// 照片還沒畫時，程式畫的佔位圖上的字（承峰 11/4：「照片待畫」改成「回憶等待觸發」，D198）
export const PHOTO_PLACEHOLDER = '回憶等待觸發';

// 照片：一段一張（D192：只用一張圖加程式動態）。file 是 assets/art/ 裡的檔名（不含 .webp），還沒有圖時用程式畫的佔位圖
// 圖裡不放任何文字（D202）；said 是照片淡入時那位熟客說的一句（沒有就是空字串），相簿裡重看也一樣
export const PHOTOS = FAV_IDS.flatMap((who) => STAGES[who].map((s) => ({ id: `${who}-${s.n}`, who, n: s.n, file: `photo_${who}_${s.n}`, caption: s.caption, said: s.said || '', favorite: !!s.favorite })));
export const photoById = (id) => PHOTOS.find((p) => p.id === id) || null;

export const blankFavorite = () => ({ stage: 0, misses: 0, servedDay: 0, told: 0 });
export function blankFavorites() { return { yuan: blankFavorite(), zhe: blankFavorite(), kevin: blankFavorite() }; }

const favOf = (save, who) => save.favorites?.[who] || null;
const hasMilestone = (save, who, n) => (save.regulars?.[who]?.milestones || []).includes(n);
// 現在要找的那一段（三段都找到了是 null）
export function current(save, who) {
  const f = favOf(save, who);
  if (!f) return null;
  return STAGES[who]?.[f.stage] || null;
}
// 這一段開放了沒：跟著的里程碑發生了（照順序，一次只有一段）
export function isOpen(save, who) {
  const s = current(save, who);
  return !!s && hasMilestone(save, who, s.after);
}
// 今天可以請德叔端一杯給他嗎（一天一杯；呼叫端另外判斷人在不在店裡、有沒有在演出）
export const canServe = (save, who, day) => isOpen(save, who) && favOf(save, who).servedDay !== day;

// 老闆最近一次喝的那杯：請德叔沖一杯、最後一杯、客人模式都記在 stats.lastBean；沒有就看咖啡日記、最後一杯，再沒有就是東山的豆
export function lastBeanOf(save) {
  const ok = (id) => !!id && M.isDrink(id);
  if (ok(save.stats?.lastBean)) return save.stats.lastBean;
  const d = [...(save.diary || [])].reverse().find((e) => ok(e.bean));
  if (d) return d.bean;
  if (ok(save.closing?.bean)) return save.closing.bean;
  return 'dongshan';
}
const nameOf = (id) => M.ITEMS[id]?.name || id;
export function hintOf(save, who) {
  const s = current(save, who);
  if (!s) return '';
  return typeof s.hint === 'function' ? s.hint(nameOf(lastBeanOf(save))) : s.hint;
}
export function isRight(save, who, drink, snack = M.withSnack(save)) {
  const s = current(save, who);
  return !!s && !!s.want({ drink, snack: !!snack, last: lastBeanOf(save) });
}

// 端一杯給熟客：記進存檔，回傳演出要用的東西；今天不能端（沒開放、今天已經收過）回傳 null
// { right, who, n, line 熟客那句, photo 照片 id（端對）, first 第一張照片, favorite 找到最愛（第三段）, hint 德叔更靠近的那句（端錯兩次以後） }
// keeper：凱文顧店時請他喝的那杯（錯兩次以後的提示改成凱文自己說的那句，KEEPER_FAV.hint）
export function serve(save, who, drink, day, t = 0, snack = M.withSnack(save), keeper = false) {
  if (!canServe(save, who, day) || !M.isDrink(drink)) return null;
  const f = favOf(save, who), s = current(save, who);
  f.servedDay = day;
  if (isRight(save, who, drink, snack)) {
    const id = `${who}-${s.n}`;
    if (!save.photos.some((p) => p.id === id)) save.photos.push({ id, day, t, item: drink, snack: !!snack });
    f.stage = s.n;
    f.misses = 0;
    return { right: true, who, n: s.n, line: s.ok, photo: id, first: save.photos.length === 1, favorite: !!s.favorite, hint: '' };
  }
  f.misses++;
  const pool = MISS[who];
  return { right: false, who, n: s.n, line: pool[(f.misses - 1) % pool.length], photo: null, first: false, favorite: false, hint: f.misses >= 2 ? (keeper && who === 'kevin' ? keeperHintOf(save) : hintOf(save, who)) : '' };
}

// 點熟客搭話的線索：這一段開放時，回傳那一段的句子（呼叫端決定多常用；沒有開放是空陣列）
export const clueLines = (save, who) => (isOpen(save, who) ? current(save, who).talk : []);
// 德叔在吧台說一次的線索：here＝在店裡、沒在演場景的熟客。回傳 { who, n, line } 或 null
export function pendingClue(save, here = []) {
  for (const who of FAV_IDS) {
    if (!here.includes(who) || !isOpen(save, who)) continue;
    const s = current(save, who);
    if ((favOf(save, who).told || 0) < s.n) return { who, n: s.n, line: s.deshu };
  }
  return null;
}
export function markClue(save, who, n) { const f = favOf(save, who); if (f) f.told = Math.max(f.told || 0, n); }

// 找到最愛（第三段）的熟客有幾位（溫度用，tasks.js 另外算一次，不 import 這個檔案）
export const favoritesFound = (save) => FAV_IDS.filter((w) => (favOf(save, w)?.stage || 0) >= STAGE_COUNT).length;

// 相簿：每位見過的熟客一頁，三格（拿到的照片＋還沒拿到的空格，Q77）；三段都找到的那一頁最後寫他的最愛
// 回傳 [{ who, slots: [{ id, n, file, got: { day, t, item } | null, caption、said（拿到才有） }], favorite: '' }]
export function album(save) {
  const out = [];
  for (const who of FAV_IDS) {
    if (!hasMilestone(save, who, 1)) continue; // 還沒見過的熟客不列（不劇透名字）
    const slots = STAGES[who].map((s) => {
      const id = `${who}-${s.n}`, got = (save.photos || []).find((p) => p.id === id) || null;
      return { id, n: s.n, file: `photo_${who}_${s.n}`, got, caption: got ? s.caption : '', said: got ? s.said || '' : '' };
    });
    const fav = (favOf(save, who)?.stage || 0) >= STAGE_COUNT;
    const last = slots[STAGE_COUNT - 1].got;
    const line = FAVORITE_LINE[who];
    out.push({ who, slots, favorite: fav ? (typeof line === 'function' ? line(nameOf(last?.item || lastBeanOf(save))) : line) : '' });
  }
  return out;
}

// 測試與校稿用：這個檔案裡所有玩家看得到的字
export function allFavoriteLines() {
  const out = [];
  for (const who of FAV_IDS) for (const s of STAGES[who]) out.push(...s.talk, s.deshu, s.ok, s.caption, ...(s.said ? [s.said] : []), typeof s.hint === 'function' ? s.hint('東山的豆') : s.hint);
  out.push(...Object.values(MISS).flat(), FAVORITE_LINE.yuan, FAVORITE_LINE.zhe, FAVORITE_LINE.kevin('東山的豆'));
  out.push(KEEPER_FAV.offer, KEEPER_FAV.ask, KEEPER_FAV.start, KEEPER_FAV.sit, KEEPER_FAV.back, ...KEEPER_FAV.clue.flat(), ...KEEPER_FAV.hint.map((h) => (typeof h === 'function' ? h('東山的豆') : h)));
  out.push(FAV_TEXT.offer('德叔', '予安'), FAV_TEXT.just, FAV_TEXT.ask('予安'), FAV_TEXT.cancel, FAV_TEXT.start, FAV_TEXT.firstPhoto, FAV_TEXT.album, FAV_TEXT.albumSub, FAV_TEXT.day(3), FAV_TEXT.close);
  return out;
}

export const PROFILE_IDS = Object.keys(PROFILES);
export const REGULAR_PROFILES = ['yuan', 'zhe', 'kevin'];
export const OTHER_PROFILES = ['deshu', 'longan', 'grandpa', 'oldman'];

// 人物誌頁上的字（每一句都標了待定）
export const PROFILE_TEXT = {
  sub: '見過的事，慢慢記下來。', // 【待定】人物誌頁標題下的一句
  open: '人物誌', // 【待定】相簿每位熟客那一頁的入口
  reread: '重讀這封信', // 【待定】
  photo: '看這張照片', // 【待定】縮圖的說明（給讀螢幕的人）
  day: (d) => `開店第 ${d} 天`, // 【待定】這一段是哪一天寫進來的（舊存檔升上來時寫進去的不顯示）
};

// 存檔 save.profiles（第 12 版）：got[who] = [{ n, day }]，寫進去的段落與第幾天（0＝舊存檔升上來時補的）
export const blankProfiles = () => ({ got: {} });
const P = (save) => {
  if (!save.profiles || typeof save.profiles !== 'object') save.profiles = blankProfiles();
  if (!save.profiles.got || typeof save.profiles.got !== 'object') save.profiles.got = {};
  return save.profiles;
};

// 把現在已經達到條件、還沒寫進去的段落寫進去（照順序；同一段只寫一次）。回傳這次新寫的 [{ who, n }]
export function syncProfiles(save, day = 0) {
  const got = P(save).got, added = [];
  for (const who of PROFILE_IDS) {
    for (const seg of PROFILES[who].segs) {
      const list = got[who] || [];
      if (list.some((x) => x.n === seg.n) || !seg.when(save)) continue;
      list.push({ n: seg.n, day });
      got[who] = list;
      added.push({ who, n: seg.n });
    }
  }
  return added;
}

// 一頁開了沒：第一段寫進去了（還沒見過的人不列，不劇透）
export const pageOpen = (save, who) => (P(save).got[who] || []).some((x) => x.n === 1);
export const openPages = (save, ids = PROFILE_IDS) => ids.filter((w) => pageOpen(save, w));
export const profileName = (save, who) => PROFILES[who]?.name(save) || '';

// 一頁的內容：寫進去的段落（照段的順序），[{ n, day, text, photo, letter }]；沒寫進去的不出現
export function profilePage(save, who) {
  const prof = PROFILES[who];
  if (!prof || !pageOpen(save, who)) return null;
  const got = P(save).got[who] || [];
  const segs = prof.segs.filter((s) => got.some((x) => x.n === s.n)).map((s) => ({
    n: s.n, day: got.find((x) => x.n === s.n).day, text: s.text, photo: s.photo || '', letter: s.letter || '',
  }));
  return { who, name: prof.name(save), segs };
}

// 測試與校稿用：這個檔案裡所有玩家看得到的字
export function allProfileLines() {
  const s0 = { regulars: { kevin: { milestones: [2] } } };
  const out = [];
  for (const who of PROFILE_IDS) {
    out.push(PROFILES[who].name(s0));
    for (const seg of PROFILES[who].segs) out.push(seg.text);
  }
  out.push(PROFILES.kevin.name({}), PROFILE_TEXT.sub, PROFILE_TEXT.open, PROFILE_TEXT.reread, PROFILE_TEXT.photo, PROFILE_TEXT.day(3));
  return out;
}

// 試咖啡（承峰 11/5「先做試咖啡」D206／D207；11/5 夜重做：參數微調 → 登錄測試紀錄 → 定案寫入品項沖法）：
// - 老闆只在吧台座與德叔一起調：粉水比、水溫、研磨、技法（冰飲技法另開）；無失敗、無分數、不加溫度。
// - 沖完可「登錄」到測試紀錄（綁定目標品項）；記事本上「定為這支的沖法」才寫 brewProfile，新品才進菜單本／黑板。
// - 黑板只寫品名、不暗示調過（承峰）。劇情配方 kiln／zhe-new 保留解鎖節奏，改為預設參數。
// - 存檔第 10 版 save.tasting；舊第 9 版紀錄遷移為 legacy。純邏輯，不依賴 Three.js 或 DOM。
import { ITEMS, unlocked, onBoard, boardFull, unlock, write, replace, isDrink, bookItems } from './menu.js';
import { hasMilestone } from './story.js';

export const RECORDS_KEEP = 30;

export const RATIOS = ['1:18', '1:16', '1:15', '1:14', '1:12'];
export const TEMPS = [88, 90, 92, 94, 96];

export const RECIPES = {

    item: 'kiln', after: { who: 'yuan', n: 3 }, dish: true,

  },

    params: { ratio: '1:15', temp: 94, grind: 'med-fine', technique: 'center' },
    offer: '阿哲那包新方法的豆子，還剩一點。老闆，粉水比和水溫我們可以慢慢調。', // 【待定】
    served: '阿哲的新方法。比較亮，像早上。', // 【待定】
    line: '酸是亮的，不刺。他阿公大概會說太年輕。', // 【待定】

export const RECIPE_IDS = Object.keys(RECIPES);

export const TASTE = {
  together: '一起試一杯', // 【待定】吧台座點德叔
  just: '只是聊聊', // 【待定】

  temp: Object.fromEntries(TEMPS.map((t) => [String(t), `水溫 ${t}°C`])), // 【待定】
  tempIce: '水溫・冰', // 【待定】冰飲不顯示 °C
  grind: { coarse: '研磨・粗', 'med-coarse': '研磨・中粗', med: '研磨・中', 'med-fine': '研磨・中細', fine: '研磨・細' }, // 【待定】
  technique: {
    'one-pour': '技法・一刀流', pulse: '技法・分段注水', center: '技法・中心繞圈', 'bloom-long': '技法・悶蒸長一點',
    'ice-pour': '技法・冰手沖', 'ice-chill': '技法・冰鎮',

  flavorName: { acid: '酸', sweet: '甜', bitter: '苦' }, // 【待定】

  profileLine: '店內沖法', // 【待定】菜單本小字
  defaultLine: '和店裡平常那杯差不多。穩。', // 【待定】
};

// 黑板上的便條（承峰 11/7：「便條紙直接貼上黑板好了」）：不做箭頭、不做發光，黑板右上角一直貼著一張德叔寫的便條，
// 點開是可以重複讀的說明（試咖啡怎麼開始、烘豆什麼時候烘）。這是「黑板不暗示調過」（承峰）之外的新例外：
// 便條只說怎麼開始，黑板上寫的品名照舊不暗示調過。不新增記事本頁面。
// 德叔提便條各一次（存檔 flags）：第一次坐吧台座、第一次打烊（最後一杯喝完以後）；還沒坐吧台座就點德叔想試，提醒先坐吧台（一次進店一次）
export const BOARD_NOTE = {
  title: '黑板上的便條', // 【待定】
  sub: '德叔寫的，一直貼著。', // 【待定】
  lines: [
    '老闆：', // 【待定】
    '新的配方會跟著店裡的故事慢慢開，不用急著找；有了，我先跟你說。', // 【待定】配方照劇情開放，便條不提前解鎖
    '有配方可以試的時候，先坐到吧台座，再叫我一聲。研磨、粉水比、水溫、技法，我們一項一項慢慢調，沒有錯的沖法。', // 【待定】
    '想烘豆，等打烊、最後一杯喝完以後，點門口右手邊角落那台大的烘豆機。淺一點、深一點，跟我說就好。', // 【待定】承峰 11/7 烘豆機搬到店門口右手邊那一角
    '不急。這張我一直貼著。', // 【待定】
  ],
  sign: '——德叔', // 【待定】
  close: '收起來', // 【待定】
  barHint: '老闆，黑板右上角那張便條是我寫的。想試新的沖法，看一下就知道。', // 【待定】第一次坐吧台座
  closeHint: '打烊以後也可以烘豆。怎麼烘，寫在黑板那張便條上。', // 【待定】第一次打烊、最後一杯喝完
  needBar: '想試新的沖法，先坐到吧台來。黑板上的便條有寫。', // 【待定】還沒坐吧台座就點德叔
};
const noteFlags = (save) => (save.flags && typeof save.flags === 'object' ? save.flags : (save.flags = {}));
// kind：'bar'（第一次坐吧台座）／'close'（第一次打烊）；提過就不再提
export const NOTE_FLAG = { bar: 'noteBarHint', close: 'noteCloseHint' };
export const noteHintDue = (save, kind) => !!NOTE_FLAG[kind] && !noteFlags(save)[NOTE_FLAG[kind]];
export function markNote(save, kind) { if (NOTE_FLAG[kind]) noteFlags(save)[NOTE_FLAG[kind]] = true; }
// 吧台座點德叔會出現「一起試一杯」：照原本的規則，德叔引導過或有配方照劇情開放了（againRecipes 是 openRecipes 的一部分）。
// 讀便條不會解鎖任何東西
export const tastingOpen = (save) => !!save.tasting?.guided || openRecipes(save).length > 0;

export const blankTasting = () => ({ trials: {}, records: [], nextId: 1, guided: false, offerHint: false });
const T = (save) => {
  if (!save.tasting || typeof save.tasting !== 'object') save.tasting = blankTasting();
  const ts = save.tasting;
  if (typeof ts.guided !== 'boolean') ts.guided = false;
  if (typeof ts.offerHint !== 'boolean') ts.offerHint = false;
  if (!Array.isArray(ts.records)) ts.records = [];
  if (!ts.trials || typeof ts.trials !== 'object') ts.trials = {};
  if (!Number.isFinite(ts.nextId)) ts.nextId = 1;
  return ts;
};
export const markGuided = (save) => { T(save).guided = true; };
export const markOfferHint = (save) => { T(save).offerHint = true; };

export const recipeOpen = (save, id) => !!RECIPES[id] && hasMilestone(save, RECIPES[id].after.who, RECIPES[id].after.n);
export const openRecipes = (save) => RECIPE_IDS.filter((id) => recipeOpen(save, id));
export const pendingOffer = (save) => openRecipes(save).find((id) => !T(save).trials[id]?.offered) || null;
export function markOffered(save, id, day) {
  const tr = T(save).trials;
  tr[id] = { offered: day, tried: tr[id]?.tried || 0, ...tr[id] };
  if (!tr[id].offered) tr[id].offered = day;
}
export const againRecipes = (save) => openRecipes(save).filter((id) => T(save).trials[id]?.offered);
export const recipeName = (id) => ITEMS[RECIPES[id]?.item]?.name || '';

export const isIceItem = (id) => ITEMS[id]?.cup === 'iced';

export function normalizeParams(raw = {}, item = 'dongshan') {
  const ice = isIceItem(item);
  const ratio = RATIOS.includes(raw.ratio) ? raw.ratio : DEFAULT_PARAMS.ratio;
  const grind = GRINDS.includes(raw.grind) ? raw.grind : DEFAULT_PARAMS.grind;
  let technique = TECH_ALL.includes(raw.technique) ? raw.technique : DEFAULT_PARAMS.technique;
  if (ice && !TECH_ICE.includes(technique)) technique = 'ice-pour';
  if (!ice && TECH_ICE.includes(technique)) technique = 'pulse';
  let temp = Number(raw.temp);
  if (ice) temp = 0;
  else if (!TEMPS.includes(temp)) temp = DEFAULT_PARAMS.temp;
  return { ratio, temp, grind, technique };
}

export function defaultParamsFor(item, recipeId = null) {
  if (recipeId && RECIPES[recipeId]) return normalizeParams(RECIPES[recipeId].params, RECIPES[recipeId].item);
  if (item && ITEMS[item]?.brewDefault) return normalizeParams(ITEMS[item].brewDefault, item);
  return normalizeParams(DEFAULT_PARAMS, item || 'dongshan');
}

export function techniquesFor(item) {
  return isIceItem(item) ? [...TECH_ICE] : [...TECH_HOT];
}

// 可登錄的品項：菜單本已解鎖的喝的 + 已開放尚未進菜單本的劇情試作
export function tuneItems(save) {
  const out = [];
  for (const id of bookItems(save)) if (isDrink(id)) out.push({ id, draft: false });
  for (const rid of openRecipes(save)) {
    const item = RECIPES[rid].item;
    if (!unlocked(save, item) && !out.some((x) => x.id === item)) out.push({ id: item, draft: true, recipe: rid });
  }
  return out;
}

export function labelParam(key, val, item) {
  if (key === 'temp' && (isIceItem(item) || val === 0)) return TASTE.tempIce;
  if (key === 'ratio') return TASTE.ratio[val] || String(val);
  if (key === 'temp') return TASTE.temp[String(val)] || `水溫 ${val}°C`;
  if (key === 'grind') return TASTE.grind[val] || String(val);
  if (key === 'technique') return TASTE.technique[val] || String(val);
  return String(val);
}

export function paramsSummary(params, item) {
  const p = normalizeParams(params, item);
  return ['ratio', 'temp', 'grind', 'technique'].map((k) => labelParam(k, p[k], item)).join('・');
}

// 口感：檔位指數加權 → 1～3，無分數、無失敗
export function flavorFromParams(params, item = 'dongshan') {
  const p = normalizeParams(params, item);
  const ri = RATIOS.indexOf(p.ratio); // 0 稀 → 4 濃
  const gi = GRINDS.indexOf(p.grind); // 0 粗 → 4 細
  const ti = isIceItem(item) ? 2 : TEMPS.indexOf(p.temp); // 0 低 → 4 高
  const tech = p.technique;
  let acid = 2, sweet = 2, bitter = 2;
  acid += (gi >= 3 ? 1 : 0) + (ti >= 3 ? 1 : 0) + (ri <= 1 ? 1 : 0) - (ri >= 3 ? 1 : 0);
  sweet += (ri >= 3 ? 1 : 0) + (gi <= 1 ? 1 : 0) + (tech === 'bloom-long' ? 1 : 0) - (ti >= 4 ? 1 : 0);
  bitter += (ri >= 3 ? 1 : 0) + (gi >= 3 ? 1 : 0) + (ti <= 1 ? 1 : 0) - (ri <= 1 ? 1 : 0);
  if (tech === 'ice-chill') { acid = Math.max(1, acid - 1); sweet += 1; }
  if (tech === 'one-pour') bitter += 1;
  const clamp = (n) => Math.max(1, Math.min(3, Math.round(n)));
  return { acid: clamp(acid), sweet: clamp(sweet), bitter: clamp(bitter) };
}

export function lineFromParams(params, item = 'dongshan', recipeId = null) {
  const p = normalizeParams(params, item);
  const d = defaultParamsFor(item, recipeId);
  if (p.ratio === d.ratio && p.temp === d.temp && p.grind === d.grind && p.technique === d.technique) {
    return recipeId && RECIPES[recipeId]?.line ? RECIPES[recipeId].line : TASTE.defaultLine;
  }
  const f = flavorFromParams(p, item);
  const bits = [];
  if (f.acid >= 3) bits.push('亮一點'); // 【待定】拼句用字
  else if (f.acid <= 1) bits.push('酸收著');
  if (f.sweet >= 3) bits.push('甜在中間');
  if (f.bitter >= 3) bits.push('尾巴有一點厚');
  else if (f.bitter <= 1) bits.push('尾段乾淨');
  if (RATIOS.indexOf(p.ratio) <= 1) bits.push('還可以再濃一點');
  else if (RATIOS.indexOf(p.ratio) >= 3) bits.push('再淡一點也許會打開');
  if (bits.length < 2 && TEMPS.indexOf(p.temp) >= 3) bits.push('水溫偏熱，香氣先出來');
  if (bits.length < 2 && GRINDS.indexOf(p.grind) >= 3) bits.push('磨得細，層次比較近');
  const body = bits.slice(0, 2).join('，') || '味道穩';
  if (recipeId === 'kiln') return `${body}。龍眼乾在旁邊，甜會再靠過來一點。`; // 【待定】
  if (recipeId === 'zhe-new') return `${body}。新方法的豆，酸是亮的。`; // 【待定】
  return `${body}。`; // 【待定】
}

function trimRecords(ts) {
  while (ts.records.length > RECORDS_KEEP) {
    const i = ts.records.findIndex((x) => !x.settled);
    if (i < 0) break;
    ts.records.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

// 登錄：寫測試紀錄（尚未改菜單本／黑板／brewProfile）
export function addTuneRecord(save, { item, recipe = null, params, day = 1, t = 0, part = 'day', legacy = false } = {}) {
  if (!ITEMS[item] || !isDrink(item)) return null;
  const ts = T(save);
  const p = normalizeParams(params, item);
  const flavor = flavorFromParams(p, item);
  const line = lineFromParams(p, item, recipe);
  if (recipe && RECIPES[recipe]) {
    markOffered(save, recipe, day);
    if (!ts.trials[recipe].tried) ts.trials[recipe].tried = day;
  }
  const dish = !!(RECIPES[recipe]?.dish || ITEMS[item]?.dish);
  const rec = {
    id: ts.nextId++, day, t, part, src: 'tune', recipe: recipe || null,
    item, params: p, flavor, line, dish, liked: false, settled: 0, told: false, legacy: !!legacy,
    // 相容舊讀法：cups[0].item
    cups: [{ item, base: item, level: 'usual', brew: isIceItem(item) ? 'iced' : 'hot', dish, flavor: { ...flavor }, line, params: p }],
  };
  ts.records.push(rec);
  trimRecords(ts);
  return rec;
}

// 舊 D206 一鍵試做：仍可用於遷移／測試，轉成帶預設參數的紀錄
export function addRecord(save, id, day = 1, t = 0, part = 'day') {
  const r = RECIPES[id];
  if (!r) return null;
  return addTuneRecord(save, { item: r.item, recipe: id, params: r.params, day, t, part });
}

export const recordById = (save, rid) => T(save).records.find((r) => r.id === rid) || null;
export const recordsNewest = (save) => [...T(save).records].reverse();
export function toggleLike(save, rid) {
  const r = recordById(save, rid);
  if (!r) return false;
  r.liked = !r.liked;
  return r.liked;
}

export function recordItem(rec) {
  return rec?.item || rec?.cups?.[0]?.item || '';
}

export function recordLines(rec) {
  const item = recordItem(rec);
  const p = rec.params || rec.cups?.[0]?.params || DEFAULT_PARAMS;
  const fl = rec.flavor || rec.cups?.[0]?.flavor || { acid: 2, sweet: 2, bitter: 2 };
  const flTxt = ['acid', 'sweet', 'bitter'].map((k) => `${TASTE.flavorName[k]}：${TASTE.flavorWord[fl[k]] || ''}`).join('・');
  return {
    head: TASTE.dayLine(rec.day, TASTE.part[rec.part] || TASTE.part.day),
    name: ITEMS[item]?.name || '',
    bean: paramsSummary(p, item),
    brew: rec.dish ? '附一小碟龍眼乾' : '', // 【待定】短註
    flavor: flTxt,
    line: `「${rec.line || rec.cups?.[0]?.line || ''}」`,
    settled: rec.settled ? TASTE.settledOn(rec.settled) : '',
  };
}

export function applyBrewProfile(save, item, params) {
  if (!save.menu?.items?.[item]) return false;
  save.menu.items[item].brewProfile = normalizeParams(params, item);
  return true;
}

export function brewProfileOf(save, item) {
  return save.menu?.items?.[item]?.brewProfile || null;
}

// 定案：寫入 brewProfile；新品則收進菜單本並寫上黑板
// 回傳 'done' | 'full' | 'profile'（只更新沖法、已在菜單本） | ''
export function settle(save, rid, day = 1, t = 0, out = null) {
  const rec = recordById(save, rid);
  if (!rec || rec.settled) return '';
  const item = recordItem(rec);
  if (!ITEMS[item]) return '';
  const params = normalizeParams(rec.params || rec.cups?.[0]?.params, item);
  const wasUnlocked = unlocked(save, item);
  const wasBoard = onBoard(save, item);
  if (!wasUnlocked) {
    unlock(save, item, day, t, { from: rec.recipe ? `trial:${rec.recipe}` : 'tune', board: false });
    const it = save.menu.items[item];
    it.told = true;
    it.seen = true;
    it.record = rec.id;
  }
  applyBrewProfile(save, item, params);
  if (!onBoard(save, item)) {
    if (out) { if (!replace(save, out, item, day)) return ''; }
    else if (boardFull(save)) return 'full';
    else if (!write(save, item, day)) return '';
  }
  rec.settled = day;
  rec.told = true;
  if (wasUnlocked && wasBoard) return 'profile';
  if (wasUnlocked) return 'done';
  return 'done';
}

export function cancelSettle(save, rid) {
  const rec = recordById(save, rid);
  if (!rec || rec.settled) return false;
  const item = recordItem(rec);
  const it = save.menu.items[item];
  if (!it || it.record !== rec.id || onBoard(save, item)) return false;
  delete save.menu.items[item];
  return true;
}

export function pendingHint(save, day) {
  const list = T(save).records.filter((r) => !r.settled && !r.told && r.day < day);
  return list.length ? list[list.length - 1] : null;
}
export function markHinted(save, day) {
  for (const r of T(save).records) if (!r.settled && r.day < day) r.told = true;
}

// 第 9 → 10：舊紀錄補 params／item，已定案的寫入 brewProfile 預設
export function migrateTastingToV10(save) {
  const ts = T(save);
  for (const rec of ts.records) {
    const item = recordItem(rec);
    if (!rec.item) rec.item = item;
    if (!rec.params) {
      const preset = rec.recipe && RECIPES[rec.recipe] ? RECIPES[rec.recipe].params : DEFAULT_PARAMS;
      rec.params = normalizeParams(preset, item);
      rec.legacy = true;
    } else rec.params = normalizeParams(rec.params, item);
    if (!rec.flavor) rec.flavor = flavorFromParams(rec.params, item);
    if (!rec.line) rec.line = rec.cups?.[0]?.line || lineFromParams(rec.params, item, rec.recipe);
    if (rec.settled && item && unlocked(save, item) && !save.menu.items[item].brewProfile) {
      applyBrewProfile(save, item, rec.params);
    }
  }
  return ts;
}

export function allTastingLines() {
  const out = [];
  for (const r of Object.values(RECIPES)) out.push(r.offer, r.served, r.line);
  for (const v of Object.values(TASTE)) {
    if (typeof v === 'string') out.push(v);
    else if (typeof v === 'function') out.push(v.length >= 2 ? v(1, '白天') : v('龍眼窯特調'));
    else if (Array.isArray(v)) out.push(...v.filter(Boolean));
    else out.push(...Object.values(v));
  }
  for (const v of Object.values(BOARD_NOTE)) out.push(...(Array.isArray(v) ? v : [v]));
  out.push('亮一點', '酸收著', '甜在中間', '尾巴有一點厚', '尾段乾淨', '還可以再濃一點', '再淡一點也許會打開', '水溫偏熱，香氣先出來', '磨得細，層次比較近', '味道穩');
  return out;
}

// 我單方面辭退老闆後，開了一間夢想中的咖啡店 — 2.5D 紙片原型
// 3D 房間 + 2D 紙片（billboard）擺飾與人物，驗證手機直立的顧客視角。
import * as THREE from 'three';
import * as A from './art.js';
import { createStore, giveStarters } from './save.js';

import * as S from './story.js';
import { petCat, jumpsOnChair, PURR, CAT_LINES } from './cat.js';
import * as H from './afterhours.js';
import * as F from './farewell.js';
import { createAudio, VOLUMES, VOLUME_NAMES } from './audio.js';
import * as MO from './moments.js';
import * as MN from './menu.js';
import * as FV from './favorites.js';
import * as TS from './tasting.js';
import * as RO from './roast.js';
import * as PR from './profiles.js';
import * as VS from './visits.js';
import { createNav } from './pathfind.js';
import { versionLabel } from './version.js';

const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
// 瀏覽器（手機尤其）可能拿到快取的舊 index.html、配上新的 main.js：少了試咖啡的 #tune 面板時，
// 頂層的 MutationObserver.observe(null) 會丟錯，整個場景停在空白。缺了就由程式補上面板與樣式。
if (!$('tune')) {
  const st = document.createElement('style');
  st.textContent = `#tune .card{max-height:calc(100% - 24px)}#tune-list{overflow-y:auto;flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;touch-action:pan-y;margin:4px 0 10px}
.tune-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(59,42,32,.12)}.tune-row b{flex:0 0 4.5em;font-size:14px}
.tune-row .val{flex:1 1 auto;font-size:14px;text-align:center}.tune-row button{flex:none;min-width:44px;min-height:44px;padding:0 10px;font-size:18px}
.tune-items{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;margin:0 0 10px}.tune-items button{text-align:left;font-size:14px;padding:10px 12px;background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(59,42,32,.35);box-shadow:none}
.tune-items button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#3b2a20;color:#f6efe2;border-color:#3b2a20}.tune-actions{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}`;
  document.head.appendChild(st);
  const el = document.createElement('div');
  el.id = 'tune'; el.className = 'overlay'; el.hidden = true;
  el.setAttribute('role', 'dialog'); el.setAttribute('aria-modal', 'true'); el.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', 'tune-title');
  el.innerHTML = '<div class="card"><h2 id="tune-title">今天這杯怎麼沖</h2><p class="sub" id="tune-sub">慢慢調。沒有錯的沖法。</p><div id="tune-list"></div>'
    + '<div class="tune-actions"><button id="tune-brew" class="primary">請德叔依這組沖</button><button id="tune-cancel">下次再調</button></div></div>';
  const nb = $('notebook');
  if (nb) nb.before(el); else document.body.appendChild(el);
}
// 同上：舊的 index.html 沒有黑板便條的 #note 面板（承峰 11/7）
if (!$('note')) {
  const st = document.createElement('style');
  st.textContent = `#note-body{overflow-y:auto;flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;touch-action:pan-y;margin:4px 0 12px}#note-body p{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.7}#note-body .sign{text-align:right;opacity:.8}`;
  document.head.appendChild(st);
  const el = document.createElement('div');
  el.id = 'note'; el.className = 'overlay'; el.hidden = true;
  el.setAttribute('role', 'dialog'); el.setAttribute('aria-modal', 'true'); el.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', 'note-title');
  el.innerHTML = '<div class="card paper"><h2 id="note-title"></h2><p class="sub" id="note-sub"></p><div id="note-body"></div><button id="note-close" class="primary"></button></div>';
  const nb = $('notebook');
  if (nb) nb.before(el); else document.body.appendChild(el);
}
// 版本號（承峰 11/7「順便把版本號改在記事本裡面」）：記事本最底下的小字，從 src/version.js 讀；
// 舊的 index.html 沒有 #nb-version 時補在「闔上」下面（樣式寫在元素上）
{
  let ver = $('nb-version');
  if (!ver) {
    ver = document.createElement('p');
    ver.id = 'nb-version';
    ver.style.cssText = 'margin:8px 0 0;font-size:11px;line-height:14px;text-align:center;opacity:.5;user-select:none;white-space:nowrap';
    $('nb-close').after(ver);
  }
  ver.textContent = versionLabel();
}
const lightsEl = $('lights'); // 打烊後每盞燈旁邊的「關燈／開燈」

/* ---------- art2b：開場、介面的手繪圖（CSS 變數）、介面圖示、啟動畫面 ---------- */
// 圖載到了才設 CSS 變數，index.html 用 var(--art-*, none)：沒有載到就是原本的漸層、純色與 2px 墨色框
for (const [v, name] of [['--art-office', 'scene_office_night'], ['--art-paper', 'ui_paper_lined'], ['--art-bubble', 'ui_bubble_9slice']]) {
  const url = A.artUrl(name);
  if (url) document.documentElement.style.setProperty(v, `url("${url}")`);
}
$('app').classList.toggle('art-bubble', !!A.artUrl('ui_bubble_9slice'));
// 介面圖示：ui_icons.svg 的四個 <symbol> 放進頁面裡（同一份文件，<use href="#icon-…"> 一定找得到），
// 選單、快轉、溫度、開燈前面加圖示；沒有載到就照舊只有文字（選單是「≡」）
const ICONS = !!A.iconSymbols();
if (ICONS) {
  const sprite = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'svg');
  sprite.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  sprite.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;width:0;height:0;overflow:hidden';
  sprite.innerHTML = A.iconSymbols();
  document.body.prepend(sprite);
}
const iconSvg = (id) => `<svg class="icon" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><use href="#icon-${id}"/></svg>`;
// 按鈕前面加圖示，文字放進 .lbl（之後改字用 setLabel，圖示不會被蓋掉）；only＝只要圖示（選單）
function iconize(el, id, only = false) {
  if (!ICONS || el.querySelector('.icon')) return;
  const text = el.textContent;
  el.innerHTML = iconSvg(id) + (only ? '' : '<span class="lbl"></span>');
  if (!only) el.querySelector('.lbl').textContent = text;
  el.classList.add('has-icon');
}
const setLabel = (el, text) => { (el.querySelector('.lbl') || el).textContent = text; };
iconize($('menu-btn'), 'menu', true);
iconize($('speed'), 'fastforward');
iconize($('temp'), 'temperature');
iconize($('lights-btn'), 'light');
// 啟動畫面：main.js 開始跑時手繪圖都載完了（art.js 的 top-level await），淡出後拿掉
{
  const sp = $('splash');
  if (sp) { sp.classList.add('out'); setTimeout(() => sp.remove(), 700); }
}

/* ---------- 開發者模式：網址加 ?dev=1（測試可再加 &speed=20 讓動作加速） ---------- */
const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const DEV = params.get('dev') === '1';
const DEV_SPEED = DEV ? Math.max(1, Number(params.get('speed')) || 1) : 1;
// 測試用：?dev=1&regulars=0 關掉熟客（不測熟客的冒煙測試段落用，溫度與基金才算得準）；&weather=rain|typhoon 指定店裡的天氣
const REGULARS_ON = !(DEV && params.get('regulars') === '0');
// 熟客的來訪段落（visits.js）：一般玩家與開發者模式一樣開著；&visits=0 關掉（只給要隔離原本里程碑場景的測試用，不是預設）
const VISITS_ON = REGULARS_ON && !(DEV && params.get('visits') === '0');
const DEV_WEATHER = DEV ? params.get('weather') : null;

/* ---------- 存檔與遊戲時間 ---------- */
// 現實一天＝遊戲一天；開發者模式可以跳天數（時間偏移存在存檔裡，一般模式不採用）
const store = createStore();
const save = store.load();
const now = () => Date.now() + (DEV ? save.dev.offsetMs : 0);
const today = () => daysOpen(save.createdAt, now());
const keeper = () => F.departed(save); // 離開東山之後：店轉為常態經營，凱文顧店（德叔跟著老闆去下一站）
const returningDay = store.status === 'loaded' && dayIndex(save.lastSeen) < dayIndex(now()); // 隔天以後才回到店裡
const lastSeenAtLoad = save.lastSeen; // 離線營業日誌從這裡結算
// 測試用：?dev=1&opening=0 直接當作看過開場（德叔的三件初始擺飾照樣收進倉庫）
if (DEV && params.get('opening') === '0' && !save.flags.seenOpening) {
  save.flags.seenOpening = true;
  giveStarters(save);
}
// 測試與截圖用（黑板菜單，D185）：&menu=all 把所有品項收進菜單本（不寫上黑板）；&board=dongshan,black,cocoa 直接指定黑板上寫什麼（沒解鎖的一併解鎖）
if (DEV && params.get('menu') === 'all') devUnlockMenu();
if (DEV && params.get('board')) {
  const ids = params.get('board').split(',').filter((id) => MN.ITEMS[id]);
  for (const id of ids) MN.unlock(save, id, today(), now(), { board: false });
  if (ids.some(MN.isDrink)) save.menu.board = ids.slice(0, MN.BOARD_MAX);
}
// 試咖啡的品項（from 是 trial:<配方>）不算：它們要在測試紀錄上定案才收進菜單本（D206）
function devUnlockMenu() {
  for (const id of MN.ITEM_IDS) if (!/^trial:/.test(MN.ITEMS[id].from) && MN.unlock(save, id, today(), now(), { board: false })) MN.markTold(save, id);
}
let resetting = false;
function persist() {
  if (resetting) return;
  save.lastSeen = now();
  PR.syncProfiles(save, today()); // 人物誌（D218）：里程碑、照片、信、告別發生了，就把那一段寫進去
  store.write(save);
}
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') persist(); });
window.addEventListener('pagehide', persist);
setInterval(persist, 60000);

const audio = createAudio(); // 聲音與音樂（src/audio.js）；接到場景的部分見「聲音與音樂」一節

/* ---------- 基本設定 ---------- */
const app = $('app');
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
// 效能（階段 7）：解析度最高 2 倍；中低階手機連續幾秒畫不到 40 FPS 時，每次往下降 0.25（最低 1 倍），見 perfTick()
const PERF = { cap: Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2), ratio: 1, frames: 0, acc: 0, fps: 0, low: 0, since: performance.now(), drops: 0, skipped: 0 };
PERF.ratio = PERF.cap;
renderer.setPixelRatio(PERF.ratio);
renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
app.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(50, 1, 0.05, 60);

function resize() {
  const w = app.clientWidth, h = app.clientHeight;
  renderer.setSize(w, h);
  camera.aspect = w / h;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  fitOverview();
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

/* ---------- 房間 ---------- */
const ROOM = { w: 6, d: 8, h: 3.2 };
const lambert = (map, extra = {}) => new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map, ...extra });

// 接正式美術第二批：地板、牆、天花板、吧台與桌面是手繪的無縫材質（沒有載到時 art.js 回傳同樣大小的 Canvas 版本），依公尺設定 repeat
const floorTex = A.tex(A.woodFloor(), [ROOM.w / 2, ROOM.d / 2]); // 一張 2×2 公尺
// 同一張圖的不同 repeat：clone() 共用同一份圖（GPU 只上傳一次）
const texRepeat = (t, x, y) => { const c = t.clone(); c.repeat.set(x, y); c.needsUpdate = true; return c; };
const floor = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(ROOM.w, ROOM.d), lambert(floorTex));
floor.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
scene.add(floor);

// 牆：上半石灰牆、下半 1 公尺高的紅磚腰牆（上緣是木腰帶），各一片平鋪 1×1 公尺的材質
const WAINSCOT = 1.0;
const plasterTex = A.tex(A.wallPlaster(), [1, 1]), wainscotTex = A.tex(A.wallWainscot(), [1, 1]);
function addWall(w, x, z, ry) {
  const m = new THREE.Group();
  const up = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w, ROOM.h - WAINSCOT), lambert(texRepeat(plasterTex, w, ROOM.h - WAINSCOT)));
  up.position.y = (ROOM.h + WAINSCOT) / 2;
  const low = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w, WAINSCOT), lambert(texRepeat(wainscotTex, w, 1)));
  low.position.y = WAINSCOT / 2;
  m.add(up, low);
  m.position.set(x, 0, z);
  m.rotation.y = ry;
  scene.add(m);
  return m;
}
addWall(ROOM.w, 0, -ROOM.d / 2, 0); // 後牆
addWall(ROOM.d, -ROOM.w / 2, 0, Math.PI / 2); // 左牆
addWall(ROOM.d, ROOM.w / 2, 0, -Math.PI / 2); // 右牆（吧台後）
const frontWall = addWall(ROOM.w, 0, ROOM.d / 2, Math.PI); // 前牆，只在坐下時顯示

const ceiling = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(ROOM.w, ROOM.d), lambert(A.tex(A.ceiling(), [ROOM.w, ROOM.d]))); // 一張 1×1 公尺
ceiling.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
ceiling.position.y = ROOM.h;
scene.add(ceiling);

// 窗戶（不受光照影響，自己發亮）；窗外隨白天／夜晚與天氣（晴、雨、颱風）換一張。
// 接正式美術第二批：窗景六張是畫好的最終亮度；窗框是另一張透明圖，貼在窗景與雨絲前面（受店裡的光照）
const winTexCache = new Map();
function winTex(night, weather) {
  const k = `${night}:${weather}`;
  if (!winTexCache.has(k)) winTexCache.set(k, A.tex(A.windowView(night, weather)));
  return winTexCache.get(k);
}
const windows = [];
const rainTex = { rain: A.tex(A.rain(false)), typhoon: A.tex(A.rain(true)) };
for (const t of Object.values(rainTex)) { t.wrapS = t.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping; t.repeat.set(2, 1.2); }
const rainPlanes = [];
const frameTex = A.tex(A.windowFrame());
function addWindow(x, y, z, ry) {
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.6, 1.3), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: winTex(false, 'clear') }));
  m.position.set(x, y, z);
  m.rotation.y = ry;
  scene.add(m);
  windows.push(m);
  // 雨絲：貼在窗戶前面一點，往下捲動
  const r = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.5, 1.2), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: rainTex.rain, transparent: true, depthWrite: false }));
  r.position.set(x, y, z);
  r.rotation.y = ry;
  r.translateZ(0.025);
  r.visible = false;
  scene.add(r);
  rainPlanes.push(r);
  const f = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.6, 1.3), lambert(frameTex, { transparent: true, alphaTest: 0.35 }));
  f.position.set(x, y, z);
  f.rotation.y = ry;
  f.translateZ(0.035);
  scene.add(f);
}
addWindow(-1.7, 1.75, -ROOM.d / 2 + 0.02, 0);
addWindow(-ROOM.w / 2 + 0.02, 1.7, -0.6, Math.PI / 2);

// 德叔換黑板（店內小事件 deshu-board）時把黑板上喝的東西換一杯到最上面：第幾杯（不存檔，重新整理回到老闆寫的順序；D188）
let boardShift = 0;
function boardText() { return { head: MN.boardHead(save), lines: MN.boardLines(save, boardShift) }; }
// 吧台後方層架（小黑板就是菜單：老闆寫上去的東西由程式寫在上面，menu.js，D185）。
// 接正式美術第二批：手繪的層架下半是一座有抽屜的櫃子，底邊在離地 0.95 公尺：底下補一座靠牆的矮櫃（正面用吧台正面的材質）撐著
// 黑板字修正（D189）：層架往店門口那一側（+z）挪 BACK_SHIFT，德叔（HOME z −1.6）改站在黑板左半前面，
// 字寫在黑板右邊（art.js 的 BOARD_TEXT），從吧台座、角落沙發看過去都在德叔右邊、不被他擋住
const BACK_SHIFT = 0.22;
const BACK_Z = -1.6 + BACK_SHIFT;
const backBar = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2.8, 1.8), lambert(A.tex(A.backBar(2.8, 1.8)), { transparent: true, alphaTest: 0.1 }));
backBar.position.set(ROOM.w / 2 - 0.02, 1.85, BACK_Z);
backBar.rotation.y = -Math.PI / 2;
scene.add(backBar);
// 黑板的字面（art.js 的 boardText()：比層架那張圖細很多，字放大也不糊），貼在黑板前面一點點
const BOARD_W = A.BOARD_TEXT.x1 - A.BOARD_TEXT.x0, BOARD_H = A.BOARD_TEXT.y1 - A.BOARD_TEXT.y0;
// 層架圖上的一點（公尺，原點是圖的左上角）在店裡的位置
const onBackBar = (u, v, out = new THREE.Vector3()) => out.set(backBar.position.x - 0.006, backBar.position.y + 0.9 - v, BACK_Z - 1.4 + u);
const boardFace = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(BOARD_W, BOARD_H), lambert(A.tex(A.boardText(boardText())), { transparent: true, alphaTest: 0.02, depthWrite: false }));
onBackBar((A.BOARD_TEXT.x0 + A.BOARD_TEXT.x1) / 2, (A.BOARD_TEXT.y0 + A.BOARD_TEXT.y1) / 2, boardFace.position);
boardFace.rotation.y = -Math.PI / 2;
boardFace.renderOrder = 1;
scene.add(boardFace);
// 黑板上的便條（承峰 11/7：「便條紙直接貼上黑板好了」）：程式畫的小紙片加紙膠帶（art.js 的 boardNote()，圖上不寫字），
// 貼在黑板右上角、比字面再前面一點；一直留著。點它打開德叔寫的說明（openNote()），文字在 tasting.js 的 NOTE
const noteMesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(A.NOTE.w, A.NOTE.h), lambert(A.tex(A.boardNote()), { transparent: true, alphaTest: 0.05, depthWrite: false }));
onBackBar(A.NOTE.u, A.NOTE.v, noteMesh.position).x -= 0.006;
noteMesh.rotation.y = -Math.PI / 2;
noteMesh.renderOrder = 2;
noteMesh.name = 'note';
scene.add(noteMesh);
// 點便條的範圍比紙片大一圈（從角落沙發看過去紙片只有十幾個像素）：一塊看不見的板子，只拿來打射線（不在 traverseVisible 裡，不擋任何東西）
const noteHit = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(A.NOTE.w * 1.4, A.NOTE.h * 1.4), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial());
noteHit.position.copy(noteMesh.position);
noteHit.rotation.y = -Math.PI / 2;
noteHit.visible = false;
scene.add(noteHit);
noteHit.updateMatrixWorld(true);
const BACK_BASE = { d: 0.2, h: 0.95 };
const counterFrontTex = A.tex(A.counterFront(), [1, 1]);
const woodTopTex = A.tex(A.woodTop(), [1, 1]);
{
  const front = lambert(texRepeat(counterFrontTex, 2.8 / 1.7, BACK_BASE.h));
  const top = lambert(texRepeat(woodTopTex, BACK_BASE.d, 2.8));
  const side = lambert(texRepeat(counterFrontTex, BACK_BASE.d / 1.7, BACK_BASE.h));
  const base = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(BACK_BASE.d, BACK_BASE.h, 2.8), [side, front, top, top, side, side]);
  base.position.set(ROOM.w / 2 - BACK_BASE.d / 2, BACK_BASE.h / 2, BACK_Z);
  scene.add(base);
}
function drawBackBar() {
  boardFace.material.map?.dispose();
  boardFace.material.map = A.tex(A.boardText(boardText()));
  boardFace.material.needsUpdate = true;
  counterBag.visible = MN.unlocked(save, 'longan');
}

// 牆上的老溫度計
const thermoMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ transparent: true, alphaTest: 0.1 });
const thermo = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.36, 0.9), thermoMat);
// 美術評分修正 e：從 x＝1.4 往左移到 1.0：從吧台座轉頭看坐在最裡面高腳椅的凱文，他的頭原本正好疊在溫度計上
thermo.position.set(1.0, 1.65, -ROOM.d / 2 + 0.02);
scene.add(thermo);
// 溫度上升時，溫度計後面亮起一圈暖光
const thermoGlow = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.9, 1.4),
  new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: A.tex(A.glow()), color: '#ffb066', transparent: true, opacity: 0, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending }));
thermoGlow.position.set(1.0, 1.65, -ROOM.d / 2 + 0.01);
thermoGlow.visible = false;
scene.add(thermoGlow);

// 吧台（實體盒子；大型家具用立體，小擺飾與人物用紙片）。
// 接正式美術第二批：正面（客人那一側）與兩端貼吧台正面的材質（1.7×1 公尺一張），檯面與圓桌貼木頭檯面（1×1 公尺一張）
// BoxGeometry 六個面的順序：+x、−x、+y、−y、+z、−z
const counterSide = lambert(texRepeat(counterFrontTex, 0.7 / 1.7, 1));
const counterFace = lambert(texRepeat(counterFrontTex, 3.4 / 1.7, 1));
const counter = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.7, 1.0, 3.4), [counterFace, counterFace, counterSide, counterSide, counterSide, counterSide]);
counter.position.set(2.0, 0.5, -1.5);
scene.add(counter);
// 檯面：木紋順著吧台長的方向（材質轉 90°）
const topTex = texRepeat(woodTopTex, 3.5, 0.8);
topTex.center.set(0.5, 0.5); topTex.rotation = Math.PI / 2;
const topEdge = lambert(texRepeat(woodTopTex, 3.5, 0.06)), topEnd = lambert(texRepeat(woodTopTex, 0.8, 0.06));
const counterTop = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.8, 0.06, 3.5), [topEdge, topEdge, lambert(topTex), topEnd, topEnd, topEnd]);
counterTop.position.set(2.0, 1.03, -1.5);
scene.add(counterTop);

const tableEdge = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: '#8a5a3b' });
function table(x, z, h = 0.74, r = 0.38) {
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  const face = lambert(texRepeat(woodTopTex, 2 * r, 2 * r)); // 圓桌面的 UV 是整個圓：直徑幾公尺就重複幾次
  const top = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r, r, 0.04, 32), [tableEdge, face, face]);
  top.position.y = h;
  const leg = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.04, 0.05, h, 12), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: '#3a3330' }));
  leg.position.y = h / 2;
  const foot = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.22, 0.24, 0.03, 24), leg.material);
  foot.position.y = 0.015;
  g.add(top, leg, foot);
  top.userData.table = leg.userData.table = foot.userData.table = true;
  g.position.set(x, 0, z);
  scene.add(g);
  return { x, z, h };
}

// 吊燈。接正式美術第二批：手繪的吊燈是紙片（燈罩下緣在原本圓錐的下緣 2.35 公尺，電線往上接到天花板），
// 只轉水平方向面向鏡頭（hanging）；燈罩的亮度用 emissive（只有燈罩那段發亮）。沒有載到就用原本的立體圓錐
const pendants = [];
const hanging = [];
const lampArt = A.pendantLamp();
const lampTex = lampArt && A.tex(lampArt), lampGlow = lampArt && A.tex(lampArt.glow);
for (const z of [-2.5, -0.7]) {
  let shade;
  if (lampTex) {
    const w = lampArt.width / lampArt.ppm, h = lampArt.height / lampArt.ppm;
    shade = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w, h).translate(0, h / 2, 0),
      new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map: lampTex, emissiveMap: lampGlow, emissive: '#ffffff', emissiveIntensity: 0.7, transparent: true, alphaTest: 0.35, side: THREE.DoubleSide }));
    shade.position.set(2.0, 2.35, z);
    hanging.push(shade);
    scene.add(shade);
  } else {
    shade = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.16, 0.2, 20, 1, true), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#ffd59a', side: THREE.DoubleSide }));
    shade.position.set(2.0, 2.45, z);
    const cord = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.006, 0.006, 0.65), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#222' }));
    cord.position.set(2.0, 2.87, z);
    scene.add(shade, cord);
  }
  const light = new THREE.PointLight('#ffb46b', 6, 0, 1.6);
  light.position.set(2.0, 2.3, z);
  scene.add(light);
  pendants.push({ shade, light, level: 1, pos: new THREE.Vector3(2.0, 2.45, z) });
}
// 夜裡吧台正面（客人那一側）的補光：吊燈在吧台正上方，正面原本只剩一片暗（階段 7）；跟著吊燈一起開關
const barFill = new THREE.PointLight('#ffc58a', 0, 3.2, 1.4);
barFill.position.set(0.9, 1.5, -1.5);
scene.add(barFill);
// 美術評分修正 c：坐下時，自己那張桌子上方一點暖光（深色桌面在近景占一大塊，原本是整片暗色）；跟著吊燈一起開關
const seatLamp = new THREE.PointLight('#ffcf94', 0, 1.8, 1.2);
scene.add(seatLamp);

/* ---------- 光線 ---------- */
const hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight('#dfe8ff', '#a8865f', 1.6);
scene.add(hemi);
const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight('#fff1dc', 2.0);
sun.position.set(-6, 5, -1.5);
scene.add(sun);

/* ---------- 紙片 ---------- */
const papers = [];
const blobTex = A.tex(A.blob());
// 落地燈亮的時候燈罩前面的暖光（手繪的落地燈用）
const haloTex = A.tex(A.glow());
const floorGlow = new Map(); // 手繪落地燈的圖 → 只有燈罩的發光材質（每張圖做一次）
function lampGlowTex(art) {
  if (!floorGlow.has(art)) floorGlow.set(art, A.tex(A.glowOnly(art, 0, 0.24)));
  return floorGlow.get(art);
}

function paper(canvas, x, z, opt = {}) {
  const w = canvas.width / A.ppmOf(canvas), h = canvas.height / A.ppmOf(canvas);
  const group = new THREE.Group();
  const geo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w, h).translate(0, h / 2, 0);
  const mat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map: A.tex(canvas), transparent: true, alphaTest: 0.35, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
  mesh.position.y = opt.y || 0;
  group.add(mesh);
  if (opt.shadow !== false && !opt.y) {
    const s = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w * 1.1, Math.max(0.25, w * 0.5)), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: blobTex, transparent: true, depthWrite: false }));
    s.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    s.position.y = 0.005;
    group.add(s);
    group.userData.shadow = s;
  }
  group.position.set(x, 0, z);
  group.userData = { ...group.userData, mesh, base: opt.base ?? 0, clamp: opt.clamp ?? Math.PI, name: opt.name, overClamp: !!opt.overClamp };
  scene.add(group);
  papers.push(group);
  return group;
}

function setPaper(p, canvas) {
  p.userData.art = canvas; // 現在用的是哪張圖（龍眼走路時依它決定要不要鏡像、德叔的小動作只在站著時做）
  const m = p.userData.mesh.material;
  m.map.dispose();
  m.map = A.tex(canvas);
  if (m.emissiveMap) m.emissiveMap = m.map; // 夜裡人物自己帶一點光（applyLight）
  m.needsUpdate = true;
}

// 換一張大小不同的圖（例如凱文從站著走進來變成坐下）：平面的尺寸也跟著換
function setArt(p, canvas) {
  const mesh = p.userData.mesh;
  const w = canvas.width / A.ppmOf(canvas), h = canvas.height / A.ppmOf(canvas);
  const prm = mesh.geometry.parameters;
  if (Math.abs(prm.width - w) > 1e-3 || Math.abs(prm.height - h) > 1e-3) {
    mesh.geometry.dispose();
    mesh.geometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w, h).translate(0, h / 2, 0);
  }
  setPaper(p, canvas);
}

function removePaper(p) {
  scene.remove(p);
  papers.splice(papers.indexOf(p), 1);
  p.traverse((o) => {
    if (o.geometry) o.geometry.dispose();
    if (o.material) { if (o.material.map !== blobTex && o.material.map !== haloTex) o.material.map?.dispose(); o.material.dispose(); }
  });
}

const wrapAngle = (a) => Math.atan2(Math.sin(a), Math.cos(a));
// 紙片轉向鏡頭。階段 7 打磨：
// 1. 俯瞰時店前半部的紙片幾乎是從正上方看，只剩一條線：不靠牆的紙片往後仰一點（鏡頭越高越仰，最多約 27°），坐下時不仰
// 2. 角落沙發平常只能小角度轉（坐下看起來才自然），俯瞰時整張轉向鏡頭，不再是側面；轉的時候慢慢轉
// 美術評分修正 d：俯瞰時不靠牆的紙片只繞垂直軸轉到和畫面平行（不是各自對著鏡頭的位置，畫面邊上的才不會斜成側面），
// 往後仰的角度不變，剩下看不到的高度用往上拉長補回來（最多 1.8 倍）：原本仰 27° 還是扁扁的，看起來像倒在地上
const camFwd = new THREE.Vector3();
function faceCamera(dt = 0) {
  const over = state.mode === 'overview';
  camera.getWorldDirection(camFwd);
  const screenYaw = Math.atan2(-camFwd.x, -camFwd.z); // 和畫面平行的方向（美術評分修正 d）
  for (const m of hanging) m.rotation.y = Math.atan2(camera.position.x - m.position.x, camera.position.z - m.position.z);
  for (const p of papers) {
    const free = p.userData.clamp >= Math.PI - 1e-6 || p.userData.overClamp; // 站在地上、可以整張轉的紙片（靠牆的不算）
    const yaw = over && free ? screenYaw : Math.atan2(camera.position.x - p.position.x, camera.position.z - p.position.z);
    const clamp = over && p.userData.overClamp ? Math.PI : p.userData.clamp;
    const d = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(wrapAngle(yaw - p.userData.base), -clamp, clamp);
    const target = p.userData.base + d;
    if (p.userData.overClamp && dt) p.rotation.y += wrapAngle(target - p.rotation.y) * Math.min(1, dt * 4);
    else p.rotation.y = target;
    if (p.userData.shadow) p.userData.shadow.rotation.z = -p.rotation.y; // 影子保持朝地
    if (free) {
      const m = p.userData.mesh;
      const h = m.geometry.parameters.height * 0.5 + m.position.y;
      const elev = Math.atan2(camera.position.y - h, Math.hypot(camera.position.x - p.position.x, camera.position.z - p.position.z));
      const lean = THREE.MathUtils.clamp((elev - 0.5) * 0.6, 0, 0.47);
      m.rotation.x = -lean;
      // 美術評分修正 d：俯瞰時剩下的角度用拉長補回來，畫出來和原圖一樣高，不會看起來扁扁地躺在地上
      const sy = over ? Math.min(1.8, 1 / Math.cos(Math.max(0, elev - lean))) : 1;
      m.scale.y = sy * (p.userData.squash ?? 1);
    }
    // 美術評分修正 e：俯瞰時人物與龍眼放大（OVER_BIG，評審：德叔約 40px、貓約 30px 太小），以腳底為準；坐下時慢慢縮回原本的大小
    if (p.userData.big !== undefined) {
      const m = p.userData.mesh, to = over ? OVER_BIG : 1;
      p.userData.big = dt ? p.userData.big + (to - p.userData.big) * Math.min(1, dt * 4) : to;
      m.scale.x = (p.userData.flip ?? 1) * p.userData.big;
      if (free) m.scale.y *= p.userData.big;
      else m.scale.y = (p.userData.squash ?? 1) * p.userData.big;
    }
  }
}
const OVER_BIG = 1.3;

/* ---------- 座位 ---------- */
const tA = table(-2.2, -0.6);
const tC = table(-1.45, 2.4, 0.45, 0.42);
const tY = table(-0.4, -2.3, 0.74, 0.34);

const SEATS = [

    id: 'window', name: '窗邊座',

    eye: new THREE.Vector3(-1.55, 1.25, 0.6), look: new THREE.Vector3(-2.0, 0.85, -3.6), fov: 60,
    cup: new THREE.Vector3(-1.9, tA.h + 0.02, -0.62), serve: new THREE.Vector3(-1.55, 0, -0.9), table: tA, // 端杯點回到原位（D213：循路自己繞開桌椅）
    prop: paper(A.chair(), -1.9, 0.15, { name: 'chair' }),
  },

    cup: new THREE.Vector3(1.72, 1.06, -1.22), serve: null,
    prop: paper(A.stool(), 1.3, -1.0, { name: 'stool' }),
  },
  {
    id: 'sofa', name: '角落沙發',
    // 美術評分修正 c：退到沙發的左後角、坐低一點，轉向吧台：德叔與吧台是主體，桌子在下面變扁、上面一點暖光
    eye: new THREE.Vector3(-2.75, 0.95, 3.72), look: new THREE.Vector3(2.2, 0.8, -1.5), fov: 62,
    cup: new THREE.Vector3(-1.35, tC.h + 0.02, 2.3), serve: new THREE.Vector3(-0.8, 0, 2.0), table: tC, // 端杯點回到原位（D213）
    prop: paper(A.sofa(), -2.1, 3.3, { base: Math.PI * 0.85, clamp: 0.7, name: 'sofa', overClamp: true }),
  },
];
const stoolMid = paper(A.stool(), 1.3, -2.1);
const stoolFar = paper(A.stool(), 1.3, -2.9); // 凱文的位子：他坐下時，他的圖本身就畫了高腳椅

// 吧台上的手沖架
/* ---------- 吧台上的手沖器具（立體小物，沖煮過程用動作呈現） ---------- */
const TOP = 1.06;
const M = {

  enamelRim: new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: '#3d6b4f' }),
};
const cyl = (rt, rb, h, mat, seg = 24, open = false) => new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(rt, rb, h, seg, 1, open), mat);

// 手搖磨豆機

// 咖啡杯（每次沖煮做一個新的，端走後留在客人桌上）
const CUP_SCALE = 1.25; // 原本直徑 8 公分在手機上太不明顯，放大一點
const CUP_H = 0.07 * CUP_SCALE;
// kind：'hot'（手沖）、'cocoa'（德叔給予安的熱可可）、'iced'（凱文的冰美式）、'enamel'（最後一晚，德叔用那個琺瑯杯）；
// dish：旁邊放一小碟窯烤龍眼乾
// 美術評分修正 e（Q63）：平常的杯子（老闆每天的那杯、熟客、一次客人、凱文的冰美式）都用手繪的 prop_cup_daily（米白馬克杯、赭黃杯緣），
// 德叔的琺瑯杯（prop_cup，白底綠邊）只在最後一晚出現在老闆桌上（劇本：從不讓別人用，最後一晚第一次放在玩家面前）。
// 兩張都裝著咖啡、一直面向鏡頭；沒有載到時用 A.cupDaily()／A.cup() 的 Canvas 杯子（最後一晚的琺瑯杯沒有圖時照舊是立體的杯子，杯緣是綠的，Q59）。
// 凱文的冰美式原本是程式畫的深色玻璃杯（評分：程式畫的），改成平常的杯子、不冒煙
const dailyImg = A.cupDaily();
const dailyArt = A.artLoaded('prop_cup_daily');
const enamelImg = A.cup();
const cupArt = A.artLoaded('prop_cup');
const DAILY_SHRINK = 0.95; // 畫師提醒：馬克杯放進去看起來大約 5%，縮一點才和桌面、手的比例對得上
const NEAR_SHRINK = 0.95; // 美術評分修正 f：老闆自己那杯（沖煮、上桌都是近景）再縮 5%（評審：近景約大 5～10%，中景合適）
// 每個杯子共用；不受光照，夜裡由 applyLight() 調暗。
// 美術評分修正 f：平常的杯子不套色調映射（toneMapped: false）：ACES 會把米白和細的赭黃杯緣一起推亮、洗成白色（評審：看起來像白杯配淡米色邊）
const cupMat = new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: A.tex(dailyImg), alphaTest: 0.35, color: '#f2ece4', toneMapped: false });
const enamelMat = new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: A.tex(enamelImg), alphaTest: 0.35, color: '#f2ece4' });
function cupSprite(g, enamel = false, near = false) {
  const img = enamel ? enamelImg : dailyImg;
  const s = new THREE.Sprite(enamel ? enamelMat : cupMat);
  // 手繪圖裁掉了留白，杯身約 9.5 公分高；Canvas 杯子的畫布上下有留白
  const h = (enamel ? (cupArt ? 0.095 : 0.12) : (dailyArt ? 0.095 * DAILY_SHRINK * (near ? NEAR_SHRINK : 1) : 0.12)) / CUP_SCALE;
  s.scale.set(h * img.width / img.height, h, 1);
  s.center.set(0.5, 0);
  const liquid = new THREE.Object3D(); // 圖裡已經有咖啡：倒進去之前也是滿的（沒有空杯的圖）
  g.add(s, liquid);
  g.userData.liquid = liquid;
  g.userData.sprite = s;
}
// near：老闆自己那杯（stationCup，沖煮與上桌都是近景）
function makeCup(kind = 'hot', dish = false, near = false) {
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.scale.setScalar(CUP_SCALE);
  if (kind === 'enamel' && cupArt) {
    cupSprite(g, true);
    g.userData.enamel = true;
    return g;
  }
  if (kind === 'enamel') {
    const body = cyl(0.04, 0.04, 0.075, M.enamel); body.position.y = 0.0375;
    const rim = cyl(0.0415, 0.0415, 0.01, M.enamelRim, 24, true); rim.position.y = 0.072;
    const handle = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.02, 0.005, 8, 16), M.enamelRim);
    handle.position.set(0.05, 0.04, 0);
    const liquid = cyl(0.037, 0.037, 0.004, M.coffee); liquid.position.y = 0.07; liquid.visible = false;
    g.add(body, rim, handle, liquid);
    g.userData.liquid = liquid;
    g.userData.enamel = true;
    return g;
  }
  if (kind === 'iced') g.userData.iced = true;
  cupSprite(g, false, near);
  if (dish) {
    const plate = cyl(0.035, 0.03, 0.006, M.ceramic); plate.position.set(-0.075, 0.003, 0.05);
    g.add(plate);
    for (const [x, z] of [[-0.085, 0.045], [-0.068, 0.058], [-0.074, 0.038]]) {
      const b = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.009, 8, 6), M.longan);
      b.position.set(x, 0.012, z);
      g.add(b);
    }
  }
  return g;
}
const CUP_SPOT = new THREE.Vector3(1.9, TOP, -1.42); // 美術評分修正 d：往德叔靠一點，看德叔沖的特寫才放得進來

function doorViewTex(night, weather) {

}

const doorMotion = { open: 0, want: 0, holdUntil: 0, bell: 0, phase: 0 };
function swingDoor(holdMs = 1600) {
  doorMotion.want = 1;
  doorMotion.holdUntil = performance.now() + holdMs / speedNow();
  doorMotion.bell = Math.max(doorMotion.bell, 0.6);
}
function ringDoorBell(amount = 0.22) { doorMotion.bell = Math.max(doorMotion.bell, amount); }
function updateDoor(dt) {
  const m = doorMotion;
  if (m.want && performance.now() > m.holdUntil) m.want = 0;
  const k = Math.min(1, dt * (m.want ? 2.4 : 1.6) * speedNow());
  m.open += (m.want - m.open) * k;
  doorLeaf.rotation.y = -m.open * 1.3;
  m.phase += dt * 9;
  m.bell *= Math.exp(-dt * 1.4);
  doorBell.rotation.z = Math.sin(m.phase) * m.bell * 0.6;
}
