    cam.pitch = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(down.pitch - dy * 0.003, -0.35, 0.35);
  } else if (!state.placing) {
    cam.yaw = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(down.yaw - dx * 0.004, -0.6, 0.6);
  }
});
renderer.domElement.addEventListener('pointerup', (e) => {
  if (!down) return;
  const moved = Math.hypot(e.clientX - down.x, e.clientY - down.y);
  const longHold = down.held && performance.now() - down.t > 400; // 按住加速後放開，不算點擊
  const tap = down.far <= 10 && performance.now() - down.t < 700; // 點黑板只算乾脆的一下
  down = null;
  if (moved > 10 || longHold) return;
  const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
  ndc.set(((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1, -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1);
  ray.setFromCamera(ndc, camera);
  if (!state.placing) { if (!(tap && (tapNote(ray) || tapBoard(ray) || tapRoaster(ray)))) talkTo(ray); return; }
  if (state.mode !== 'overview') return;
  const decor = [...decorPapers.values()];
  const hit = ray.intersectObjects(decor.map((d) => d.userData.mesh))[0];
  if (hit) { select(decor.find((d) => d.userData.mesh === hit.object)); return; }
  if (state.selected) {
    const f = ray.intersectObject(floor)[0];
    if (f) {
      moveDecor(state.selected.userData.entry, f.point.x, f.point.z); // 擺放永遠免費；按「確定」才寫回存檔
      select(null);
    }
  }
});

/* ---------- 點人物搭話 ---------- */
NAMES.set(deshu, '德叔').set(yuan, '予安').set(cat, '龍眼').set(zhe, '阿哲').set(kevin, '凱文').set(grandpa, '阿公');
const WHO = { 德叔: deshu, 予安: yuan, 龍眼: cat, 阿哲: zhe, 凱文: kevin }; // tasks.js 台詞裡的說話者
const HEAD = new Map([[deshu, 2.0], [cat, 0.5]]);
const DESHU_HEAD = HEAD.get(deshu); // 凱文坐到老闆旁邊時（D200）先拿掉、回吧台再放回來
// 泡泡的高度：紙片的頭頂（姿勢不同，高度不同）
// 美術評分修正 a：圖的上面常有留白（例如坐著的予安），改用圖裡第一列有畫東西的高度，泡泡與對話鏡頭才對得準頭
const inkCache = new WeakMap();
function inkTop(img) {
  img = img?.canvas || img;
  if (!img?.getContext) return 0;
  if (inkCache.has(img)) return inkCache.get(img);
  let empty = 0;
  try {
    const { data } = img.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, img.width, img.height);
    let row = 0;
    find: for (; row < img.height; row++) for (let x = 3; x < img.width * 4; x += 16) if (data[row * img.width * 4 + x] > 40) break find;
    empty = row < img.height ? row / img.height : 0;
  } catch { empty = 0; }
  inkCache.set(img, empty);
  return empty;
}
const headOf = (p) => {
  const m = p.userData.mesh;
  const h = tallOf(m);
  const fixed = HEAD.get(p);
  return (fixed !== undefined ? fixed * (p.userData.big ?? 1) : h * (1 - inkTop(m.material.map?.image)) + 0.06) + m.position.y; // 龍眼睡在書架上、椅子上時泡泡跟著高
};
const LINES = new Map([
  [deshu, ['不急。', '老闆，今天想坐哪裡？', '水溫九十度，剛好。', '這間店，慢慢會有自己的樣子。']],
]);
// 熟客的台詞依故事進度（story.js 的 TALK）
// 熟客最愛的咖啡（favorites.js）：這位熟客正在找的那一段開放時，一半的機會說那一段的線索
function regularLine(w) {
  const clue = FV.clueLines(save, w);
  if (clue.length && Math.random() < 0.5) return clue[Math.floor(Math.random() * clue.length)];
  const n = save.regulars[w].milestones.length;
  const groups = S.TALK[w].filter((g) => (g.after || 0) <= n);
  const latest = groups[groups.length - 1];
  const pool = Math.random() < 0.6 ? latest.lines : groups.flatMap((g) => g.lines);
  return pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
}
function talkTo(r) {
  if (state.cinematic || state.tutorial === 'enter' || state.scene || state.choice || state.guest || state.arriving || state.favorite) return;
  const people = [deshu, yuan, zhe, kevin, cat].filter((p) => p.visible);
  const hit = r.intersectObjects(people.map((p) => p.userData.mesh))[0];
  if (!hit) return;
  const who = people.find((p) => p.userData.mesh === hit.object);
  if (who === deshu && brewing) return;
  if (who === cat) { petTheCat(); return; } // 摸龍眼（點太多次他會走開）
  let line;
  // 予安的自我介紹：來訪段落的第 2 次（打招呼）演過、或那個窗口過了，才在點她時說（fable 第四節 6；選了「點點頭」的人，名字留到這時候）
  if (who === yuan && !save.flags.metYuan && (!VISITS_ON || VS.yuanIntroReady(save))) { line = '……啊，你好。我叫予安，常坐在這裡寫稿。'; save.flags.metYuan = true; persist(); }
  else if (who === yuan || who === zhe || who === kevin) line = regularLine(who === yuan ? 'yuan' : who === zhe ? 'zhe' : 'kevin');
  else if (who === deshu && keeper() && keeperFavOfferable()) line = keeperLine(); // 坐吧台座、凱文那一段開放：偶爾說那一段的線索（D199）
  else if (who === deshu && keeper()) { const l = state.closing ? F.KEEPER.closingTalk : F.KEEPER.talk; line = l[Math.floor(Math.random() * l.length)]; } // 離開東山之後，吧台後面是凱文
  else if (who === deshu && state.closing) line = H.CLOSING.deshuTalk[Math.floor(Math.random() * H.CLOSING.deshuTalk.length)]; // 打烊後，他在擦杯子
  else if (who === deshu && !noteBarTold && needBarSeat()) { line = TS.BOARD_NOTE.needBar; noteBarTold = true; } // 黑板便條：還沒坐吧台座就想試，先提醒一次
  else { const l = LINES.get(who); line = l[Math.floor(Math.random() * l.length)]; }
  say(line, 3500, who);
  const w = PEOPLE_IDS.find((k) => PEOPLE[k] === who);
  if (w && favOfferable(w)) offerFavorite(w);
  else if (who === deshu && keeperFavOfferable()) offerKeeperDrink();
  else if (who === deshu && trialAgainable()) offerTrialAgain(); // 試咖啡：請德叔再試一杯（D206）
}

/* ---------- 點黑板打開菜單本（承峰 11/3：「做點黑板打開菜單本」，D191） ---------- */
// 坐角落沙發時黑板的字讀不清楚（約 5.7 公尺遠），點黑板就打開和「佈置」→「菜單」同一本菜單本
// 射線碰到的東西是不是實心的：紙片看碰到那一點透不透明（透明的地方不算），淡出的家具、沒有圖的半透明光暈也不算
const solidUv = new THREE.Vector2();
function solidAt(h, glow = true) {
  const m = h.object.material;
  if (Array.isArray(m) || (!m.transparent && !(m.alphaTest > 0))) return true;
  if (m.opacity < 0.35 || !m.visible) return false;
  const img = m.map?.image;
  if (!img || !h.uv) return glow;
  m.map.transformUv(solidUv.copy(h.uv));
  const x = Math.min(img.width - 1, Math.floor(solidUv.x * img.width)), y = Math.min(img.height - 1, Math.floor(solidUv.y * img.height));
  const a = img.data ? img.data[(y * img.width + x) * 4 + 3] : img.getContext?.('2d', { willReadFrequently: true }).getImageData(x, y, 1, 1).data[3] ?? 255;
  return a > Math.max(40, (m.alphaTest || 0) * 255);
}
// 射線最先碰到的實心東西是黑板（層架圖上 A.BOARD 那一塊）時，回傳距離；被吧台、擺飾、人物擋住就是 null
function boardDist(r) {
  const objs = []; scene.traverseVisible((o) => { if (o.isMesh) objs.push(o); });
  const hit = r.intersectObjects(objs, false).find((h) => h.object === boardFace || solidAt(h, false));
  if (!hit || (hit.object !== backBar && hit.object !== boardFace)) return null;
  const u = hit.point.z - (BACK_Z - 1.4), v = backBar.position.y + 0.9 - hit.point.y; // 換回層架圖上的公尺
  const B = A.BOARD;
  return u >= B.x0 && u <= B.x1 && v >= B.y0 && v <= B.y1 ? hit.distance : null;
}
// 什麼時候點黑板會打開：和點人物搭話一樣，演出（開場、讀信後的鏡頭、熟客劇情、選項、客人模式、有人推門進來）時不開；
// 另外開場在店裡的段落、店裡的小事正在演、打烊後的離店與關燈、佈置中、已經有面板開著時也不開
const boardOpenable = () => !state.cinematic && !state.tutorial && !state.scene && !state.choice && !state.guest && !state.arriving
  && !state.placing && !moments.busy && !state.favorite && (!state.closing || state.closing === 'after') && !overlayOpen();
// 點到誰就算誰：德叔、熟客、龍眼站在黑板前面時，點到他們（紙片的範圍）照舊搭話
function tapBoard(r) {
  if (!boardOpenable()) return false;
  const d = boardDist(r);
  if (d === null) return false;
  const people = [deshu, yuan, zhe, kevin, cat].filter((p) => p.visible);
  const person = r.intersectObjects(people.map((p) => p.userData.mesh))[0];
  if (person && person.distance < d) return false;
  // 手指點的時候，放開之後瀏覽器還會補一個 click，落在剛打開的菜單本背景上（點背景會關上）：吃掉這一個
  const eat = (ev) => { ev.stopPropagation(); ev.preventDefault(); };
  window.addEventListener('click', eat, { capture: true, once: true });
  setTimeout(() => window.removeEventListener('click', eat, true), 500);
  openSheet('menu');
  return true;
}
// 用滑鼠時，游標移到黑板上變成手指（手機沒有游標，不另外提示）
let hoverAt = 0;
function hoverBoard(e) {
  if (e.pointerType !== 'mouse' || performance.now() - hoverAt < 120) return;
  hoverAt = performance.now();
  const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
  ndc.set(((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1, -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1);
  ray.setFromCamera(ndc, camera);
  renderer.domElement.style.cursor = (boardOpenable() && (noteDist(ray) !== null || boardDist(ray) !== null)) || (roasterTappable() && roasterDist(ray) !== null) ? 'pointer' : '';
}

/* ---------- 黑板上的便條（承峰 11/7：「便條紙直接貼上黑板好了」；文字與規則在 tasting.js 的 BOARD_NOTE） ---------- */
// 不做箭頭、不做發光：便條一直貼在黑板右上角，點它打開德叔寫的說明（可以一直重讀）。
// 什麼時候點得到和點黑板一樣（boardOpenable()）；點到便條就不打開菜單本。人物站在前面、比便條近時照舊搭話
function noteDist(r) {
  const h = r.intersectObject(noteHit, false)[0];
  if (!h) return null;
  const objs = []; scene.traverseVisible((o) => { if (o.isMesh && o !== backBar && o !== boardFace && o !== noteMesh) objs.push(o); });
  const block = r.intersectObjects(objs, false).find((x) => x.distance < h.distance - 0.02 && solidAt(x, false));
  return block ? null : h.distance;
}
function tapNote(r) {
  if (!boardOpenable()) return false;
  const d = noteDist(r);
  if (d === null) return false;
  const people = [deshu, yuan, zhe, kevin, cat].filter((p) => p.visible);
  const person = r.intersectObjects(people.map((p) => p.userData.mesh))[0];
  if (person && person.distance < d) return false;
  // 和點黑板一樣：手指放開後補的那一個 click 會落在剛打開的面板背景上，吃掉
  const eat = (ev) => { ev.stopPropagation(); ev.preventDefault(); };
  window.addEventListener('click', eat, { capture: true, once: true });
  setTimeout(() => window.removeEventListener('click', eat, true), 500);
  openNote(true);
  return true;
}
function openNote(open) {
  const el = $('note');
  if (!open) { el.hidden = true; syncModal(); updateUI(); return; }
  openAbout(false); openNotebook(false);
  const N = TS.BOARD_NOTE;
  $('note-title').textContent = N.title;
  $('note-sub').textContent = N.sub;
  const body = $('note-body');
  body.innerHTML = '';
  for (const line of N.lines) { const p = document.createElement('p'); p.textContent = line; body.appendChild(p); }
  const sign = document.createElement('p');
  sign.className = 'sign'; sign.textContent = N.sign;
  body.appendChild(sign);
  $('note-close').textContent = N.close;
  el.hidden = false; // 只是讀：配方照劇情開放，讀便條不解鎖任何東西
  syncModal();
  updateUI();
  $('note-close').focus();
}
$('note-close').onclick = () => openNote(false);
$('note').addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (e.target === $('note')) openNote(false); });
// 德叔提一次便條（第一次坐吧台座、第一次打烊後）：走「店裡的小事」的佇列，劇情、交信、選項、有人說話時都等
async function noteHint(kind) {
  TS.markNote(save, kind);
  persist();
  say(kind === 'bar' ? TS.BOARD_NOTE.barHint : TS.BOARD_NOTE.closeHint, 4600, deshu);
  await realWait(5000);
}
// 現在可以提哪一句：坐吧台座的那句在營業中、坐著、德叔閒著時；打烊的那句在最後一杯喝完以後、德叔在吧台、沒在烘豆時。
// 都要店裡安靜（quiet()）、沒有要演的熟客劇情或要交的信（storyBusy()）；凱文顧店以後不提（便條還在，但沒有德叔可以點）
function noteHintDue() {
  if (keeper() || !MOMENTS_ON || moments.busy || !quiet() || storyBusy() || dueLetter(save, letterCtx()) || bubble.classList.contains('show')) return null;
  if (TS.noteHintDue(save, 'bar') && !state.closing && state.mode === 'seat' && state.seat?.id === 'bar' && deshuFree() && !state.arriving && !waiting.approach
    && performance.now() - (state.satAt || 0) > 3000 / DEV_SPEED) return 'bar';
  if (TS.noteHintDue(save, 'close') && state.closing === 'after' && !roasting && !brewing && !deshuReturning && !live.deshuWalk
    && deshu.visible && deshu.position.distanceTo(HOME) < 0.05 && !(REGULARS_ON && F.segmentDue(save, today())?.lastNight)) return 'close';
  return null;
}
let noteBarTold = false; // 還沒坐吧台座就點德叔想試：這次進店提醒過了沒（提醒一次，之後照舊閒聊）

/* ---------- 烘豆（承峰 11/6：「我希望你直接完成這兩項 烘豆……」，D217；roast.js） ---------- */
// 打烊後點店門口右手邊那一角的落地烘豆機（承峰 11/7）：德叔問烘淺一點、深一點，還是剛好（choose()，剛好放最下面）→ 從吧台店門口那一端
// 循路走過去倒生豆、滾筒轉（機器輕輕震、爐口的火光、煙囪冒淡灰的煙）、一爆的細劈啪、下豆到冷卻盤上的竹篩、搖一搖冷卻 → 走回吧台。
// 全部用動作呈現，泡泡只有開頭一句與最後一句（AGENTS：泡泡不描述步驟）。
// 選完那一刻就換掉架上那一批並存檔（中途按「明天見」或關掉也不會白烘）；演的時候用 runMoment()，熟客場景、交信、德叔的話都等它演完。
// 老闆可以坐著看，也可以去做別的事（關燈、寫日記、整理擺飾）；不加溫度、不進任務、不計數量
const ROASTER_SPOT = V3(ROASTER.spot.x, 0, ROASTER.spot.z); // 德叔站在烘豆機左邊、冷卻盤旁（roast.js 的 ROASTER.spot）
let roasting = null; // { level, phase: 'ask'|'walk'|'pour'|'roast'|'drop'|'cool'|'back', k }
const roasterTappable = () => !keeper() && !state.cinematic && !state.tutorial && !state.scene && !state.choice && !state.guest && !state.arriving
  && !state.placing && !state.favorite && !state.letter && !overlayOpen();
// 現在點下去會開始烘：打烊後、德叔在吧台（擦琺瑯杯也算）、沒在沖、沒有別的事在演
const roastOpenable = () => roasterTappable() && state.closing === 'after' && !roasting && !brewing && !deshuReturning && !moments.busy && !live.deshuWalk
  && deshu.position.distanceTo(HOME) < 0.05;
// 射線最先碰到的實心東西是烘豆機時，回傳距離（照 boardDist() 的做法：紙片透明的地方不算、被人擋住不算）
function roasterDist(r) {
  if (!roasterP.visible) return null;
  const objs = []; scene.traverseVisible((o) => { if (o.isMesh) objs.push(o); });
  // 整張紙片的範圍都算（煙囪和機身之間透明的縫也算；手繪圖已經裁掉四周的留白），前面被實心的東西擋住才不算
  const hit = r.intersectObjects(objs, false).find((h) => h.object === roasterP.userData.mesh || solidAt(h, false));
  return hit && hit.object === roasterP.userData.mesh ? hit.distance : null;
}
function tapRoaster(r) {
  if (!roasterTappable()) return false;
  const d = roasterDist(r);
  if (d === null) return false;
  const people = [deshu, yuan, zhe, kevin, cat].filter((p) => p.visible);
  const person = r.intersectObjects(people.map((p) => p.userData.mesh))[0];
  if (person && person.distance < d) return false;
  if (roasting) { if (!bubble.classList.contains('show')) say(RO.ROAST.busy, 2600); return true; } // 【待定】
  if (state.closing !== 'after') { // 開店時（或打烊後還沒喝最後一杯）：德叔說一句，什麼都不會少
    if (!state.closing && !brewing && !sayBusy) say(RO.ROAST.notYet, 3200);
    return !state.closing;
  }
  if (!roastOpenable()) return false;
  startRoast();
  return true;
}
async function startRoast(pick = null) {
  if (!roastOpenable()) return false;
  roasting = { level: '', phase: 'ask', k: 0 };
  const ch = RO.roastChoices();
  const level = pick && RO.LEVELS.includes(pick) ? pick : ch[await choose(ch.map((c) => c.text), RO.ROAST.ask, '德叔')].level;
  RO.roastBatch(save, level, today(), now());
  persist();
  roasting.level = level;
  runMoment('roast', level, () => roastShow(level)).finally(() => { roasting = null; updateUI(); });
  return true;
}
async function roastShow(level) {
  const R = roasting, m = deshu.userData.mesh, drum = roasterP.userData.mesh;
  const T = RO.TIMING;
  say(RO.ROAST.start, 2200);
  R.phase = 'walk';
  await deshuGo(ROASTER_SPOT);
  // 1. 倒生豆：德叔手上的生豆往上一倒、一顆一顆落進機器頂上的入豆漏斗（淡綠的小點）
  R.phase = 'pour';
  setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.pour);
  const fall = [];
  const top = onRoaster(RA.hopper, V3(0, 0, 0));
  const hand = V3(deshu.position.x + 0.22, 1.15, deshu.position.z + 0.05);
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
    const b = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.012, 6, 5), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: RO.BEAN_COLOR.green }));
    b.visible = false;
    scene.add(b);
    fall.push(b);
  }
  audio.play('tray');
  await animate(T.pour, (k) => {
    onRoaster(RA.hopper, top);
    fall.forEach((b, i) => {
      const kk = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(k * 1.6 - i * 0.05, 0, 1);
      b.visible = kk > 0 && kk < 1;
      // 從手上拋一個小弧線到漏斗口（最高點比漏斗口高 0.15 公尺）
      b.position.lerpVectors(hand, top, kk);
      b.position.x += (i % 3 - 1) * 0.012;
      b.position.y += Math.sin(Math.PI * kk) * 0.15 + 0.02;
      b.position.z += i % 2 ? 0.012 : -0.012;
    });
  });
  for (const b of fall) { scene.remove(b); b.geometry.dispose(); b.material.dispose(); }
  // 2. 烘：滾筒轉（大台的機器只輕輕震，德叔跟著小幅搖）、爐口的火光淡入、煙囪冒淡灰的煙；一爆的時候細細的劈啪幾下
  R.phase = 'roast';
  setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.idle);
  audio.start('roast');
  const smoke = onRoaster(RA.smoke, V3(0, 0, 0), 0);
  let pops = 0;
  await animate(T.roast[level] || T.roast.medium, (k) => {
    R.k = k;
    const t = performance.now();
    drum.rotation.z = Math.sin(t / 60) * 0.0025;
    m.rotation.z = Math.sin(t / 340) * 0.03;
    placeRoastFx();
    onRoaster(RA.smoke, smoke, 0);
    roastFlame.material.opacity = Math.min(1, k * 6) * (0.55 + 0.15 * Math.sin(t / 90) + 0.1 * Math.sin(t / 37));
    if (k > 0.25) smokeSources.add(smoke);
    // 一爆：從 crack 那一刻起，間隔一下劈啪一次，共四次
    if (pops < 4 && k >= T.crack + pops * 0.035) { pops++; audio.play('crack'); }
  });
  audio.stop('roast');
  smokeSources.delete(smoke);
  drum.rotation.z = 0;
  m.rotation.z = 0;
  // 3. 下豆：冷卻盤上的竹篩出現，豆子一顆一顆倒進去（顏色就是這一批）
  R.phase = 'drop';
  setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.serve);
  roastBeanMat.color.set(RO.BEAN_COLOR[level]);
  roastBeans.forEach((b) => { b.visible = false; b.position.y = b.userData.y; });
  roastTray.rotation.y = 0;
  placeRoastFx();
  roastTray.visible = true;
  audio.play('tray');
  await animate(T.drop, (k) => {
    placeRoastFx();
    roastFlame.material.opacity = Math.max(0, 0.6 * (1 - k * 2));
    roastBeans.forEach((b, i) => { b.visible = i < Math.ceil(k * roastBeans.length); });
  });
  roastFlame.material.opacity = 0;
  // 4. 冷卻：搖一搖竹篩，豆子跳一下
  R.phase = 'cool';
  let shook = 0;
  await animate(T.cool, (k) => {
    const t = performance.now();
    placeRoastFx();
    const shake = Math.sin(k * Math.PI * 10) * Math.sin(Math.PI * k);
    roastTray.rotation.y = shake * 0.25;
    roastBeans.forEach((b, i) => { b.position.y = b.userData.y + Math.max(0, Math.sin(t / 70 + i * 1.7)) * 0.006 * Math.abs(shake); });
    if (shook < 2 && k > 0.2 + shook * 0.4) { shook++; audio.play('tray'); }
  });
  roastTray.rotation.y = 0;
  roastBeans.forEach((b) => { b.position.y = b.userData.y; });
  setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.idle);
  say(RO.ROAST.done[level], 4200);
  await wait(2.2);
  // 走回吧台；竹篩收起來（豆子進了架上那一罐）
  R.phase = 'back';
  roastTray.visible = false;
  await deshuGo(HOME);
  deshu.userData.mesh.position.y = 0;
}

// 測試用（__cafe.boardView()）：畫面上的這幾點裡，離 (cx, cy) 最近、點下去會算點到黑板的一點
function tapPoint(pts, cx, cy) {
  const r = new THREE.Raycaster(), n = new THREE.Vector2(), W = app.clientWidth, H = app.clientHeight;
  const people = [deshu, yuan, zhe, kevin, cat].filter((p) => p.visible).map((p) => p.userData.mesh);
  for (const q of [...pts].sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - cx, a.y - cy) - Math.hypot(b.x - cx, b.y - cy))) {
    r.setFromCamera(n.set((q.x / W) * 2 - 1, 1 - (q.y / H) * 2), camera);
    const d = boardDist(r), person = r.intersectObjects(people)[0];
    if (d === null || (person && person.distance < d)) continue;
    const o = app.getBoundingClientRect(); // pageX／pageY：整個頁面上的座標（桌機的 #app 在中間），page.mouse.click／page.touchscreen.tap 直接用
    return { x: Math.round(q.x), y: Math.round(q.y), pageX: Math.round(q.x + o.left), pageY: Math.round(q.y + o.top), ok: boardOpenable() };
  }
  return null;
}

/* ---------- 開場：推門進店（第三幕後半）與第一杯（第四幕） ---------- */
// 第一幕到第三幕前半是 DOM 畫面（src/opening.js），推門之後在 3D 店裡演
const realWait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms / DEV_SPEED)); // 開發者模式的倍率也縮短等待
const tsay = (text, ms) => say(text, ms / DEV_SPEED);
const DOOR = { from: new THREE.Vector3(0.1, 1.6, 3.9), to: new THREE.Vector3(0.45, 1.55, 2.9), look: new THREE.Vector3(2.6, 1.45, -1.6) };
let tutToken = 0; // 略過時讓還在等的段落作廢

function startOpening() {
  const op = runOpening({ root: $('opening'), save, persist, art: A, speed: DEV_SPEED, sound: { stage: () => applySound(), play: (n) => audio.play(n) } });
  op.done.then(({ lines }) => enterShop(lines));
  openingCtl = op;
  applySound();
}
let openingCtl = null;

async function enterShop(lines) {
  const my = ++tutToken;
  state.tutorial = 'enter';
  if (!lines) { beginAct4(); return; }
  state.mode = 'door';
  ceiling.visible = true;
  cam.yaw = 0; cam.pitch = 0;
  cam.pos.copy(DOOR.from); cam.look.copy(DOOR.look);
  moveCamera(DOOR.to, DOOR.look, 2.6); // 推門進去，往吧台走兩步
  audio.play('door'); audio.play('bell');
  updateUI();
  catVisit(V3(1.45, 0, 0.55), 25); // 美術評分修正 e：德叔說「那隻貓叫龍眼」的時候，龍眼走到吧台前面坐下（畫面下方原本是空的地板）
  await realWait(1700);
  // 劇本第三幕：吧台後的人抬頭
  for (const line of ['老闆，歡迎回來。', '哦，是第一次來。習慣了，對每個人都這樣說。', '那隻貓叫龍眼，是這間三合院本來就有的。他不是我們的，是我們是他的。']) {
    if (my !== tutToken) return;
    tsay(line, 3900);
    await realWait(4300);
  }
  if (my === tutToken) beginAct4();
}

// 第四幕 1：「先坐。」教玩家點椅子坐下
function beginAct4() {
  const my = ++tutToken;
  if (state.mode !== 'overview') {
    state.mode = 'overview';
    frontWall.visible = false;
    ceiling.visible = false;
    cam.yaw = 0; cam.pitch = 0;
    moveCamera(OVER.pos, OVER.look, 1.6);
  }
  if (save.stats.cups >= 1) { tutorialAfterCup(false); return; } // 喝過第一杯才重新整理的話，從送擺飾接著演
  state.tutorial = 'sit';
  updateUI();
  setTimeout(() => { if (my === tutToken && state.tutorial === 'sit') tsay('先坐。', 4000); }, 900 / DEV_SPEED);
}

// 第四幕 4～5：杯子上桌後德叔說「店是空的……」、送三件初始擺飾，溫度計從 20°C 爬到 20.5°C，德叔看了一眼溫度計
async function tutorialAfterCup(justServed) {
  const my = ++tutToken;
  state.tutorial = 'gift';
  updateUI();
  if (justServed) await realWait(4800); // 先讓「東山的豆，就是窗外那片山。」說完
  if (my !== tutToken) return;
  tsay('店是空的。老闆，你想坐在什麼樣的店裡？', 5000);
  giveStarters(save);
  save.flags.storeHint = true; // 送擺飾這句已經說了，佈置時不用再提醒
  persist();
  await realWait(1600);
  if (my !== tutToken) return;
  checkTasks({ delay: 99999 }); // 第一杯：溫度上升與撥款（這個任務沒有台詞）
  (async () => { if (deshuReturning) await deshuReturning; await glance(deshu); })(); // 「德叔看了一眼溫度計，沒說話。」
  await realWait(3800);
  if (my !== tutToken) return;
  // 【待定】送三件初始擺飾時德叔說的話（劇本只寫「送三件初始擺飾」）
  tsay('倉庫裡有三件，是我替老闆準備的開店禮。', 4200);
  state.tutorial = 'choose';
  updateUI();
}

// 開場結束：之後重新整理就直接進店
function endOpening() {
  tutToken++;
  state.tutorial = null;
  save.flags.seenOpening = true;
  delete save.flags.openingAct;
  giveStarters(save);
  persist();
  updateUI();
  checkTasks({ delay: 1200 }); // 略過第四幕時，已經上桌的第一杯照樣算數
  readyAt = performance.now() + 6000 / DEV_SPEED;
  startDay(); // 開店第一天：阿哲會拎著龍眼乾來
}

$('tut-place').onclick = () => {
  endOpening();
  if (state.seat) stand();
  startPlacing();
  openSheet('store');
};
$('tut-later').onclick = () => { endOpening(); glowFund(); };
// 「略過開場」：第三幕後半略過就到第四幕，第四幕略過就直接結束
$('op-skip-shop').onclick = () => {
  if (state.tutorial === 'enter') { beginAct4(); return; }
  if (state.mode === 'door') { state.mode = 'overview'; ceiling.visible = false; moveCamera(OVER.pos, OVER.look); }
  endOpening();
};

/* ---------- 德叔的營業日誌 ---------- */
const journalEl = $('journal');
let journalDone = null;
function openJournal(page, onClose = null) {
  journalDone = onClose;
  $('jr-title').textContent = page.keeper ? '凱文的營業日誌' : '德叔的營業日誌'; // 離開東山之後，凱文寫
  const body = $('jr-body');
  body.innerHTML = '';
  const n = page.days.length + (page.summary ? 1 : 0);
  // 【待定】日誌抬頭的一句
  $('jr-sub').textContent = page.summary || n > 1 ? `老闆不在的這幾天，店裡的事。` : '老闆不在的時候，店裡的事。';
  const add = (tag, cls, text) => { const el = document.createElement(tag); el.className = cls; el.textContent = text; body.appendChild(el); return el; };
  if (page.summary) {
    add('p', 'jr-sum', page.summary);
    if (page.notes.length) {
      const ul = add('ul', 'jr-list', '');
      for (const t of page.notes) { const li = document.createElement('li'); li.textContent = t; ul.appendChild(li); }
    }
  }
  for (const d of page.days) {
    add('h3', 'jr-day', `${d.date}・第 ${d.day} 天${d.rain ? '・雨' : ''}`);
    const ul = add('ul', 'jr-list', '');
    for (const t of d.lines) { const li = document.createElement('li'); li.textContent = t; ul.appendChild(li); }
  }
  journalEl.hidden = false;
  body.scrollTop = 0;
  $('jr-close').focus();
}
function closeJournal() {
  journalEl.hidden = true;
  const fn = journalDone;
  journalDone = null;
  fn?.();
}
$('jr-close').onclick = closeJournal;
journalEl.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (e.target === journalEl) closeJournal(); });

/* ---------- 老先生的信 ---------- */
const letterEl = $('letter');
let letterDone = null;
// 手寫的信：每個字一點點歪，看起來字有點抖（同一封信每次打開都抖得一樣）
// 避頭點（美術評分修正 b）：每個字各自是一個 inline-block，瀏覽器的 line-break 管不到，
// 所以句號、逗號、後引號這類不能放在行首的字，和前一個字包在一起；前引號和後一個字包在一起
const NO_START = new Set([...'，。、；：！？」』）〉》…—,.!?']);
const NO_END = new Set([...'「『（〈《']);
function shaky(text, seed) {
  let s = seed;
  const r = () => ((s = (s * 16807) % 2147483647) / 2147483647);
  const groups = [];
  let glue = false;
  for (const ch of text) {
    if (groups.length && (glue || NO_START.has(ch))) groups[groups.length - 1].push(ch);
    else groups.push([ch]);
    glue = NO_END.has(ch);
  }
  const one = (ch) => `<i style="transform:rotate(${((r() - 0.5) * 5).toFixed(1)}deg) translateY(${((r() - 0.5) * 1.6).toFixed(1)}px)">${ch}</i>`;
  return groups.map((g) => (g.length === 1 ? one(g[0]) : `<span class="nb">${g.map(one).join('')}</span>`)).join('');
}
function openLetter(letter, onClose = null) {
  letterDone = onClose;
  const hand = letter.hand ?? letter !== LAWYER_LETTER; // 律師信是印刷的，其他是手寫的
  letterEl.querySelector('.card').classList.toggle('hand', hand);
  $('lt-title').textContent = letter.title;
  $('lt-body').innerHTML = letter.paragraphs
    .map((p, i) => `<p>${letter.shaky ? shaky(p, 97 + i * 31) : p.replace(/[<>&]/g, '')}</p>`).join('');
  letterEl.hidden = false;
  $('lt-body').scrollTop = 0;
  $('lt-close').focus();
}
function closeLetter() {
  letterEl.hidden = true;
  const fn = letterDone;
  letterDone = null;
  fn?.();
}
$('lt-close').onclick = closeLetter;
letterEl.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (e.target === letterEl) closeLetter(); });

// 交信要等店裡安靜下來：開場結束、沒在沖咖啡、沒在佈置、沒有打開的面板、德叔沒在說話
let readyAt = Infinity;
const overlayOpen = () => [about, notebook, sheet, journalEl, letterEl, $('opening'), $('diary'), $('closed'), $('map'), $('photo'), $('tune'), $('note')].some((el) => !el.hidden);
// 彈窗打開時，場景上的標籤、提示、泡泡、按鈕列都收起來（index.html 的 #app.modal；美術評分修正 b）。
// 任何彈窗的 hidden 一變就馬上切換，不等下一格
const syncModal = () => app.classList.toggle('modal', overlayOpen());
const modalWatch = new MutationObserver(syncModal);
for (const el of [about, notebook, sheet, journalEl, letterEl, $('opening'), $('diary'), $('closed'), $('map'), $('photo'), $('tune'), $('note')]) modalWatch.observe(el, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['hidden'] });
syncModal();
function quiet() {
  return save.flags.seenOpening && !state.tutorial && !state.letter && !state.cinematic && !state.scene && !state.choice && !brewing && !deshuReturning && !state.placing && !moments.busy && !state.favorite
    && !state.guest && (!state.closing || state.closing === 'after') && !overlayOpen() && !sayBusy && performance.now() > Math.max(readyAt, sayEnds + 1500 / DEV_SPEED);
}
const letterCtx = () => ({ daysOpen: today(), temp: temperature(save) });
setInterval(() => {
  if (!quiet()) return;
  const l = dueLetter(save, letterCtx());
  if (l) deliverLetter(l);
}, 1000);

// 德叔從吧台抽屜拿出來，放在吧台上
async function deliverLetter(letter) {
  state.letter = letter;
  updateUI();
  setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.pour); // 彎腰拉開抽屜
  await realWait(700);
  setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.idle);
  envelope.visible = true;
  envelope.userData.mesh.position.y = TOP - 0.12;
  await animate(0.6, (k) => { envelope.userData.mesh.position.y = TOP - 0.12 + 0.12 * ease(k); });
  say(letter.give(letterCtx()), 4200);
}

$('read-letter').onclick = () => {
  const letter = state.letter;
  if (!letter) return;
  openLetter(letter, () => {
    markRead(save, letter.id, now(), today());
    persist();
    state.letter = null;
    envelope.visible = false;
    if (letter.id === 'second') departScene(); // 離開東山的早上：讀完就出發
    else wipeScene();
  });
};

// 讀完信，往德叔看：他正在擦那個琺瑯杯，沒抬頭
const WIPE = { pos: new THREE.Vector3(0.9, 1.55, -0.35), look: new THREE.Vector3(2.6, 1.3, -1.6) };
async function wipeScene() {
  state.cinematic = true;
  bubble.classList.remove('show'); // 德叔沒抬頭，也沒說話
  updateUI();
  const seat = state.mode === 'seat' ? state.seat : null;
  ceiling.visible = true;
  cam.yaw = 0; cam.pitch = 0;
  moveCamera(WIPE.pos, WIPE.look, 1.6);
  const tex = { wipe: A.tex(deshuCanvas.wipe), wipe2: A.tex(deshuCanvas.wipe2) };
  const mat = deshu.userData.mesh.material;
  const idleMap = mat.map;
  let t = 0, frame = -1;
  await new Promise((done) => realWaiters.push((dt) => {
    t += dt * DEV_SPEED;
    const f = Math.floor(t / 0.5);
    if (f !== frame) { frame = f; mat.map = f % 2 ? tex.wipe2 : tex.wipe; if (mat.emissiveMap) mat.emissiveMap = mat.map; mat.needsUpdate = true; }
    if (t > 6.5) { done(); return true; }
    return false;
  }));
  if (seat && state.seat === seat) moveCamera(seat.eye, seat.look);
  else { ceiling.visible = false; moveCamera(OVER.pos, OVER.look); }
  await realWait(1500);
  mat.map = idleMap;
  if (mat.emissiveMap) mat.emissiveMap = idleMap;
  mat.needsUpdate = true;
  tex.wipe.dispose(); tex.wipe2.dispose();
  state.cinematic = false;
  readyAt = performance.now() + 4000 / DEV_SPEED;
  updateUI();
}

/* ---------- 三位熟客：在店裡的一天（里程碑引擎在 src/story.js） ---------- */
// 老闆在店裡時，今天會來的熟客依自己的習慣出現：予安整天坐窗邊、阿哲不固定、凱文下午五點。
// 走進店裡就記一次來店；可以演的里程碑等店裡安靜下來（和交信一樣）才演，「在場」里程碑一天最多一個。
const V2 = (x, z) => new THREE.Vector3(x, 0, z);
const DOOR_IN = V2(0.15, 3.7);
// 每個人的位子：pos 站或坐的地方、cup 德叔把杯子放在哪裡（null 就拿在手上）、counter 在吧台前（德叔從吧台裡面遞）、stool 會被擋住的高腳椅
const SPOT = {
  yuan: { pos: V2(-0.4, -1.75), cup: new THREE.Vector3(-0.22, tY.h + 0.02, -2.15) },
  kevin: { pos: V2(1.3, -2.9), cup: new THREE.Vector3(1.72, TOP, -2.9), counter: true, stool: stoolFar },
  bar: { pos: V2(1.3, -0.2), cup: new THREE.Vector3(1.72, TOP, -0.2), counter: true },
};
// 凱文坐到老闆對面（依老闆坐的位子）
const OPPOSITE = {
  window: { pos: V2(-2.35, -1.3), cup: new THREE.Vector3(-2.2, tA.h + 0.02, -0.85) },
  bar: { pos: V2(1.3, -2.1), cup: new THREE.Vector3(1.72, TOP, -2.1), counter: true, stool: stoolMid },
  sofa: { pos: V2(-0.85, 1.75), cup: new THREE.Vector3(-1.2, tC.h + 0.02, 2.2) },
};
// 角落的候選位置（凱文躲起來、阿公坐的地方）。店門口右手邊那一角放了落地烘豆機（承峰 11/7）：原本的 (2.35, 3.1) 在機器裡面，
// 往店裡挪到機器前面、靠右牆的 (2.45, 2.5)
const CORNERS = [V2(-2.45, -3.3), V2(-1.3, -3.45), V2(0.75, -3.45), V2(2.45, 2.5), V2(-0.55, 3.35), V2(0.75, 3.4)];
const HOME_SPOT = { yuan: SPOT.yuan, kevin: SPOT.kevin, zhe: SPOT.bar };

const live = { day: 0, token: 0, expect: new Map(), arrived: new Set(), leaveAt: new Map(), at: {}, answers: {}, cups: new Map(), seatHinted: false, walking: 0, planned: {}, held: new Set(), fwHinted: 0, trialOfferHint: '' };
seatOf = (w) => (live.at[w]?.stool ? 'stool' : 'chair');
const ABORT = Symbol('abort');
const PEOPLE_IDS = ['yuan', 'zhe', 'kevin', 'grandpa'];
const defaultPose = (w) => (w === 'yuan' ? 'type'
  : w === 'kevin' ? (S.hasMilestone(save, 'kevin', 5) ? 'free' : 'sit')
  : w === 'zhe' ? (save.story.typhoonDay === today() ? 'towel' : 'stand')
  : 'sit');

// 角落：挑一個沒有擺飾、也沒有人的地方；老闆坐著的話，挑他轉頭看得到的那個
function freeCorner(w) {
  const near = (v, x, z, r) => Math.hypot(x - v.x, z - v.z) < r;
  const busy = (v) => [...decorPapers.values()].some((d) => near(v, d.position.x, d.position.z, 0.6))
    || [...PEOPLE_IDS.filter((o) => o !== w).map((o) => PEOPLE[o]), cat].some((p) => p.visible && near(v, p.position.x, p.position.z, 0.6));
  const s = state.mode === 'seat' ? state.seat : null;
  const ang = (x, z) => Math.atan2(x - s.eye.x, z - s.eye.z);
  // 從座位看過去，被比較近的人擋住的角落不選（例如阿公坐在予安正後方）
  const blocked = (v) => PEOPLE_IDS.some((o) => o !== w && PEOPLE[o].visible
    && Math.hypot(PEOPLE[o].position.x - s.eye.x, PEOPLE[o].position.z - s.eye.z) < Math.hypot(v.x - s.eye.x, v.z - s.eye.z)
    && Math.abs(wrapAngle(ang(PEOPLE[o].position.x, PEOPLE[o].position.z) - ang(v.x, v.z))) < 0.3);
  const turn = (v) => {
    if (!s) return 0;
    const b = s.look.clone().sub(s.eye);
    return Math.abs(wrapAngle(ang(v.x, v.z) - Math.atan2(b.x, b.z))) + (blocked(v) ? 3 : 0);
  };
  const free = CORNERS.filter((v) => !busy(v));
  const best = (free.length ? free : CORNERS).slice().sort((a, b) => turn(a) - turn(b))[0];
  return { pos: best.clone(), cup: null };
}
function spotFor(w, at) {
  if (at === 'home') return HOME_SPOT[w];
  if (at === 'bar') return SPOT.bar;
  if (at === 'opposite') return OPPOSITE[state.seat?.id] || SPOT.bar;
  if (at === 'corner') return freeCorner(w);
  if (at === 'cornerSide') { // 阿哲站在阿公旁邊
    const g = live.planned.grandpa?.pos || live.at.grandpa?.pos || CORNERS[2];
    return { pos: V2(g.x + (g.x > 0.5 ? -0.6 : 0.6), g.z - 0.1), cup: null };
  }
  return HOME_SPOT[w] || SPOT.bar;
}

// 走完回傳 true；中途被新的一段取代就停下來、回傳 false
async function walkPath(p, pts, speed, own = false) {
  for (const pt of pts) if (!(await walk(p, pt, speed, own))) return false;
  p.userData.mesh.position.y = 0;
  return true;
}
// 坐上高腳椅、椅子不收起來（D215：椅子一律保留拉開的狀態）；人物的紙片畫在同一個位置的高腳椅前面（PEOPLE 的 polygonOffset）
function settle(w, spot) {
  live.at[w] = spot;
  PEOPLE[w].position.set(spot.pos.x, 0, spot.pos.z);
}
function placeAt(w, spot, pose) {
  settle(w, spot); // 先坐定位，setPose 才知道他坐的是高腳椅還是椅子
  setPose(w, pose || defaultPose(w));
  PEOPLE[w].visible = true;
}
const walkSpeed = (w, fast) => (fast ? 1.3 : w === 'grandpa' ? 0.45 : 0.75);
async function enterPerson(w, spot, walkPose, thenPose, fast) {
  const p = PEOPLE[w];
  const tok = live.token;
  setPose(w, walkPose || (w === 'kevin' ? 'walk' : 'stand'));
  p.position.copy(DOOR_IN);
  p.visible = true;
  if (!(w === 'grandpa' && PEOPLE.zhe.visible && PEOPLE.zhe.position.distanceTo(DOOR_IN) < 1)) audio.play('bell'); // 有人推門進來（阿公跟在阿哲後面，鈴只響一次）
  swingDoor(w === 'grandpa' ? 3200 : 1600); // 阿公走得慢：門開久一點
  waiting.approach = null; waiting.quietFrom = performance.now();
  if (!(await walkPath(p, [spot.pos], walkSpeed(w, fast), true))) return; // 走到一半就要離開了（打烊）
  if (tok !== live.token) return; // 走到一半換了一天（開發者跳天數）
  settle(w, spot);
  setPose(w, thenPose || defaultPose(w));
}
async function movePerson(w, spot, walkPose, thenPose) {
  const p = PEOPLE[w];
  const tok = live.token;
  if (walkPose) setPose(w, walkPose);
  if (!(await walkPath(p, [spot.pos], walkSpeed(w), true))) return;
  if (tok !== live.token) return;
  settle(w, spot);
  setPose(w, thenPose || defaultPose(w));
}
async function leavePerson(w) {
  const p = PEOPLE[w];
  if (!p.visible) return;
  live.arrived.delete(w);
  delete live.at[w];
  removeGuestCup(w);
  setPose(w, w === 'kevin' ? 'walk' : w === 'grandpa' || w === 'yuan' ? 'stand' : poses[w]); // 予安站起來走（Canvas 版站著與坐著是同一張）
  const tok = live.token;
  const out = await walkPath(p, [DOOR_IN], walkSpeed(w), true);
  if (out && tok === live.token) { p.visible = false; swingDoor(1000); if (w !== 'grandpa') audio.play('bell'); }
}
function removeGuestCup(w) {
  const c = live.cups.get(w);
  if (!c) return;
  c.parent?.remove(c);
  const i = cups.indexOf(c);
  if (i >= 0) cups.splice(i, 1);
  live.cups.delete(w);
}

// 接正式美術：德叔端杯子走過去時換成 serve 的圖（圖裡手上已經端著杯子），立體的杯子先藏起來；
// 到了再從圖裡杯子的位置拿出來放下。Canvas 版與凱文顧店時沒有這張圖（cupAt），照舊拿著立體的杯子走
function carryCup(cup) {
  const c = deshuCanvas.serve;
  if (!c.cupAt) return false;
  setPaper(deshu, c);
  cup.visible = false;
  return true;
}
function putDownCup(cup, carried) {
  if (!carried) return;
  const [x, y] = deshuCanvas.serve.cupAt;
  cup.position.set(x, y, 0.08);
  cup.visible = true;
  setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.idle);
}
// 德叔站在吧台後面、沒在做事的時候的小動作：溫度升高時拿起老溫度計看一眼、任務完成的那句話時笑一下（只有手繪圖有這兩張）
async function deshuMoment(pose, ms) {
  const c = deshuCanvas[pose];
  if (!c?.art || keeper() || brewing || wipeOn || state.cinematic || state.scene) return false;
  if (deshu.userData.art !== deshuCanvas.idle || deshu.position.distanceTo(HOME) > 0.05) return false;
  setPaper(deshu, c);
  await realWait(ms);
  if (deshu.userData.art !== c) return false; // 中途有別的動作換過圖了
  setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.idle);
  return true;
}

// 德叔走過去：吧台是碰撞物（navBlockers()），要去吧台裡面或外面時循路自己從吧台兩端（店門口那一端或最裡端的空隙）挑近的繞
const behindBar = (v) => v.x > 1.7 && v.z < 0.5;
async function deshuGo(target) {
  while (live.deshuWalk) await live.deshuWalk; // 上一段還沒走完（場景裡「不等德叔走回去」的那一步）
  await walkPath(deshu, [target], WALK);
}
// 站在某人旁邊的位置（吧台前的人，德叔從吧台裡面）
function nearSpot(w) {
  const spot = live.at[w];
  const pos = spot?.pos || PEOPLE[w].position;
  if (spot?.counter) return V2(2.5, behindBarZ(PEOPLE[w], pos.z));
  return V2(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(pos.x + (pos.x < 0.45 ? 0.5 : -0.5), -2.7, 2.7), THREE.MathUtils.clamp(pos.z + 0.12, -3.7, 3.6));
}

// art2b：吧台前的人，德叔從吧台裡面走到他對面時，在吧台裡錯開一點（評審：颱風夜阿哲正好站在德叔前面，看起來像一個雙頭人）。
// 從現在的鏡頭看過去，兩個人畫出來的範圍（左右）不能重疊：在吧台裡面（z −3.0～0）找離那個人最近、又不重疊的位置；
// 怎麼放都重疊時，挑分得最開的
const barProbe = new THREE.Vector3();
function behindBarZ(p, z) {
  camera.updateMatrixWorld();
  const right = new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0).applyQuaternion(camera.quaternion);
  const span = (x, zz, half) => {
    const xs = [-1, 1].map((sg) => { barProbe.set(x, 1.0, zz).addScaledVector(right, sg * half).project(camera); return barProbe.x; });
    return [Math.min(...xs), Math.max(...xs)];
  };
  const halfOf = (q) => q.userData.mesh.geometry.parameters.width * drawnHalf(q.userData.mesh.material.map?.image);
  const [a0, a1] = span(p.position.x, p.position.z, halfOf(p) * 0.85);
  const dh = halfOf(deshu) * 0.85;
  let best = z, bestGap = -Infinity;
  for (let k = 0; k <= 12; k++) for (const sg of k ? [-1, 1] : [1]) {
    const zz = z + sg * k * 0.1;
    if (zz < -3.0 || zz > 0) continue;
    const [b0, b1] = span(2.5, zz, dh);
    const gap = Math.max(b0 - a1, a0 - b1); // 正的＝分開了多少（NDC）
    if (gap > 0.04) return zz;
    if (gap > bestGap) { bestGap = gap; best = zz; }
  }
  return best;
}

// 德叔端東西給熟客：從吧台拿杯子，走過去放在他桌上（沒有桌子就交到他手上）
// dish：杯子旁邊附一小碟龍眼乾（老闆請熟客的那杯，黑板上有點心時）
async function serveTo(w, kind, dish = false) {
  removeGuestCup(w);
  await deshuGo(HOME);
  const cup = makeCup(kind, dish);
  if (cup.userData.liquid && kind !== 'iced') cup.userData.liquid.visible = true;
  setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.pour);
  await wait(0.6);
  setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.idle);
  deshu.attach(cup);
  cup.position.set(0.32, 0.98, 0.12);
  const carried = carryCup(cup);
  await deshuGo(nearSpot(w));
  deshu.userData.mesh.position.y = 0;
  putDownCup(cup, carried);
  scene.attach(cup);
  const spot = live.at[w];
  if (spot?.cup) {
    const from = cup.position.clone();
    await animate(0.7, (k) => { cup.position.lerpVectors(from, spot.cup, ease(k)); cup.position.y += Math.sin(Math.PI * k) * 0.05; });
    placeCup(cup, { id: 'guest:' + w, cup: spot.cup });
    if (kind === 'iced') cup.userData.age = 999; // 冰的不冒煙
  } else {
    PEOPLE[w].attach(cup);
    cup.position.set(0, 0.5, 0.08);
    cup.rotation.set(0, 0, 0);
  }
  live.cups.set(w, cup);
}

// 龍眼走到某人身邊：lap＝跳上他的腿（凱文），不然就睡在旁邊（予安念稿）
async function catTo(w, lap) {
  while (catBusy) await realWait(200);
  catBusy = true;
  catAtHome = false;
  catOnSeat = null;
  catHoldUntil = performance.now() + 120000 / DEV_SPEED;
  catVisiting = false; // 陪熟客的停留，老闆坐窗邊座也不中斷
  const p = PEOPLE[w];
  const toCam = V2(camera.position.x - p.position.x, camera.position.z - p.position.z).setLength(lap ? 0.14 : 0.45);
  const target = p.position.clone().add(toCam);
  setPaper(cat, catCanvas.walk);
  cat.userData.shadow.visible = true;
  if (cat.userData.mesh.position.y > 0.02) await catHop(0); // 睡在窗台上、椅子上的話，先跳下來
  cat.userData.mesh.position.y = 0;
  await walk(cat, target, 0.6);
  if (lap) { setPaper(cat, catCanvas.sit); await animate(0.4, (k) => { cat.userData.mesh.position.y = 0.48 * ease(k) + Math.sin(Math.PI * k) * 0.12; }); }
  else { cat.userData.mesh.position.y = 0; setPaper(cat, catCanvas.sleep); }
  catBusy = false;
}

// 德叔把音樂調小：走到黑膠唱機或收音機旁（沒有的話就是吧台後面的音響），音符縮小、淡掉
const noteTex = A.tex(A.note());
async function musicDown() {
  audio.duck(0.35, 120); // 真的把音樂調小
  const src = [...decorPapers.values()].find((d) => d.userData.item.id === 'record-player' || d.userData.item.id === 'radio');
  const pos = src ? src.position.clone() : V2(2.85, -1.6);
  const sprite = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: noteTex, transparent: true, depthWrite: false }));
  sprite.position.set(pos.x, src ? 0.95 : 2.35, pos.z);
  sprite.scale.setScalar(0.32);
  scene.add(sprite);
  await deshuGo(src ? V2(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(pos.x + (pos.x < 0 ? 0.55 : -0.55), -2.6, 2.6), pos.z + 0.2) : HOME);
  setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.pour);
  await animate(1.6, (k) => { sprite.scale.setScalar(0.32 - 0.2 * k); sprite.material.opacity = 1 - 0.6 * k; });
  setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.idle);
  animate(2, (k) => { sprite.material.opacity = 0.4 * (1 - k); }).then(() => { scene.remove(sprite); sprite.material.dispose(); });
}

// 笑：紙片輕輕跳兩下（不用泡泡描述動作）
async function laugh(w) {
  const m = PEOPLE[w].userData.mesh;
  await animate(0.9, (k) => { m.position.y = Math.abs(Math.sin(k * Math.PI * 2)) * 0.06; });
  m.position.y = 0;
}

// 坐著的時候，鏡頭慢慢轉向說話的人；max：最多轉幾度（客人模式聽人聊天時可以轉過身去看）
// p 為 null：轉回座位原本的視線（看著自己桌上的杯子）
// 坐著的時候把視線轉向某個人（p＝null：回到座位原本的方向）。
// 美術評分修正 a：對話時說話的人要完整入鏡——水平置中、臉放在畫面上方約 1/3（同時算 yaw 與 pitch）；
// 熟客的場景與客人模式裡，畫面略微推近（FOCUS_FOV）、四周加一點暗角；前景擋住臉的人由 updateOcclusion() 淡掉
const FOCUS_FOV = 62, SEAT_FOV = 72;
const seatFov = () => state.seat?.fov || SEAT_FOV; // 美術評分修正 c：座位可以有自己的視角（推近一點，桌子少一點）
// 美術評分修正 c：說話的人離得遠時再推近一點，身高（地板到頭頂）至少占畫面約 35%（評審：凱文第二幕凱文太小）；最多推到 30°
let focusFov = FOCUS_FOV;
const SPEAKER_SHARE = 0.52, FOCUS_FOV_MIN = 30; // 0.52：headOf() 算到泡泡的位置、比畫出來的頭頂高，實測畫面上約 37%
const FACE_DROP = 0.2; // 臉的中心在頭頂（headOf）往下多少
let focusP = null;
let focusAlso = null; // 和說話的人一起入鏡的另一位（美術評分修正 e）：前景淡出時不算他
// art2b：轉向說話的人時他站在哪裡；同一個人走開了（德叔說完「我端過去」走到桌邊才說下一句），下一句要重新轉過去
const focusAt = new THREE.Vector3();
const movedSinceLook = (p) => p.position.distanceTo(focusAt) > 0.8;
let lookTok = 0, turnTok = 0; // turnTok：正在轉向的那一次（轉完是 0；開發者模式的 camStill 用）
const isPerson = (p) => p === cat || Object.values(PEOPLE).includes(p);
const conversing = () => !!state.scene || !!state.favorite || (!!state.guest && state.guest !== 'enter' && state.guest !== 'sit'); // state.favorite：老闆請熟客的那杯（favorites.js） // 客人模式：坐下之後的點單、上桌、聊天
// also：一起入鏡的另一個人（客人模式聊天的兩位熟客）：鏡頭對著兩人的中間，視角放到兩人都完整、腳底貼近畫面下緣、頭上留給泡泡
const PAIR_HALF = 0.32; // 一個人畫出來的半寬（公尺）
const PAIR_HEADROOM = 0.3, PAIR_FOOT = 0.04; // 頭頂以上留畫面高度的 30%（泡泡與頂部介面），腳底以下留 4%
function pairView(s, list) {
  const b = s.look.clone().sub(s.eye), base = Math.atan2(b.x, b.z), basePitch = Math.atan2(b.y, Math.hypot(b.x, b.z));
  let a0 = Infinity, a1 = -Infinity, top = -Infinity, bot = Infinity;
  // 龍眼坐在兩人旁邊（catVisit()）的話也一起入鏡
  const near = cat.visible && cat.userData.mesh.position.y < 0.05 && list.some((q) => q.position.distanceTo(cat.position) < 1.5);
  for (const q of near ? [...list, cat] : list) {
    const t = q.position.clone().sub(s.eye), dist = Math.hypot(t.x, t.z);
    const a = wrapAngle(Math.atan2(t.x, t.z) - base), w = Math.atan((q === cat ? 0.25 : PAIR_HALF) / dist);
    a0 = Math.min(a0, a - w); a1 = Math.max(a1, a + w);
    if (q !== cat) top = Math.max(top, Math.atan2(q.position.y + headOf(q) - s.eye.y, dist));
    bot = Math.min(bot, Math.atan2(-s.eye.y, dist));
  }
  const aspect = camera.aspect;
  let F = (top - bot) / (1 - PAIR_HEADROOM - PAIR_FOOT);
  const needH = (a1 - a0) / 2 + 0.03;
  const vForH = 2 * Math.atan(Math.tan(needH) / aspect);
  F = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(Math.max(F, vForH), THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(FOCUS_FOV_MIN), THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(75));
  // 頭頂貼在留白線上的仰角與腳底貼在下緣的仰角；寬度卡住、視角放大時兩者之間都可以，取中間
  const pitch = ((top + PAIR_HEADROOM * F - F / 2) + (bot + F / 2 - PAIR_FOOT * F)) / 2;
  return { yaw: (a0 + a1) / 2, pitch: THREE.MathUtils.clamp(pitch - basePitch, -0.6, 0.5), fov: THREE.MathUtils.radToDeg(F) };
}
function lookToward(p, max = 1.2, also = null) {
  if (state.mode !== 'seat' || !state.seat || p === undefined) return;
  const s = state.seat;
  const person = !!p && isPerson(p);
  focusP = person ? p : null;
  if (person) focusAt.copy(p.position);
  if (person && conversing()) state.focus = true;
  $('vignette').classList.toggle('on', !!state.focus && !state.closeup);
  const b = s.look.clone().sub(s.eye), t = p ? p.position.clone().sub(s.eye) : b;
  if (person && state.focus) {
    const tall = p.position.y + headOf(p), dist = Math.hypot(t.x, t.z);
    focusFov = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(2 * THREE.MathUtils.radToDeg(Math.atan(tall / (2 * SPEAKER_SHARE * dist))), FOCUS_FOV_MIN, FOCUS_FOV);
  }
  let yaw = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(wrapAngle(Math.atan2(t.x, t.z) - Math.atan2(b.x, b.z)), -max, max);
  let pitch = 0;
  const pair = person && state.focus && also && also.visible && isPerson(also) ? pairView(s, [p, also]) : null;
  focusAlso = null;
  if (pair && Math.abs(pair.yaw) <= max) {
    focusAlso = also;
    focusFov = pair.fov;
    yaw = pair.yaw;
    pitch = pair.pitch;
  } else if (person) {
    const fov = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(state.focus ? focusFov : seatFov());
    const fy = p.position.y + headOf(p) - FACE_DROP - s.eye.y;
    const want = Math.atan2(fy, Math.hypot(t.x, t.z)) - Math.atan((1 / 3) * Math.tan(fov / 2)); // 臉在畫面上方 1/3
    pitch = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(want - Math.atan2(b.y, Math.hypot(b.x, b.z)), -0.6, 0.5);
  }
  let from = null, fromPitch = 0;
  const my = ++lookTok;
  let k = 0;
  realWaiters.push((dt) => {
    if (my !== lookTok) return true; // 又轉向別人了
    // 鏡頭還在移回座位（例如看完德叔沖、端上桌之後）：等它到了再轉。
    // 轉的角度是相對座位原本的方向算的，移動中先轉，說話的人會被切到畫面邊上（美術評分修正 b：桌機客人模式予安被切掉一半）
    if (tween) return false;
    if (state.mode !== 'seat') return true; // 等的時候站起來了
    if (from === null) { from = cam.yaw; fromPitch = cam.pitch; }
    turnTok = my;
    k = Math.min(1, k + dt * 1.2 * DEV_SPEED);
    if (k >= 1) turnTok = 0;
    cam.yaw = from + (yaw - from) * ease(k);
    cam.pitch = fromPitch + (pitch - fromPitch) * ease(k);
    return k >= 1;
  });
}
// art2b：對話中途看完德叔沖、鏡頭移回座位時，視線回到正前方：正在說話的人（泡泡還在）要再轉回來
// （原本要等下一個人開口才轉；颱風夜阿哲的最後一句，畫面停在窗戶上、泡泡沒有尾巴）。lookToward() 會等鏡頭移完再轉
function refocusSpeaker() {
  if (conversing() && bubble.classList.contains('show') && speaker && speaker !== 'player' && isPerson(speaker) && speaker.visible) lookToward(speaker, 2.3);
}
// 鏡頭移動（例如端上桌之後移回座位）做完：對話的下一句等鏡頭到了再說，說話的人才會在畫面裡（快轉時台詞比鏡頭快很多）
const camSettled = () => new Promise((r) => { const f = () => (tween ? requestAnimationFrame(f) : r()); f(); });
// 對話結束（場景演完、客人模式聊完）：推近與暗角收起來，視線回到座位原本的方向
function endFocus() {
  if (!state.focus || conversing()) return;
  state.focus = false;
  $('vignette').classList.remove('on');
  if (state.mode === 'seat' && !state.closeup) lookToward(null);
  focusP = null;
}
// 前景的人擋住說話的人的臉：淡成半透明；沒擋住就慢慢恢復
const occ = new THREE.Vector3();
const BIG_FG = 1.3; // 前景的人看起來比說話的人大 1.3 倍以上就淡出
function updateOcclusion(dt) {
  // art2b：鏡頭轉向誰（focusP）之外，對話中正在說話的人也算（客人模式德叔端上桌的那句，鏡頭剛移回座位、還沒轉向他）
  const talker = focusP || (conversing() && bubble.classList.contains('show') && speaker && speaker !== 'player' && isPerson(speaker) ? speaker : null);
  const f = state.mode === 'seat' && !state.closeup && talker && talker.visible ? talker : null;
  let face = null;
  const tanH = Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(camera.fov) / 2);
  if (f) {
    occ.copy(f.position); occ.y += headOf(f) - FACE_DROP;
    const d = camera.position.distanceTo(occ);
    occ.project(camera);
    if (occ.z < 1) face = { x: occ.x, y: occ.y, d, ry: 0.2 / (d * tanH), rx: 0.16 / (d * tanH * camera.aspect), size: (f.position.y + headOf(f)) / d };
  }
  for (const q of [...Object.values(PEOPLE), cat]) {
    const m = q.userData.mesh, mat = m.material;
    let target = 1;
    if (face && q !== f && q !== focusAlso && q.visible) {
      const prm = m.geometry.parameters;
      occ.copy(q.position); occ.y += m.position.y + prm.height / 2;
      const d = camera.position.distanceTo(occ);
      if (d < face.d - 0.3) {
        occ.project(camera);
        const hx = (prm.width * 0.35) / (d * tanH * camera.aspect), hy = (prm.height * 0.45) / (d * tanH); // 圖的四周有留白：只算中間的身體
        if (occ.z < 1 && Math.abs(occ.x - face.x) < hx + face.rx && Math.abs(occ.y - face.y) < hy + face.ry) target = 0.35;
        // 美術評分修正 c：前景的人在畫面裡、看起來比說話的人大很多（凱文第二幕的予安比凱文大三倍）：整個淡出，說話的人才是焦點
        else if (occ.z < 1 && Math.abs(occ.x) < 1 + hx && Math.abs(occ.y) < 1 + hy && (q.position.y + headOf(q)) / d > BIG_FG * face.size) target = 0;
      }
      // 美術評分修正 e：被畫面左右邊緣切掉一大塊的人（評審：告別第六段德叔在右邊被切掉半張臉）：要嘛完整入鏡、要嘛完全出鏡，淡出
      if (target > 0 && edgeCut(q)) target = 0;
    }
    fadeTo(mat, target, dt);
  }
  // art2b：前景的擺飾與椅子也一樣（評審：桌機客人模式，前景的畫架擋住右邊 1/3 和德叔；高腳椅在畫面正中下方）。
  // 比說話的人近、畫出來的範圍和說話的人左右重疊（擋在中間），或在畫面裡看起來比說話的人高，就淡出（修正 f 以前是 30%）；試擺中的東西本來就是 72%
  let body = null;
  if (face) {
    const r = screenRect(f, 0.8);
    if (r) body = r;
  }
  // 美術評分修正 e：坐著時，緊貼在鏡頭前、上緣只比按鈕列高一點的椅子（吧台座轉頭看凱文時旁邊那張空高腳椅）大半被提示條和按鈕列蓋住：整個淡出
  const uiLine = -1 + (2 * UI_SPACE.bottom) / (app.clientHeight || 1) + 0.25;
  for (const q of occProps()) {
    const mat = q.userData.mesh.material;
    const base = q.userData.entry?.trial ? 0.72 : 1;
    let target = base;
    if (state.mode === 'seat' && !state.closeup && q.visible) {
      const r = screenRect(q, 0.92);
      // 美術評分修正 f：一半以上在按鈕列與提示條底下就算（吧台座看凱文時鏡頭往下壓，前景那張空高腳椅的上緣變高了）
      if (r && r.d < 2.0 && r.x1 > -1 && r.x0 < 1 && (Math.min(uiLine, r.y1) - r.y0) / Math.max(1e-3, r.y1 - r.y0) > 0.5) target = 0;
    }
    if (body && q.visible) {
      const r = screenRect(q, 0.92);
      if (r && r.d < face.d - 0.3 && r.x1 > -1 && r.x0 < 1 && r.y1 > -1 && r.y0 < 1) {
        // 擋在鏡頭和說話的人中間：左右和說話的人重疊（上下不看：吧台前的高腳椅比吧台後的德叔低，但正好在他前面）
        const ox = Math.min(r.x1, body.x1) - Math.max(r.x0, body.x0);
        // 美術評分修正 f：直接淡到看不見（評審：颱風夜阿哲前面停著一張半透明的凳子殘影）
        if (ox > 0.3 * Math.min(r.x1 - r.x0, body.x1 - body.x0) || r.size > face.size) target = 0;
      }
      // 美術評分修正 e：前景被畫面邊緣切掉一大塊的椅子、擺飾（評審：左邊一條深色的椅子弧線）也淡出
      if (r && r.d < face.d - 0.3 && edgeCut(q, r)) target = 0;
    }
    fadeTo(mat, target, dt);
  }
}
// 紙片畫出來的範圍有一部分在畫面左右邊緣外：看得到的部分在 5%～75% 之間（大半在外、或被切掉一大塊）
function edgeCut(q, r = screenRect(q, 0.9)) {
  if (!r || r.x1 - r.x0 < 1e-3) return false;
  const seen = (Math.min(1, r.x1) - Math.max(-1, r.x0)) / (r.x1 - r.x0);
  return (r.x0 < -1 || r.x1 > 1) && seen > 0.05 && seen < 0.75 && r.y1 > -1 && r.y0 < 1;
}
function fadeTo(mat, target, dt) {
  if (Math.abs(mat.opacity - target) < 0.005) return;
  mat.opacity += (target - mat.opacity) * Math.min(1, dt * 6);
  if (Math.abs(mat.opacity - target) < 0.005) mat.opacity = target;
  mat.alphaTest = mat.opacity < 0.99 ? 0.08 : 0.35;
}
// 會擋到人的擺飾與椅子（老闆自己坐的那張也算：坐吧台時高腳椅就在鏡頭前面；在鏡頭後面的 screenRect() 會略過）
const occProps = () => [...decorPapers.values(), ...SEATS.map((st) => st.prop), stoolMid, stoolFar, yuanChair, noticeSign];
// 紙片畫出來的範圍在畫面上的外框（NDC）、離鏡頭多遠、看起來多高（公尺÷距離）；shrink：外框往內縮一點（圖的邊緣多半是細的椅腳、葉子）
const rectV = new THREE.Vector3(), rectR = new THREE.Vector3();
function screenRect(q, shrink = 1) {
  const m = q.userData.mesh, prm = m.geometry.parameters;
  const img = m.material.map?.image;
  const half = prm.width * drawnHalf(img) * shrink;
  const y0 = q.position.y + m.position.y, y1 = y0 + prm.height * (1 - inkTop(img)) * (shrink < 1 ? 0.96 : 1);
  rectR.set(1, 0, 0).applyQuaternion(camera.quaternion);
  const d = camera.position.distanceTo(rectV.copy(q.position).setY((y0 + y1) / 2));
  let x0 = Infinity, x1 = -Infinity, ya = Infinity, yb = -Infinity;
  for (const sg of [-1, 1]) for (const y of [y0, y1]) {
    rectV.copy(q.position).setY(y).addScaledVector(rectR, sg * half).project(camera);
    if (rectV.z >= 1) return null; // 在鏡頭後面
    x0 = Math.min(x0, rectV.x); x1 = Math.max(x1, rectV.x); ya = Math.min(ya, rectV.y); yb = Math.max(yb, rectV.y);
  }
  return { x0, x1, y0: ya, y1: yb, d, size: (y1 - y0 + Math.max(0, y0)) / d };
}

// 颱風夜：天色一下子暗下來，窗外的雨斜著打，風雨聲
function startTyphoon() {
  state.weather = 'typhoon';
  state.night = true;
  applyLight();
  applySound();
  return realWait(600);
}

// 德叔在吧台試沖阿哲的兩包豆子
async function brewTaste() {
  await deshuGo(HOME);
  const steam = brewer.position.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.19, 0));
  steamSources.add(steam);
  setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.pour);
  await wait(2.4);
  setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.idle);
  await wait(0.8);
  setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.pour);
  await wait(2.0);
  setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.idle);
  steamSources.delete(steam);
}

const sayMs = (text) => Math.min(6500, 1900 + [...text].length * 115);
// 選項選了以後，老闆說出那一句（泡泡在畫面下方）；「（點點頭）」這種括號開頭的動作不出泡泡（fable 第四節 8）
async function playerSays(text) {
  if (!text || text.startsWith('（')) return;
  const ms = sayMs(text);
  say(text, Math.max(ms / DEV_SPEED, Math.min(ms, 700)), 'player');
  await realWait(ms + 450);
}
// 龍眼此刻睡在窗台上（來訪段落裡講到窗台的句子只在這時候演；cat-chair 把他叫到椅子上時跳過，不改龍眼的位置）
const catOnSill = () => catAtHome && !catOnSeat && cat.visible;
const personOf = (w) => (w === 'boss' ? kevin : w === 'player' ? 'player' : w === 'cat' ? cat : w === 'window' ? windows[0] : w === 'thermo' ? thermo : PEOPLE[w]);

async function playSteps(steps, tok) {
  for (const s of steps) {
    if (tok !== live.token) throw ABORT;
    await playStep(s, tok);
  }
}
async function playStep(s, tok) {
  switch (s.do) {
    // 快轉時泡泡至少留 0.7 秒（下一句會直接換掉）：美術評分修正 c，全流程截圖才拍得到泡泡；一般玩家 DEV_SPEED＝1，沒有差別
    case 'say': { if (state.mode === 'seat') await camSettled(); const ms = sayMs(s.text); // 美術評分修正 e：視訊裡的主管不在店裡：泡泡改成沒有尾巴的「畫外音」樣式（原本尾巴指著凱文）
      say(s.text, Math.max(ms / DEV_SPEED, Math.min(ms, 700)), personOf(s.who), s.name || null, s.who === 'boss');
      return realWait(ms + 450); }
    case 'wait': return realWait(s.sec * 1000);
    case 'look': lookToward(personOf(s.who), 2.3); return realWait(500); // 和對話時轉向說話的人一樣，可以轉到身後
    case 'pose': setPose(s.who, s.pose); return realWait(350);
    case 'enter': {
      if (S.REGULAR_IDS.includes(s.who)) { S.arrive(save, s.who, today()); live.arrived.add(s.who); }
      const spot = spotFor(s.who, s.at);
      live.planned[s.who] = spot; // 一起走進來的人（阿哲站在阿公旁邊）要知道對方要去哪裡
      const go = enterPerson(s.who, spot, s.pose, s.then || s.pose, s.fast);
      if (!s.async) await go;
      return;
    }
    case 'walk': return movePerson(s.who, spotFor(s.who, s.at), s.pose, s.then);
    case 'arrived': {
      const t0 = performance.now();
      while (live.at[s.who] !== live.planned[s.who] && performance.now() - t0 < 30000) await realWait(100);
      return undefined;
    }
    case 'leave': return leavePerson(s.who);
    case 'deshuTo': return deshuGo(nearSpot(s.who));
    case 'deshuHome': {
      if (!s.async) return deshuGo(HOME);
      const go = deshuGo(HOME).finally(() => { if (live.deshuWalk === go) live.deshuWalk = null; });
      live.deshuWalk = go;
      return undefined;
    }
    case 'serve': return serveTo(s.who, s.kind);
    case 'cat': return catTo(s.who, s.lap);
    case 'music': return musicDown();
    case 'laugh': return Promise.all(s.who.map(laugh));
    case 'glance': return glance(personOf(s.who));
    case 'weather': return startTyphoon();
    case 'prop': counterBag.visible = true; return realWait(500);
    case 'choice': {
      const i = await choose(s.options, s.prompt || ''); live.answers[s.key] = i; save.story.answers[s.key] = i; persist();
      if (s.speak) await playerSays(s.options[i]); // 來訪段落：老闆那句以「你」的泡泡說出來（括號的動作不出泡泡）
      return;
    }
    // 來訪段落（visits.js）多的幾種步驟：只在某個狀態下演、記一件事、龍眼在窗台上的小動作
    case 'when': return VS.condOk(save, s.if, { catSill: catOnSill() }) ? playSteps(s.steps, tok) : undefined;
    case 'mark':
      if (s.flag) save.flags[s.flag] = true;
      if (s.early) MO.markEarly(save, s.early);
      persist();
      return undefined;
    case 'catMove': return catFree() ? catMove(s.kind) : undefined;
    case 'branch': return playSteps(s.cases[live.answers[s.key] ?? save.story.answers[s.key] ?? 0] || [], tok); // 隔天才用到的選項（凱文念啟事）從存檔讀
    case 'notice': return postNotice();
    case 'keys': return handKeys(s.who);
    case 'name': { // 最後一晚：德叔第一次叫老闆的名字
      const t = F.nameLine(save.player.name), ms = sayMs(t) + 800;
      lookToward(null); // 視線回到桌上的琺瑯杯
      say(t, ms / DEV_SPEED, deshu);
      return realWait(ms + 450);
    }
    case 'ifFire': return save.player.resignation === 'fire' ? playSteps(s.steps, tok) : undefined;
    case 'read': return new Promise((r) => openLetter(S.DOCS[s.doc], r));
    case 'brewTaste': return brewTaste();
    case 'menu': return zheBeansAsk();
    default: return undefined;
  }
}

// 阿哲第六幕（任務 #19，Q73 的暫定做法，D186）：阿哲的豆收進菜單本，德叔問老闆要不要寫上黑板；老闆可以說之後再說。
// 任務照舊在這一幕演完時完成（不卡 37°C）；黑板寫滿了就問要擦掉哪一行，也可以先不寫
async function zheBeansAsk() {
  const d = today();
  MN.unlock(save, 'zhe-beans', d, now(), { board: false });
  MN.markTold(save, 'zhe-beans');
  persist();
  if (MN.onBoard(save, 'zhe-beans')) { drawBackBar(); return realWait(800); } // 中途重新整理、重演一次：已經寫上去了
  const i = await choose(MN.ZHE6.options, MN.ZHE6.ask, '德叔');
  let ok = false;
  if (i === 0) {
    ok = MN.write(save, 'zhe-beans', d);
    if (!ok) {
      const lines = [...save.menu.board];
      const j = await choose([...lines.map((id) => MN.eraseOf(MN.ITEMS[id].name)), MN.BOOK.cancel], MN.BOOK.swap, '德叔');
      if (j < lines.length) ok = MN.replace(save, lines[j], 'zhe-beans', d);
    }
  }
  if (ok) {
    MN.markNoticed(save, 'zhe-beans', 'zhe');
    persist();
    drawBackBar();
    audio.play('click');
    return realWait(900);
  }
  persist();
  const ms = sayMs(MN.ZHE6.later);
  say(MN.ZHE6.later, ms / DEV_SPEED, deshu);
  return realWait(ms + 450);
}

// 演一個里程碑；演完才記進存檔（中途重新整理就從頭再演一次）
// full：老闆坐著、來訪段落開著時，改演那個里程碑當天的擴寫（visits.js 的 kind: 'with'；原場景的每一句照順序都在裡面），
// 演完記進存檔之後，結尾有第一杯的就自然問一次（runInvite()）。站著、離線時照舊是原場景。
// 正式流程只在今天還有份量時才呼叫（storyTick() 的 liveScene()／entranceDue()）；開發者的 __cafe.playScene() 不看份量，滿了時是原場景
async function runScene(m, { full = false } = {}) {
  const tok = ++live.token;
  const ex = full ? VS.expansionFor(save, m.id, today()) : null;
  state.scene = m;
  bubble.classList.remove('show');
  updateUI();
  try {
    await playSteps(ex ? ex.steps : m.scene, tok);
    if (!behindBar(deshu.position) || deshu.position.distanceTo(HOME) > 0.05) await deshuGo(HOME);
  } catch (e) {
    if (e !== ABORT) console.warn('熟客場景中斷', e);
    if (tok !== live.token) return; // 跳天數等等讓場景作廢：不記進存檔
  }
  const d = today();
  const got = S.complete(save, m, d, now());
  if (got.length) drawBackBar();
  if (m.gift) glowFund(); // 熟客送的東西收進倉庫：佈置鈕輕輕亮一下
  if (m.id === 'zhe4') for (const w of ['zhe', 'grandpa']) live.leaveAt.set(w, performance.now() + 60000 / DEV_SPEED);
  if (m.id === 'zhe3') live.leaveAt.delete('zhe'); // 颱風夜，阿哲待在店裡
  // 來訪段落：老闆看到的里程碑（含同日擴寫）算那位熟客今天的一段；擴寫版演過就不再演接回；窗口過了的段落跳過
  VS.noteMilestone(save, m.who, d);
  if (ex) VS.markPlayed(save, ex, d);
  VS.expire(save);
  persist();
  if (ex && VS.inviteOf(ex) && tok === live.token) await runInvite(m.who, VS.inviteOf(ex), tok).catch((e) => { if (e !== ABORT) console.warn('第一杯的邀請中斷', e); });
  state.scene = null;
  updateUI();
  refreshDevTools();
  checkTasks({ delay: 600 });
  readyAt = performance.now() + 6000 / DEV_SPEED;
}

// 熟客的來訪段落（visits.js）：里程碑之間的閒聊、離線里程碑之後的接回。和熟客場景同一套步驟與鏡頭（state.scene，conversing() 為真）；
// 不完成任務、不加溫度、不寫日誌；演完才記進存檔（中途換一天就作廢，那一段之後照窗口規則再演或跳過）
async function runVisit(seg) {
  const tok = ++live.token;
  state.scene = { id: seg.id, visit: true, who: seg.who };
  bubble.classList.remove('show');
  updateUI();
  try {
    await playSteps(seg.steps, tok);
    if (!behindBar(deshu.position) || deshu.position.distanceTo(HOME) > 0.05) await deshuGo(HOME);
  } catch (e) {
    if (e !== ABORT) console.warn('來訪段落中斷', e);
    if (tok !== live.token) return;
  }
  const d = today();
  VS.markPlayed(save, seg, d);
  visitLog.push({ id: seg.id, day: d });
  persist();
  const inv = VS.inviteOf(seg);
  if (inv && tok === live.token) await runInvite(seg.who, inv, tok).catch((e) => { if (e !== ABORT) console.warn('第一杯的邀請中斷', e); });
  state.scene = null;
  updateUI();
  refreshDevTools();
  readyAt = performance.now() + 6000 / DEV_SPEED;
}
const visitLog = []; // 測試用：演過的來訪段落
// 段落結尾的第一杯（最愛第一段）：老闆在選項裡自然請一杯（提案決策 B）。選「我請」就直接端黑板上的那一杯（服從一天一杯）；
// 黑板上沒有那一杯（阿哲是沒有龍眼乾）時，德叔問要端哪一杯，照平常的選杯流程。今天這位熟客的邀請就算問過了（點他不再問）
async function runInvite(w, inv, tok) {
  const d = today();
  if (!VS.inviteReady(save, w, d) || !PEOPLE[w]?.visible) return;
  VS.markOffered(save, w, d);
  persist();
  const i = await choose(inv.options);
  if (tok !== live.token) throw ABORT;
  VS.markInvited(save, w); // 問到了（選項出來前中斷的，之後由接回補問：予安是 yuan-r3）
  persist();
  await playerSays(inv.options[i]);
  if (i !== 0) { await playSteps(inv.no, tok); return; }
  const drink = VS.inviteDrink(save, inv, boardShift);
  await playSteps(drink ? inv.yes : inv.missing, tok);
  state.scene = null; // 端過去的那段由 serveFavorite() 接手（state.favorite）
  if (drink) { await serveFavorite(w, drink, { quiet: true }); return; }
  const drinks = MN.boardDrinks(save, boardShift);
  if (!drinks.length) return;
  const j = await choose([...drinks.map((id) => MN.ITEMS[id].name), FV.FAV_TEXT.cancel], FV.FAV_TEXT.ask(favName(w)), barName());
  if (j < drinks.length && tok === live.token && PEOPLE[w].visible) await serveFavorite(w, drinks[j]); // 選完杯，德叔照平常說「好，我沖一杯過去。」
}
// 老闆在場時，這位熟客現在可以開始演的里程碑：S.liveNext() 再看今天的份量（visits.js 的 milestoneRoom()：
// 在場的里程碑含同日擴寫算一段，每位熟客一天一段、全店一天兩段）。份量滿了就是 null：今天不演、不記完成、不給獎勵，
// 條件與順序不動，等下一個有份量的遊玩日（老闆不在的日子照舊由營業日誌結算）。&visits=0（隔離原場景的測試）不看份量
function liveScene(w, d) {
  const m = S.liveNext(save, w, d);
  return m && (!VISITS_ON || VS.milestoneRoom(save, w, d)) ? m : null;
}
// 走進來就是演出的里程碑（颱風夜、阿哲帶阿公來）今天可以演：條件達成、在場的全店一天一個、今天的份量還有
const entranceDue = (w, m, d) => !!m?.entrance && S.isDue(save, m, d) && (!m.present || save.story.lastPresentDay !== d)
  && (!VISITS_ON || VS.milestoneRoom(save, w, d));
// 今天別的熟客還要演的里程碑有幾個（全店一天兩段：先留給它們）；今天已經用掉一段的熟客，里程碑今天也不會演，不留
function reservedMilestones(w, d) {
  let n = 0;
  const used = VS.slotsToday(save, d);
  for (const o of S.REGULAR_IDS) {
    if (o === w || used.includes(o) || (!live.arrived.has(o) && !live.expect.has(o))) continue;
    const m = S.nextMilestone(save, o);
    if (m && save.regulars[o].lastMilestoneDay !== d && S.isDue(save, m, d) && (!m.present || save.story.lastPresentDay !== d)) n++;
  }
  return n;
}
const VISIT_QUIET_MS = 8000; // 店裡安靜這麼久（遊戲時間）之後，才開始來訪段落（熟客剛坐下、剛說完話時不馬上開始）
// 現在可以演的來訪段落：人在店裡、坐在自己的位子上，這位熟客今天沒有里程碑要演
function visitCandidate(d) {
  if (!VISITS_ON || keeper() || F.inFarewell(save) || state.guest || state.closing) return null;
  for (const w of S.REGULAR_IDS) {
    if (!live.arrived.has(w) || !PEOPLE[w].visible || live.at[w] !== HOME_SPOT[w] || state.favorite === w) continue;
    const m = S.nextMilestone(save, w);
    const due = !!m && save.regulars[w].lastMilestoneDay !== d && S.isDue(save, m, d);
    const seg = VS.dueVisit(save, w, d, { milestoneDue: due, reserved: reservedMilestones(w, d) });
    if (seg) return seg;
  }
  return null;
}

// 新的一天（進店、跳天數、過了午夜）：決定今天誰會來
function stopStory() {
  live.token++;
  keeperHome(true); // 凱文坐在老闆旁邊喝的那杯（D200）：換一天、重設時直接回到吧台
  state.scene = null;
  if (state.choice) { state.choice = false; $('choices').innerHTML = ''; }
  for (const w of PEOPLE_IDS) {
    PEOPLE[w].visible = false;
    removeGuestCup(w);
  }
  live.expect.clear(); live.arrived.clear(); live.leaveAt.clear();
  live.at = {}; live.planned = {}; live.answers = {}; live.seatHinted = false; live.visitSeatHinted = false; live.closeHinted = false; live.deshuWalk = null; live.fwHinted = 0; live.held = new Set(); live.trialOfferHint = '';
  live.day = 0;
  catHoldUntil = 0;
}
function startDay() {
  if (!REGULARS_ON || !save.flags.seenOpening) return;
  const d = today();
  if (live.day === d) return;
  stopStory();
  live.day = d;
  S.settleThrough(save, d - 1);
  refreshNotice();
  if (F.departureDue(save, d)) { departureMorning(); updateUI(); return; } // 離開東山的早上
  if (H.closedOn(save, d)) {
    // 今天已經打烊了（打烊後重新整理）；最後一晚的話，凱文還在，龍眼睡在他腿上
    if (REGULARS_ON && (F.fw(save).on[7] === d || F.segmentDue(save, d)?.lastNight)) { placeAt('kevin', SPOT.kevin, 'free'); live.arrived.add('kevin'); }
    updateUI();
    return;
  }
  const t = performance.now();
  for (const p of S.planToday(save, d)) {
    if (p.who === 'kevin' && keeper()) continue; // 離開東山之後，凱文在吧台後面顧店
    if (p.already) {
      // 同一天重新整理：予安、凱文還在位子上；阿哲平常早就走了（颱風夜還在，或還有話要說時才在）
      if (p.who !== 'zhe' || save.story.typhoonDay === d || liveScene('zhe', d)) {
        placeAt(p.who, HOME_SPOT[p.who]);
        live.arrived.add(p.who);
      }
      continue;
    }
    live.expect.set(p.who, t + arrivalDelay(p.who, d));
  }
  planFarewellDay(d, t);
  updateUI();
}
// 什麼時候走進來（毫秒）：予安一開門就在；阿哲隔一會兒；凱文下午五點（開發者模式不等五點）
function arrivalDelay(w, d) {
  if (w === 'yuan') return 0;
  if (w === 'zhe') return (20000 + Math.floor(((d * 7919) % 25) * 1000)) / DEV_SPEED;
  if (DEV) return 8000 / DEV_SPEED;
  if (F.inFarewell(save) && F.done(save, 3)) return 10000; // 錄取之後，凱文早一點來（德叔：「明天早一點來。」）
  const ms = S.kevinWaitMs(new Date(now()));
  return ms ? ms : 3000;
}
async function arriveNormally(w) {
  const d = today();
  S.arrive(save, w, d);
  persist();
  if (w === 'yuan') { placeAt('yuan', SPOT.yuan); live.arrived.add('yuan'); return; }
  const m = S.nextMilestone(save, w);
  const seatPose = m?.arrivePose && S.isDue(save, m, d) ? m.arrivePose : defaultPose(w);
  live.walking = (live.walking || 0) + 1;
  await enterPerson(w, HOME_SPOT[w], w === 'kevin' ? 'walk' : 'stand', seatPose);
  live.walking--;
  if (live.day !== d) return;
  live.arrived.add(w);
  if (w === 'zhe') live.leaveAt.set('zhe', performance.now() + 100000 / DEV_SPEED);
}
const sceneReady = () => quiet() && !dueLetter(save, letterCtx());

function storyTick() {
  if (!REGULARS_ON || !live.day || live.day !== today()) return;
  const d = live.day, t = performance.now();
  for (const [w, at] of live.expect) {
    if (state.guest || state.closing) break; // 客人模式、打烊時沒有人走進來
    if (t < at) continue;
    const m = S.nextMilestone(save, w);
    // 自己走進來就是演出的里程碑（颱風夜、阿哲帶阿公來）：等店裡安靜下來。
    // 今天的份量滿了就照平常走進來，那個里程碑等下一個有份量的遊玩日（不記完成）
    if (entranceDue(w, m, d)) {
      if (sceneReady() && !state.scene) { live.expect.delete(w); runScene(m); return; }
      continue;
    }
    live.expect.delete(w);
    arriveNormally(w);
  }
  for (const [w, at] of live.leaveAt) {
    if (state.guest) break; // 客人模式中，聊天的人不會走
    if (t > at && !state.scene && state.favorite !== w && (!S.REGULAR_IDS.includes(w) || !liveScene(w, d)) && !farewellNeeds(w, d)) { live.leaveAt.delete(w); leavePerson(w); }
  }
  if (state.scene || !sceneReady()) return;
  // 今天的份量滿了的熟客不在候選裡（liveScene()）：不演第三段，也不提「先坐」「等打烊」
  const cands = [...live.arrived].map((w) => liveScene(w, d)).filter(Boolean)
    .sort((a, b) => (a.present - b.present) || S.MILESTONES.indexOf(a) - S.MILESTONES.indexOf(b));
  for (const m of cands) {
    // 予安念稿：要老闆按了「打烊」、喝完最後一杯；還沒打烊時德叔提一次
    if (!!m.needClosing !== (state.closing === 'after')) {
      if (m.needClosing && !state.closing && !live.closeHinted) { live.closeHinted = true; say(m.needClosingHint, 4800); }
      continue;
    }
    if (m.needSeat && state.mode !== 'seat') {
      if (!live.seatHinted) { live.seatHinted = true; say(m.needSeatHint, 4800); }
      continue;
    }
    // 里程碑當天的擴寫（visits.js）：老闆坐著才演擴寫版。在場的里程碑（yuan3）等老闆坐下，德叔提一次「先坐。」；
    // 可以離線的里程碑不等，照舊演原場景（之後演接回或跳過），條件與順序都不動。
    // 能走到這裡就表示今天還有份量（liveScene()），擴寫不會因為份量滿了消失
    const ex = VISITS_ON ? VS.expansionFor(save, m.id, d) : null;
    if (ex && m.present && state.mode !== 'seat') {
      if (!live.visitSeatHinted) { live.visitSeatHinted = true; say(VS.SEAT_HINT, 3000); }
      continue;
    }
    runScene(m, { full: !!ex && state.mode === 'seat' });
    return;
  }
  // 來訪段落：里程碑都沒有要演時，坐著才演；站著時德叔提一次「先坐。」（一天一次）
  const seg = live.day === d && moments.quietFrom && (performance.now() - moments.quietFrom) * DEV_SPEED > VISIT_QUIET_MS ? visitCandidate(d) : null;
  if (seg) {
    if (state.mode === 'seat') { runVisit(seg); return; }
    if (!live.visitSeatHinted && !state.placing) { live.visitSeatHinted = true; say(VS.SEAT_HINT, 3000); }
  }
  farewellTick(d);
}
setInterval(storyTick, 500);

/* ---------- 等客人（承峰 11/3 試玩回饋 3，D179） ---------- */
// 「要玩家等，但要等啥沒讓玩家知道，會以為當機了」：熟客快走到門口的前幾秒，門外有腳步聲、門上的鈴輕輕晃，
// 提示列寫「好像有人往這邊走來了……」；坐著、一陣子沒人說話時，提示列換成等待的句子（文字與規則在 story.js 的 waitHint()）。
// 熟客場景裡「營業中」（D219）一字不改，只讓提示列慢慢呼吸（index.html 的 .hint.breathe），看得出畫面沒有停住
// 下一位熟客還有幾毫秒走進門（遊戲時間，開發者倍率換算回來）；今天沒有人要來、客人模式、打烊時是 null
function nextArrivalMs() {
  if (!REGULARS_ON || !live.day || live.day !== today() || state.guest || state.closing) return null;
  const t = performance.now();
  let best = null;
  for (const [w, at] of live.expect) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(at)) continue;
    const m = S.nextMilestone(save, w);
    if (entranceDue(w, m, live.day) && !sceneReady()) continue; // 走進來就是演出的：要等店裡安靜下來，時間說不準
    best = Math.min(best ?? Infinity, Math.max(0, at - t) * DEV_SPEED);
  }
  return best;
}
function waitTick() {
  const next = nextArrivalMs();
  if (next !== null && next <= S.APPROACH_MS && !waiting.approach) {
    waiting.approach = { until: performance.now() + (next + 4000) / DEV_SPEED };
    audio.play('steps');
    ringDoorBell();
  }
  if (waiting.approach && performance.now() > waiting.approach.until) waiting.approach = null;
  const here = PEOPLE_IDS.some((w) => PEOPLE[w].visible);
  const idleMs = (performance.now() - Math.max(state.satAt || 0, sayEnds, waiting.quietFrom)) * DEV_SPEED;
  const line = S.waitHint({ approaching: !!waiting.approach, nextMs: next, idleMs, here });
  if (line !== waiting.line) { waiting.line = line; updateUI(); }
}
setInterval(waitTick, 500);

/* ---------- 店裡的小事（承峰 11/3 第二輪回饋：方案 3、1、5；文字與規則在 moments.js） ---------- */
// 店裡沒事的時候（沒有演出、沒有人說話、沒在沖咖啡、沒有人走進來），依序看：
// 1. 擺飾第一次擺出來的反應（D183）：安靜 4 秒就演，一件一次（存檔 moments.decor）；
// 2. 前三天的小段落（D181）：安靜 30 秒（遊戲時間）之後演，一段一次（存檔 moments.early）；
// 3. 店內小事件（D182）：安靜 1～3 分鐘一件。
// 演的時候 moments.busy，quiet() 為 false：熟客場景、交信、德叔的話都等它演完（每件最多十幾秒）
// 開發者模式：店內小事件預設不自己發生（冒煙測試快轉時不會被隨機的小事打斷），&idle=N 改成安靜 N 秒（真實時間）就來一件；
// &moments=0 連擺飾的反應、前三天的小段落也關掉。__cafe.idleEvent()／early()／decorReact() 可以直接演
const MOMENTS_ON = !DEV || params.get('moments') !== '0';
const IDLE_FIXED = DEV && Number(params.get('idle')) > 0 ? Number(params.get('idle')) * 1000 : 0;
const IDLE_ON = MOMENTS_ON && (!DEV || IDLE_FIXED > 0);
const idleGap = () => IDLE_FIXED || (MO.IDLE_GAP.min + Math.random() * (MO.IDLE_GAP.max - MO.IDLE_GAP.min)) / DEV_SPEED;
moments.gap = idleGap();
const deshuFree = () => !keeper() && !brewing && !deshuReturning && !wipeOn && deshu.userData.art === deshuCanvas.idle && deshu.position.distanceTo(HOME) < 0.05;
const catFree = () => catAtHome && !catBusy && !catHeld() && !catOnSeat && cat.visible;
function momentsFree() {
  return quiet() && !state.closing && !state.arriving && !live.walking && !waiting.approach && !state.closeup && !sceneHidden() && !bubble.classList.contains('show');
}
const placedSet = () => new Set(save.owned.filter((o) => o.placed).map((o) => o.item));
// 在店裡、沒在演場景的熟客
const hereNow = () => (state.scene ? [] : S.REGULAR_IDS.filter((w) => PEOPLE[w].visible && live.arrived.has(w)));
function earlyCtx() {
  return { day: today(), here: S.REGULAR_IDS.filter((w) => PEOPLE[w].visible), seated: hereNow().filter((w) => live.at[w] === HOME_SPOT[w]),
    expecting: [...live.expect.keys()], met: { yuan: S.hasMilestone(save, 'yuan', 1), zhe: S.hasMilestone(save, 'zhe', 1) } };
}
async function runMoment(kind, id, fn) {
  moments.busy = true;
  moments.log.push({ kind, id, at: Math.round(performance.now()) });
  try { await fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('店裡的小事', id, e); }
  moments.busy = false;
  moments.quietFrom = performance.now();
  moments.gap = idleGap();
  updateUI();
}
setInterval(() => {
  if (moments.busy || !MOMENTS_ON) return;
  const t = performance.now();
  // 黑板便條：德叔各提一次（第一次坐吧台座、第一次打烊後）。打烊後 momentsFree() 是 false，所以放在它前面，條件自己看（noteHintDue()）
  const nh = noteHintDue();
  if (nh) { runMoment('note', nh, () => noteHint(nh)); return; }
  if (!momentsFree()) { moments.quietFrom = t; return; }
  const quietMs = (t - moments.quietFrom) * DEV_SPEED;
  if (quietMs > 4000) {
    const item = MO.pendingDecor(save)[0];
    if (item) { runMoment('decor', item, () => decorReact(item)); return; }
  }
  // 黑板菜單（D187）：收進菜單本的東西德叔提一句；熟客看到自己的東西寫上黑板（或被擦掉）說一句。都是一次
  if (quietMs > 4000 && !keeper()) {
    const t = MN.pendingTell(save)[0];
    if (t) { runMoment('menu', t.id, () => menuTell(t)); return; }
    const r = MN.boardReaction(save, hereNow(), (w, n) => S.hasMilestone(save, w, n));
    if (r) { runMoment('board', `${r.item}:${r.who}:${r.kind}`, () => boardReact(r)); return; }
    // 熟客最愛的咖啡：這一段開放、那位熟客在店裡時，德叔在吧台說一次那一段的線索
    const c = REGULARS_ON && live.day === today() ? FV.pendingClue(save, hereNow()) : null;
    if (c) { runMoment('clue', `${c.who}-${c.n}`, () => favClue(c)); return; }
    // 試咖啡教學：配方開放了、老闆還站著 → 德叔請他坐下（一次）
    const pendGuide = TS.pendingOffer(save);
    if (pendGuide && !save.tasting?.guided && state.mode === 'overview' && deshuFree() && !state.placing) {
      runMoment('trial-guide', pendGuide, () => tasteGuide()); return;
    }
    // 試咖啡（D206、D207）：劇情配方開放了，老闆坐著、德叔在吧台閒著時提一次；還沒定案的測試紀錄，隔天提一次（一張最多一次）
    const off = deshuFree() && trialOfferable() ? TS.pendingOffer(save) : null;
    if (off) { runMoment('trial', off, () => offerTrial(off)); return; }
    const rec = TS.pendingHint(save, today());
    if (rec) { runMoment('record', String(rec.id), () => recordHint(rec)); return; }
  }
  if (REGULARS_ON && live.day === today() && quietMs > MO.EARLY_QUIET_MS && !keeper()) {
    const e = MO.earlyDue(earlyCtx(), save.moments.early);
    if (e) { runMoment('early', e.id, () => earlyBeat(e)); return; }
  }
  if (IDLE_ON && t - moments.quietFrom > moments.gap) {
    const e = MO.pickIdle({ placed: placedSet(), night: state.night, weather: state.weather, keeper: keeper(), deshuFree: deshuFree(), catFree: catFree(), recent: moments.recent }, Math.random());
    if (!e) { moments.quietFrom = t; return; }
    moments.recent = [e.id, ...moments.recent].slice(0, 2);
    runMoment('idle', e.id, () => idleEvent(e, MO.idleLine(e, Math.random())));
  }
}, 1000);

// 德叔換一個姿勢一會兒（擦杯子、彎腰寫黑板）；sway：紙片左右輕輕晃（擦的動作）。中途有別的動作換過圖就不換回來
async function deshuBusy(pose, sec, sway = 0) {
  const c = deshuCanvas[pose];
  setPaper(deshu, c);
  const m = deshu.userData.mesh;
  await animate(sec, (k) => { m.rotation.z = sway * Math.sin(k * Math.PI * 6) * Math.sin(Math.PI * k); });
  m.rotation.z = 0;
  if (deshu.userData.art === c && !brewing) setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.idle);
}
// 德叔走到某處做一件事再走回吧台：走開的這段當作「德叔走回吧台……」（deshuReturning），這時按沖咖啡會等他回來
async function deshuErrand(pos, fn) {
  let done;
  deshuReturning = new Promise((r) => { done = r; });
  try {
    await deshuGo(V2(THREE.MathUtils.clamp(pos.x + (pos.x < 0.45 ? 0.5 : -0.5), -2.6, 2.6), THREE.MathUtils.clamp(pos.z + 0.25, -3.6, 3.5)));
    await fn();
    await deshuGo(HOME);
    deshu.userData.mesh.position.y = 0;
  } finally { deshuReturning = null; done(); }
}
// 澆花：壺口落下幾滴水（小小的淡藍點，往下掉、淡掉）
function waterDrops(pos) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
    const s = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: puffTex, color: '#9fd0e6', transparent: true, opacity: 0.8, depthWrite: false }));
    s.position.set(pos.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.18, 0.75 + Math.random() * 0.15, pos.z + 0.1);
    s.scale.setScalar(0.035);
    s.visible = false;
    scene.add(s);
    const vy = 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.3, delay = i * 0.18;
    let t = 0;
    waiters.push((dt) => {
      t += dt * speedNow();
      if (t < delay) return false;
      s.visible = true;
      s.position.y -= vy * dt * speedNow();
      s.material.opacity = Math.max(0, 0.8 - (t - delay) * 1.4);
      if (t - delay > 0.6) { scene.remove(s); s.material.dispose(); return true; }
      return false;
    });
  }
}
// 窗台上的龍眼：伸懶腰（坐起來、拉長）、翻身（換邊）、尾巴晃（紙片輕輕擺）、坐起來看窗外。都不離開窗台（Q64）
async function catMove(kind) {
  catBusy = true;
  const m = cat.userData.mesh;
  try {
    if (kind === 'stretch') {
      setPaper(cat, catCanvas.sit);
      await animate(1.6, (k) => { cat.userData.squash = 1 + Math.sin(Math.PI * k) * 0.12; });
      cat.userData.squash = 1;
      await wait(0.6);
    } else if (kind === 'roll') {
      await animate(0.5, (k) => { m.position.y = SILL.y + Math.sin(Math.PI * k) * 0.05; cat.userData.squash = 1 - Math.sin(Math.PI * k) * 0.15; });
      catTurn = -catTurn;
      cat.userData.squash = 1;
    } else if (kind === 'tail') {
      await animate(2.4, (k) => { m.rotation.z = Math.sin(k * Math.PI * 4) * 0.035; });
    } else if (kind === 'look') {
      setPaper(cat, catCanvas.sit);
      await wait(6);
    }
  } finally {
    m.rotation.z = 0;
    if (catAtHome) { m.position.y = SILL.y; setPaper(cat, catCanvas.sleep); }
    cat.userData.squash = 1;
    catBusy = false;
  }
}
// 窗外經過的影子（機車）：後面那扇窗前一團很淡的影子由左滑到右
async function windowShadow(sec = 3.2) {
  const w = windows[0];
  const s = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: puffTex, color: '#2a2018', transparent: true, opacity: 0, depthWrite: false }));
  s.scale.set(0.55, 0.4, 1);
  scene.add(s);
  await animate(sec, (k) => {
    s.position.set(w.position.x - 0.75 + 1.5 * k, w.position.y - 0.3, w.position.z + 0.04);
    s.material.opacity = Math.sin(Math.PI * k) * (state.night ? 0.08 : 0.16);
  });
  scene.remove(s); s.material.dispose();
}
const decorOf = (ids) => [...decorPapers.values()].find((d) => ids.includes(d.userData.item.id));

// 店內小事件（D182）：line＝這次偶爾說的那一句（沒有就是不說話）
async function idleEvent(e, line = '') {
  const deshuSays = (ms = 3200) => { if (line) say(line, ms); };
  switch (e.id) {
    case 'deshu-wipe':
      await deshuBusy('wipe', 4.5, 0.025);
      deshuSays();
      break;
    case 'deshu-water': {
      const p = decorOf(['plant', 'succulent']);
      if (!p) break;
      await deshuErrand(p.position, async () => {
        setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.pour);
        waterDrops(p.position);
        await wait(2.2);
        setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.idle);
        deshuSays(2600);
        await wait(1.2);
      });
      break;
    }
    case 'deshu-board':
      setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.pour);
      await wait(1.6);
      // 黑板上喝的東西換一杯到最上面（只寫老闆寫上去的東西，D188）；只有一杯時只是重寫一次、不說「今天換這支」
      if (MN.boardDrinks(save).length > 1) boardShift++;
      else line = '';
      drawBackBar();
      audio.play('click');
      await wait(0.8);
      if (deshu.userData.art === deshuCanvas.pour && !brewing) setPaper(deshu, deshuCanvas.idle);
      deshuSays();
      break;
    case 'cat-stretch': await catMove('stretch'); deshuSays(); break;
    case 'cat-roll': await catMove('roll'); break;
    case 'cat-tail': await catMove('tail'); break;
    case 'cat-look': await catMove('look'); break;
    case 'window-bike':
      audio.play('motorbike');
      await windowShadow();
      deshuSays();
      break;
    case 'window-birds':
      audio.play('birds');
      await wait(2.5);
      break;
    default: break;
  }
  if (line) await realWait(2600);
}

// 前三天的小段落（D181）
async function earlyBeat(e) {
  MO.markEarly(save, e.id);
  persist();
  const tok = live.token;
  if (e.id === 'd1-peek') {
    // 門外有腳步聲、門上的鈴輕輕晃（D179 的提示照常），一位小姐推門進來，站在門口看了窗邊那張桌子一會兒，沒坐就走了
    waiting.approach = { until: performance.now() + 9000 / DEV_SPEED };
    audio.play('steps');
    ringDoorBell();
    updateUI();
    await realWait(4000);
    if (tok !== live.token) return;
    live.walking = (live.walking || 0) + 1;
    try {
      await enterPerson('yuan', { pos: V2(0.25, 2.55), cup: null }, 'stand', 'stand');
      updateUI(); // 人進來了：「好像有人往這邊走來了……」換回平常的提示
      if (tok !== live.token) return;
      await wait(1.2);
      await glance(yuan, 2.2);
      await wait(1.5);
      await leavePerson('yuan');
    } finally { live.walking--; }
    if (tok !== live.token) return;
    await realWait(1500);
  } else if (e.id === 'd2-refill') {
    await serveTo('yuan', 'hot');
    deshuReturning = deshuGo(HOME).then(() => { deshuReturning = null; });
    await deshuReturning;
  } else if (e.id === 'd3-passerby') {
    audio.play('steps');
    await realWait(2600);
    ringDoorBell(0.12);
    await realWait(2200);
  }
  if (tok !== live.token) return;
  say(e.line[1], 4200, WHO[e.line[0]] || deshu);
  await realWait(4600);
}

// 收進菜單本的東西：德叔說一句（D187）
async function menuTell(t) {
  MN.markTold(save, t.id);
  persist();
  say(t.line, 4200, deshu);
  await realWait(4600);
}
// 熟客最愛的咖啡：德叔說那一段的線索（每段一次）
async function favClue(c) {
  FV.markClue(save, c.who, c.n);
  persist();
  if (!PEOPLE[c.who]?.visible) return;
  say(c.line, 4400, deshu);
  await realWait(4800);
}
// 熟客看到黑板：自己的東西第一次寫上去、或平常點的東西被擦掉（D187）
async function boardReact(r) {
  MN.markReaction(save, r);
  persist();
  if (!PEOPLE[r.who]?.visible) return;
  say(r.line, 4000, PEOPLE[r.who]);
  await realWait(4400);
}

// 試咖啡（承峰 11/5：「先做試咖啡」，D206；文字與規則在 tasting.js）：老闆坐著、德叔在吧台，沒有劇情、選項、演出時
function trialOfferable() {
  // 承峰：只在吧台座可以試（參數微調）
  return !keeper() && state.mode === 'seat' && state.seat?.id === 'bar' && !brewing && !deshuReturning && !state.choice && !state.scene && !state.favorite
    && !state.guest && !state.closing && !state.cinematic && !state.tutorial && !state.arriving && !state.placing && !state.letter && !overlayOpen()
